concepts.description: **Iteration 1, the founding document of the corpus's content system, six hundred words.** **Saṅkalpa Ignition** (5–10 min: the fierce mantra, Hanumān leaping *"the ocean of creative blocks"*, and the shift from *"I need to create"* to *"Hanumān creates through me"* — with the ego-driven *"what will people think?"* dissolving into *"how can this serve?"*) · **Vīrya Channeling** (the crossing-posture — *"focused, fearless, unwavering"* — the Kortex → SPARK → draft pipeline with breath awareness, *"JAI HANUMĀN!"* to break a block, and the corpus's first statement of its AI stance) · ⭐ **Prasād Distribution** — read the piece aloud, ask ***"Does this increase fearlessness, wisdom, or devotion in the reader?"***, and release with *"may this reach those who need it most."* ⚑⚑ ***Prasād* is the corpus's best metaphor and it never appears again**: the offering is made before release, so ownership is settled before anybody reads — **and prasād cannot be targeted or withheld**, which forbids the Hanumān Seal's later instruction to seal content *"to reach only those who will benefit."* ⚑ **The same before/during/after skeleton the flagship expands into fifteen techniques across three arsenals** — ⚠ **and the later document is more detailed while this one is more coherent**, having lost both the metaphor and the single pre-publication test. ⚑ Names its own coinage correctly (*"what I call Seva-Driven Creation"*); concedes spiritual bypassing in its own drawbacks

concepts.title: The Five-Phase Crisis Integration Protocol
concepts.description: **the corpus's most operationally complete document**, on the premise that crisis is *"acceleration opportunity"*. Five phases with durations (0–30 min · 30–60 min · 1–3 hours · 3–7 days · 1–4 weeks), four crisis-type protocols each layered three ways, the Five-Stream Confluence Method, and three intensity schedules rising to **90–180 minutes daily**. ⭐ **A stage-varying assessment question**, so the teaching question is never asked of a beginner. ⭐ **A symptom-to-site routing rule**, the only one in the corpus. ⭐ **The 90/10 attention allocation** — the one numeric rule here that is not an efficacy claim. ⚑⚑ **Its dark-night entry answers by *removing* apparatus, reversing the document's own premise in silence** — the one place experience appears to have overruled the framework. 🚩 **No clinician at the highest tier**, against a sibling document that makes therapist consultation a precondition; 🚩 *"reactions slow down by 50%"*. ⚑ **It also cross-references two other folder documents, which narrows phase 7's propagation finding: the documents that *assemble* cite, the ones that *generate* do not**

concepts.title: The Bhūmi–Kāṇḍa Correspondence System
concepts.description: ten bodhisattva *bhūmis* banded into three and mapped onto stretches of the *Rāmāyaṇa*, each band with its own crisis roster, its own assessment question and its own two-tier success markers. ⭐ **The staging is genuinely good**: *overwhelm from multiple paths* as a beginner's crisis and *spiritual pride* as an advanced one, with a stage-varying question that never asks a beginner *"how is this an opportunity for wisdom transmission?"* ⭐ **And the immediate/developmental marker split is exactly the distinction the corpus's measurement proposal needs and does not make there.** ⚑⚑ **This is the control case for the attribution problem — here the Buddhist borrowing is declared, while a sibling strips *"Bodri's four stages"* to *"Ram bhakti stages,"* so the variable is not honesty but whether the document's frame had a slot for provenance.** ⚠ **The advanced band runs to *Uttara-kāṇḍa*, the book of Sītā's banishment, unremarked** — and the deeper move, reading the epic's book order as the order of ripening, is an allegorical commitment the volume's own practice cautions against

concepts.title: The Five-Stream Confluence Method
concepts.description: ⭐ **the corpus's one answer to the question its whole method raises: *why more than one tradition?*** Five streams with assigned functions — formless awareness (Zen/Advaita), natural flow (Taoist), transformation technology (esoteric Buddhism), devotional surrender (bhakti), systematic development (classical yoga). ⚑⚑ **They are not five parallel tools but a ground, a diagnostic, two interventions pulling opposite ways and a constraint — a coherent architecture presented as a list, so what is missing is a *selection rule*.** ⭐ **Stream 2 supplies the corpus's only question that can conclude the crisis is right** — *are you maintaining conditions that need to transform?* 🔴 **Streams 1 and 4 make incompatible claims about whether anything is happening to the practitioner; streams 2 and 3 disagree about force. Both pairs printed without engagement and preserved here unsmoothed.** ⚠ **Against the volume's own multi-path structure, which sorts by *who is walking* and ranks the roads — and against the phase-4 rule that convergence is evidence only where the traditions were constituted to answer the question**

concepts.title: Direct Transmission and the Preparation Sequence
concepts.description: fifteen minutes in three five-minute phases, aimed at making the practitioner a channel. **Phase 1** at the heart centre with the marker being *the mantra continuing by itself*; **Phase 2** thirty seconds of deliberate self-identification *before* permeability, with the clear-glass-container image and the refusal *"you are not trying to become Hanuman"*; **Phase 3** the channel opened **downward to all beings before anything is received**. ⭐⭐ **Phase 2 is the corpus's cleanest statement of identification without dissolution — one image doing what its other identification practice needs four safeguards to say.** ⭐ **And the downward-first ordering is a structural anti-hoarding device rather than an exhortation, which is rare in this corpus.** ⚑⚑ **The vault holds the graded apparatus this lacks — Abhinavagupta's nine grades exist to distinguish what this treats as binary — and essay 41 holds the Hanuman-specific version, *"it was never Sūrya's gift at all, it was proximity."*** 🚩 *"Hanumān sthiti"* is a coinage under a provenance-claiming frame

concepts.title: The Four Readiness Indicators
concepts.description: the gate the corpus places in front of its most ambitious claim, and one of three places in this cluster where it polices itself. **Three elements required *simultaneously*** — understanding, unconditional love, effortless compassionate activity — **and a pseudo-transmission test conceding that *"even genuine insights"* can be mistaken for the real thing**, which is the only version of that warning applicable to a sincere practitioner. ⭐ **Three of the four indicators test *consistency*, not intensity** — the correct design, since a depth criterion would be satisfied by the very experience it must screen out. ⭐ **Indicator three names *"the desire to be needed"* as disqualifying**: the specific motive that produces teachers, invisible to whoever has it. ⚑⚑ **All four govern *offering* transmission; none governs receiving it, and the receiving gate exists as the four-part safety framework in a different file.** ⚠ **Self-administered, which is what grandiosity survives**

concepts.title: The Four-Level Service Architecture
concepts.description: ⚠ **the corpus's third and largest whole-framework misattribution**: an entire cosmology — personal, interpersonal, cultural, cosmic — restated twice more as an energy network and a karma–dharma matrix, with four applications, attributed throughout to a volume containing none of it, up to *"the Hanuman Ank suggests that sufficient numbers of individuals… can literally shift cultural paradigms."* ⭐⭐ **And the volume holds the argument it needed**: Dvivedī on the *ananya* verse, *maĩ sevaka sacarācara rūpa svāmi bhagavanta*, converting *dāsya* from personal loyalty into service to the whole of creation. ⚑⚑ **The verse changes *whom the service is addressed to* rather than describing energy climbing levels — so there is no ladder, and the four-level shape may simply be wrong for the claim.** ⚑ **The document states its purpose twice: to explain why the author's curriculum works** — which is why no level ever resolves against the practitioner. ⚠ **Against Rāma's private certainty that Hanuman's full capacity would trigger an early apocalypse: a cosmology in which cosmic-scale individual capacity is a hazard requiring management**

concepts.title: One Mantra, Six Functions
concepts.description: ⭐⭐ **six documents, one recitation, six mutually incompatible accounts of what saying it does** — nectar · sonar · temporal template · trinity · catalyst · excavation — **each declaring itself *"completely different"* from its predecessors.** ⚑⚑ **Strip the accounts and the same skeleton stands in all six**: three phases with day boundaries, morning/real-time/evening, three or four 1–10 metrics, a three-part constitutional adaptation — **even the phase boundaries nearly identical and never quite the same, which is a frame reused rather than re-derived.** **So what varied is the story about the hour, not the hour** — which is what you would expect if the interpretation were doing no work, and which lands where the volume already points: *"it was never Sūrya's gift at all, it was proximity."* ⭐ **This is also where phase 9's pre-registered prediction failed and produced the better finding: cross-referencing tracks a SHARED OBJECT, not document type.** ⚠ **The method never retracts — *"methodology scatter"*, in the author's own words**

concepts.title: The Trinity Protocol and the Three-Test Convergence
concepts.description: the fourth reading, which absorbs the first three and builds ⭐⭐⭐ **the strongest epistemic device in the extension corpus**: *"the correct dharmic choice will test positive across all three dimensions **simultaneously**."* ⚑⚑ **A conjunctive rule makes a single favourable reading insufficient — exactly the correction a confirmation-prone method needs, and the corpus builds it without noticing.** **Three further selection rules** (constitution, trauma type, situation), a 20-minute calibration with minute markers, ⚑ **and the corpus's only *banded* rating scale.** ⚠ **Independence of the three readings is never required**, and the document that would repair the echo protocol is the one that absorbs it

concepts.title: The Ram Nectar Overflow Protocol
concepts.description: the mantra as substance; trauma displaced by saturation. ⭐ **Two keepers**: the instruction ***not* to direct** the practice at a chosen wound — removing the step most governed by avoidance — and a success criterion refusing erasure, *"still present but no longer painful."* 🚩 **Against them the bypass claim** and **a full theodicy offered to a specific person about their own history.** ⚑⚑ **The corpus's own correction sits one document later** as a Yellow Caution on spiritual bypassing; the claim and its qualification are adjacent and never printed together. ⚠ **The volume runs the other way** — conceded lapses that stay lapses, a failure that stays a failure, and a sin with a named expiation rather than a reframe. ⚑ **Its Overflow Effect is the corpus's non-instrumental account of affecting others: a by-product produced by no intention**

concepts.title: The Ram Echo Location Protocol
concepts.description: the mantra as sonar, and **the corpus's first stated selection rule**: routing between three named healing approaches by the quality of the return, citing Protocol 1 by name. ⚑ **One genuine anti-confirmation feature** — a *resonance vocabulary* built on neutral objects over ten days, before anything is at stake. 🚩 **And the confirmation problem located in one line**: accuracy scored retrospectively by the person who made the decisions, with no record-before-outcome step. ⚑⚑ **The repair is one line — write the reading down before acting — and it converts a divination into a forecast that can be scored.** ⚠ **Its relationship application reads other people's states covertly and fails the corpus's own disclosure test.** ⚑ **The readings vary by constitution, which concedes the epistemic question: a reading that varies with the reader is a reading of the reader**

concepts.title: The Ram Time-Weaving Protocol
concepts.description: the mantra as access key to a *completed* dharmic timeline; **trauma as temporal disconnection, Karmic Timeline Editing, a seven-generation repair protocol.** ⭐ **Its best formulation is inherited-pattern-as-wisdom-that-outlived-its-conditions.** ⚠ **Its theodicy is *scored***: *"past traumas feeling like necessary preparation"* is a mastery sign, so a practitioner who accepted the teaching scores well and nothing distinguishes conviction from development. 🚩 **Its headline metric cannot fail** — a meaningful coincidence is a coincidence found meaningful. ⚑⚑ **The volume's Rāma does not support the perfection premise**, and the author's own reasoning document names *"Ram Relationship Distortion"* as a drawback of this very construct — then writes three more protocols past it

concepts.title: The Co-Evolution Synchrony Protocol
concepts.description: the mantra as catalyst in a loop between inner development and outer circumstance. 🚩 **The corpus's most intimate instrumental proposal**: unconditional service cultivated toward a **named person**, with that person's spiritual receptivity as an *expected* and tracked outcome — **service with a return, called unconditional in the same sentence.** ⚑ **One part survives whole: the environmental loop**, where the practitioner changes a space or a circle and the change supports the disposition — the only place they act rather than interpret. ⚠ **Everything else is equally well predicted by the practitioner's perception shifting while circumstance holds still**, and no observation the protocol proposes could distinguish them — **a method cannot detect mutual responsiveness using one of the two parties as its instrument**

concepts.title: The Consciousness Archaeology Protocol
concepts.description: the mantra as excavation tool, and **the one protocol whose central move the volume independently argues**: *"instead of creating Ram consciousness in your life, you discover Ram consciousness already present but hidden"* — essay 41's *jñāna-mudrā* reading in modern idiom. ⭐⭐ **Six excavation questions usable on any difficulty by anyone with no metaphysics attached** — what cosmic law is operating · what love is trying to express itself · what battle is this really about. ⚑ **Headed *"Mental Model #16"*, a sixth numbered model, and the generator's work is visible in the output.** ⚠ **Every dig strikes something, which is generation rather than excavation** — allowing a layer to return empty is the one change that would fix it, and the author's own historiographic method already requires evidence that resists him

concepts.title: The Reality Debugging Protocol and the Eight Sankats
concepts.description: one of two documents in the folder whose subject is a **traditional text**, and it behaves differently in every direction. ⭐ **A real eight-part roster** — *vyādhi · śoka · bhaya · krodha · dāridrya · apamāna · śatru · vighna* — **circumstances rather than interior states, needing no introspection to apply, and strictly more usable than the corpus's own invented five.** **The received method recorded before alteration** (Tuesdays, red cloth, 7/21/108 by urgency) **and the attribution correctly hedged.** ⭐⭐ **Its monthly metric is the series' strongest: *"types of problems that no longer occur"* — an outcome measured by absence.** ⚠ **Two textual claims flagged for a check not yet run**: whether *aṣṭa-sankat* names eight difficulties or eight verses, and whether two of the three analysed verses are Chālīsā lines

concepts.title: The Chalisa as a Forty-Verse Journey
concepts.description: the forty verses read as a staged journey peaking at 35 with **a descent**, verses 36–40 as *"return and integration."* ⭐ **A structural claim about the composition that could be argued with**, and the only claim in the cluster settleable by reading a text rather than by introspection. ⚑⚑ **It applies the corpus's best formal device to scripture** — *"Traditional Understanding"* printed above every reinterpretation, so the reader sees what was swapped `[n=2]`. ⭐⭐ **And its precautions name the gap this build has recorded for four phases, in the corpus's own voice**: *"traditional guru-disciple relationships provided this, but modern practitioners may lack adequate mentorship."* ⚠ **A precaution rather than a condition** — and it teaches a thirty-second ego-dissolution in its opening minutes with none of the guards the corpus builds elsewhere

concepts.title: The Ṣoḍaśopacāra Work Session
concepts.description: six phases of temple worship transferred to a working session: intention as a bilateral contract, a quality invoked before the task, and the document's own closing disclosure that it never reached the text it cites

concepts.title: The Three Stages of Archetypal Embodiment
concepts.description: four technologies across three years, relationship to identification to neither; the mudrās track the stances exactly, and the highest stage carries the corpus's one binding external-party gate

concepts.title: Mundane Excellence Without Devotion
concepts.description: the single document proposing that systematic excellence may reach Hanumanic consciousness without bhakti, filed not as a claim but as a dated decision point with three options and the null included

concepts.title: The Eight Aṣṭavarga Powers as Cultivable Capacities
concepts.description: the fullest roster and glosses anywhere in either stratum, five techniques covering all eight, and a misattribution that resolves into a transmission loss with a named commentator behind it

concepts.title: Competency-Based Advancement
concepts.description: the corpus's own argument that time-based curricula are the wrong instrument, written inside a corpus holding twelve mutually incompatible calendars and never routed to any of them

concepts.title: The Three-Tier Integration Architecture
concepts.description: a seven-day coverage rotation, four situation-keyed combinations producing four named capacities, and three diagnostics; the one document that schedules practice against the diary rather than the calendar

concepts.title: The Nyāsa Archetypal Rotation
concepts.description: four weeks of ritual body-placement across Rāma, Hanumān, Sītā and the council; the seven qualities laid at seven sites, and two placements that carry an argument the document never states

concepts.title: The Five Prāṇas Mapped to Hanumān's Acts
concepts.description: each vāyu paired to an act instantiating its classical function, apāna to the celibacy and samāna to the swallowed sun; the corpus's best construction and its worst attribution record, in one document

concepts.title: The Rāmāyaṇa Pathworking System
concepts.description: the seven kāṇḍas as consciousness laboratories, three written and four not; the ocean obstacles read as a kindness to decline, a test to pass and a pattern to destroy

concepts.title: The Solar-Devotional Cultivation Architecture
concepts.description: a twelve-month sādhanā in three phases, sharing its title with a document it has no practice in common with, and containing the corpus's one genuine experiment

concepts.title: The Three Transformation Rituals
concepts.description: rites for commitment, failure and completion, each with an irreversible act at its centre; the cleanest document in the practice cluster and the only one making no provenance claim at all

concepts.title: Parallel Path Development
concepts.description: overlay a second intention on an existing sequence rather than adding a second sequence; a general method stated once, for one pairing, and never generalised

concepts.title: Bhakti as the Ground of Bodhicitta
concepts.description: love of an unbounded object inherits its object's scope, so existing devotion is routed outward rather than new compassion manufactured

concepts.title: The Threefold Interpretation Framework
concepts.description: ādhyātmika, ādhibhautika and ādhidaivika applied to Hanumān and mapped to the three tracks; the tradition's instrument for holding incompatible readings, never turned on the corpus's own

concepts.title: The Three Energetic Foundations
concepts.description: bhakti-śakti, buddhi-śakti and vīrya-śakti as the corpus's account of what makes each track more than a productivity discipline; and three tracks running to five, five and eight tiers, with the longest changing what it measures

concepts.title: The Trinity Council Method
concepts.description: the decision set outside the practitioner as a crystalline object and consulted from three fixed positions with three fixed questions; a strong decision procedure and an unresolved encounter

concepts.title: The Dual-Lens Method
concepts.description: traditional foundations stated first and labelled, radical reinterpretations second and labelled; the corpus writing the build's own description-before-assessment rule as a structure, in its first iteration, and never carrying it forward

concepts.title: Multi-Scale Dharmic Navigation
concepts.description: three time scales fired simultaneously with three dosages, from three seconds to a lifetime; and the one document that grades itself, which is evidence about the corpus's production rather than about the framework

title: Phase 9b — Aṅka, *Devotees, Legends & Worship* (25 essays listed, 24 read in full, 1 excluded by standing ruling; saturated at Pass 6). 2026-08-18. **Completes the volume at 122 of 123 essays.**

concepts.title: Read, Understand and Do
concepts.description: ⭐⭐⭐ **the volume's testimonial column, and the reframing of phase 9a's largest finding.** Two instalments, **thirteen accounts**, named contributors, dated 1959/1922/1965, placed at Siyarwa, Laksar, Chitrakoot, Jaipur, with the British Resident and an Agent to the Governor-General named — **and a witness-boundary volunteered** in the one case where a crowd would have helped (*"only by the family and a few bystanders close enough to see it happen"*). ⚑ **So the extension corpus's missing evidence base is not missing because it is hard: the tradition has a standing genre for exactly this, ran it as a recurring column, and the corpus read that volume.** ⚠ Sits pages away from a frank miracle-legend with no marker separating the registers

concepts.title: The Aside That Undoes the Argument
concepts.description: ⭐⭐ Revāprasād Dvivedī builds the volume's only **commentary-anchored** siddhi demonstration — sūtra numbers, Vyāsa, Vācaspati — then concedes in a parenthesis that ***"raw yogic siddhi and moral direction are two entirely separate questions"***, Rāvaṇa being a genuine yogi. ⚑ **Which voids what the demonstration was for**, and the prenatal-attainment reading voids it again from the other side: capacities held from birth are not achievements. ⚠ The sun-leap case study shows the commentaries pulling the sūtra *away* from the episode — the method's rigour is what exposes it

concepts.title: The Practice Recorded in Hours
concepts.description: ⭐⭐ **the only complete *sādhanā* record in either stratum.** Sixteen years at gurukul, then **ten hours a day of japa for eleven years**, in an essay that stops mid-count to insist *sādhanā* is **not a bargain struck for a fixed return** — and licenses practice *"however forced that devotion may need to be at first."* ⚑ The reward turns out to be **permission to watch Hanuman do what he was always doing.** ⚠ Hagiography: no date, no witness, no locator — **the volume's most detailed practice record is in its least checkable genre**

concepts.title: Every Opponent Converts
concepts.description: ⭐⭐ **the post-*Rāmāyaṇa* Aśvamedha career the build had never recorded.** Four opponents on the horse's route: **three convert and the defeat itself is the delivery mechanism**; the demon is simply destroyed. ⚑ He **fights Śiva, wins, and spends an unlimited boon on corpse-security** — with no contributor reconciling that against the Rudrāṃśa identification. ⚑ And a **second willing capture with no payoff at all**: bound because the *astra* was Rāma's own weapon. ⚠ The pattern is prior orientation, not persuasion; recorded as this page's reading

concepts.title: The One Who Cannot Say the Polite Thing
concepts.description: ⭐⭐ Krishna stages a whole episode — feigned illness, a summons across yugas, a queen costumed as Sītā — to obtain **one sentence from the one being incapable of the polite lie**, then discloses his authorship **privately, to the target only.** ⚑ The same literalism that produced the sindoor custom produces a queen in tears, and the volume never connects them. ⚠ **Devotional fiction, stated as such** — evidence about a 1975 portrait, never about events

concepts.title: False Stages, and the Footnote That Says So
concepts.description: Bodri disclaims his own six-hundred-page apparatus in a footnote, calls the stages false, and names the three jobs they actually do: rest stops, verifications, motivational assists

concepts.title: The Five General Stages of the Spiritual Path
concepts.description: accumulation, preparation, seeing, cultivating, no more learning; forty stages before the first that counts, and the reclassification of nearly all world practice into the first two

concepts.title: Buddhism as a Comparative Reference Grid
concepts.description: Buddhism as the best measuring instrument rather than the best religion; a good criterion for comparing traditions, and the circularity the criterion cannot fix

concepts.title: Identical Metaphor, Different Attainment
concepts.description: two traditions, one image, different states; why shared vocabulary is the weakest evidence of shared experience, and how a tradition's terms outlive their referents

concepts.title: Translation, Not Refutation
concepts.description: six symbolic systems decoded into one scheme; the practice survives the decoding, the mystique does not

concepts.title: The Unproduced Is the Test
concepts.description: cultivate and it's there, don't cultivate and it's still there; the criterion that disqualifies every state the book grades, including its own

concepts.title: One Process, Described Many Ways
concepts.description: five measuring schemes welded at named joints; the map gets finer exactly where it gets less checkable, and two schemes rank the same attainment several stages apart

concepts.title: The Withholding Pattern, and Why He Publishes Anyway
concepts.description: six things named and declined, two distinct reasons for silence, and the observation that what gets withheld is disproportionately what would have been checkable

concepts.title: Vocabulary Chosen by What It Prevents
concepts.description: four terminology preferences argued on effect rather than accuracy; a coarser model chosen because it is coarser, and precision paid for in attachment

concepts.title: The Book That Warns Against Its Own Genre
concepts.description: a catalogue of recorded results, in a book arguing that readers turn recorded results into methods; the wager stated with its price attached

concepts.title: The Four Prayoga Sub-Stages
concepts.description: warming, peak, patience, highest worldly attainment; a run-up whose completion is not an arrival, and the correction of an attribution the vault had carried at second hand

concepts.title: Yeshe Tsogyel's Eight Austerities as Stage Two
concepts.description: a year of generated heat on a glacier filed under preparation, and the guru's rebuke that says the same from inside the tradition: too repressed and too fervent

concepts.title: No Samādhi Without Chi-Mai Work
concepts.description: nāḍī, mai, meridian and acupuncture channel collapsed into one referent; the four dhyānas and formless absorptions relocated into physiology; every chakra open and the Tao still unseen. ⚑ Contradicts footnote 518's *never think I said this was necessary*, in the same book, both in the imperative

concepts.title: The Atiśa Loop
concepts.description: merit is defined as wisdom and wisdom as accumulated merit, printed as a definition; samādhi requires prior merit and merit requires samādhi. ⚑ **The exit is in his own quoted material**: ten of Sonam Rinchen's eleven ways of serving others need no higher perception at all, and a second exit relocates merit into single mind-moments

concepts.title: Samādhi Is the Only Real Discipline
concepts.description: rules as an imitation of a state; Gorakṣanātha's Ṣaḍaṅga Yoga dropping *yama* and *niyama*; religions as armies who must dig ditches to keep the soldiers busy. ⚑ Reads as a loosening and is a tightening: transgression redefined as *any selfish stirring* makes a perfect thirty-year record a continuous violation. Stated three times in three registers — discipline, faith, worship `[n=3]`

concepts.title: What a Guru Is Actually For
concepts.description: the role narrowed to fast error-detection and nothing else; four sources across three traditions on the impossibility of vicarious awakening; and an argument that runs theodicy backwards — *if any being could save you, compassion means they already would have*. ⚑ Grace-of-the-guru survives as a **demonstration unit**: rare, exhibitory, a taste

concepts.title: You Cannot Elect a Saint
concepts.description: *it's laughable that some council can claim they elect someone into being a saint*; attainment is a fact and facts do not take votes. ⚑ **The Church's own devil's advocate got there first**: Lambertini, later Benedict XIV, concluded that extrasensory knowledge is not intrinsically related to sanctity — *"fools, idiots, melancholy persons, and brute beasts"* have it too, and the canonisations continued. ⚠ He is not against ranking; he supplies the nine-samādhi ruler and uses it on named figures at a distance of centuries

concepts.title: Verification and Its Broken Chain
concepts.description: *if the master himself is mistaken, what's the use of his testifying?* The chain terminates nowhere and degrades silently, with everyone acting in good faith. ⚑ **The fallback and the failure are the same procedure**: self-validation is offered as what the path is about, and Hakuin — self-validating — concluded nobody in history had gone deeper. ⚑ The cold-water checklist is withdrawn in the sentence after it is written. ⚠ Verification gated on prior acceptance `[n=4]`

concepts.title: The Source Mirror's Ten Questions
concepts.description: the closest thing in the book to an actual test, from Yen-shou via Nan Huai-Chin. ⚑ **Not one of the ten asks what you have experienced** — they ask what has not lapsed, what cannot move you, and what you can meet *without becoming afraid*, which independently corroborates the unproduced test from a tenth-century source. ⚠ The definitive criterion is in an untranslated book and the decisive physical sign is withheld *because people would use it to cheat* — a forfeit, not a move

concepts.title: Teachings Shaped by Political Power
concepts.description: *separate such factors of influence from the pure and true teachings*, with no method supplied beyond one membership test. ⚑ **The same acts are corruption at p 580 and *an excellent example of skillful means* at p 641** — the only thing separating the filings is a judgement about the shaper's purpose, which the surviving text never contains. ⚑ Two accounts of the same loss, unreconciled: suppression by interested parties, and congregations preferring the lecture about heaven

concepts.title: The Sheep and the Shepherds
concepts.description: 🚩 a page and a half quoted approvingly from Godman's Papaji record: five or six shepherds, beliefs as ownership brands, priests as barking dogs, the whole thing *a gigantic fraud*. ⚑ **Contradicted in the very next paragraph** — religious forms are *absolutely necessary*, use them, respect them. ⚑ And the quoted claim is direct-path immediacy, the position his entire apparatus exists to deny. ⚠ Wholesale dismissal of living traditions `[n=3]`

concepts.title: No Work, No Food
concepts.description: *if I do not work, I have no right to take my meal*: an argument about debt, not virtue, filed by Bodri as bodhisattva **norm-establishment** rather than as monastic economics. ⚑ **The only structural remedy in the cluster** — self-supply removes the surface patron-capture acts on, and kept working for centuries after anyone remembered why. ⚠ *Only* Zen surviving the confiscation, and surviving *because* of the rule, are two strong causal claims with no citation at all

concepts.title: Samādhi States Are Images of Emptiness
concepts.description: stated four times across the book `[n=4]`: the states are *constructions of thought*, purer than ordinary mind and ontologically still pollution. ⚑ **The knowing-criterion is the one test in the build that needs no certifier** — if there was a registration of the emptiness, the arrangement contained two things. ⚑ *Understood and experienced, but not had.* ⚠ A 0-1 affair, in a book of fifty-three graded stations

concepts.title: Superpowers Are Not Evidence
concepts.description: demons hold some of the same powers as the Buddha; powers follow **body structure**, and an accident or illness can produce them. ⚑ **The real measure is undemonstrable in principle, so a community converges on the demonstrable one** — which is why the error is universal rather than local and why information cannot correct it. ⚠ The *Śūraṅgama* reportedly files the four dhyānas and formless absorptions as *outside paths*, uncited

concepts.title: Powers Are Earned by Mirrored Ethical Acts
concepts.description: Nāgārjuna via Loden: lamps buy the divine eye, drums the divine ear, protected minds the knowledge of minds. ⚑ **Five entries mirror and the sixth — knowing that all things have no entityness — cannot be bought at all**, so the verse itself sorts the clairvoyances from the extinguishment. ⚠ Three incompatible accounts of powers in one book (equipment, merit, uncovering); the demon case falsifies two

concepts.title: The Yogi and the Stick
concepts.description: ⭐ the build's best worked example. Levitation and multilocation tested, seven languages checked, food materialised — **and one door in the universe that will not open.** ⚑ A guru who said *I don't have this knowledge and I have never met anyone who has*; a Kumbh Mela search where every yogi asked to be taught the powers instead. ⚑ The stick goes in the river and nothing works — glossed as impermanence, demonstrating **attribution-dependence**. ⚠ Ends with a look that transmits realisation, in a book arguing transmission is impossible

concepts.title: Psychic Abilities as Occipital Chi Pressure
concepts.description: chi impinging on the jade pillow; *esoteric biophysics*; abilities arriving equally from past lives, meditation, **or an accident or illness**. ⚑ The accuracy signature is the finding: *correct, at least in small things* and *will not work on big events at all* — the profile of an associative engine, not of access. ⚠ Anatomical vocabulary without anatomical support

concepts.title: Semblance Dharmas
concepts.description: artificial attainments that *look almost exactly the same* and can only be held by force. ⚑ **The mechanism is having a description of the destination**: the old schools escaped it by making *no prior assumptions about what the end points looked like*, which means the better a tradition documents its attainments the better the forgeries it manufactures. ⚠ Only someone telling you can distinguish it — in a book that has already shown the teller cannot be verified

concepts.title: Du-Yin and the Psi Programmes
concepts.description: the solitary consciousness: image-generation that runs *without the first five consciousnesses*, filing dreams, insanity, incoherence, meditation, ESP, instinct and **inspiration** as one organ. ⚑ Dream yoga's screening criterion excludes the already-dreamy — the people most drawn to it. 🚩 **The one external corroboration is sourced entirely to Art Bell's *The Source*, an excluded source**; the recurrence is recorded, the claim is not filed

concepts.title: This Is Not Sainthood
concepts.description: six states from the *Śūraṅgama*'s "Warning to Cultivation Practitioners," each with the same refrain. ⚑ **The names are diagnoses**: *the effect of excessive repression*, *remote visions of the overworked mind taking flight*. ⚑ The value is conditional on the interpretation — *if you do not confuse this with sainthood, it is an excellent level of achievement*. ⚠ Yogananda's cosmic consciousness relocated by two bracketed glosses that are Bodri's and unmarked

concepts.title: The Hundred Twenty Errors of False Cults
concepts.description: Yung-ming via Cleary, plus the *Śūraṅgama*'s fifty *for people of high attainment*. ⚑ **Almost every entry is a legitimate method held wrongly**, and four fold back on themselves — *some cling to the nonclinging mind, learning imitation insight*. ⚑ The list's author is the *Source Mirror*'s author under his other name, which Bodri never connects: one diagnostician, a negative instrument and a positive one

concepts.title: The Census of Thirty, and Science Has No Subjects
concepts.description: every master on earth in one room: two or three at the fourth dhyāna, sixteen to eighteen at the first, **about thirty in total**, most unknown by preference. ⚑ The sampling objection is genuinely sound and is pointed only at negative findings. ⚠ **Granular to the individual with no method stated** — and by its own arithmetic every publicly available teacher is outside the thirty

concepts.title: The Pathologizing of Mysticism
concepts.description: Mohammed, Paul, Joan, Teresa, Joseph Smith, Swedenborg and Van Gogh diagnosed posthumously. ⚑ **Seizure and act of God are mirror errors delivering one verdict — nothing for you to do** — which makes the clinical reading and the devotional one functionally interchangeable. ⚠ He objects to diagnosing the dead from texts, then does it: the prophets' miracles were samādhi *and nothing else*. ⛔ **The DSM/APA claim is excluded — `[CONTESTED]`, citation is a bare edition reference to the edition that made the opposite change**

concepts.title: The Sexual Desire Test
concepts.description: the *Śūraṅgama* via Lu K'uan Yu: the difference between the worldly and the saintly *depends solely on the elimination or not of sexual desire* — the only single-variable criterion in the book. ⚑ **Cultivation arouses chi and so amplifies the barrier**, which means the test gets harder as you progress and the monitoring it demands is itself the ironic process. ⚑ Four absorptions sit below the first dhyāna, including *samādhi that is similar to samādhi*. 🚩 Sourced twice to Napoleon Hill's *Think and Grow Rich*; ⚠ gendered claim reported and not adopted

concepts.title: Jada Samādhi and the Biofeedback Problem
concepts.description: buried alive for months: a state *without conscious open awareness, like deep sleep*, purifying nothing, filed with the acrobat and the ice-skater. ⚑ **Ordinary people with a biofeedback machine reach the same category** — so instrumentation destroyed the evidential value of a lifetime's physical attainment. ⚑ Forced against natural: retention is the means, unforced cessation is the attainment, and yoga has widely mistaken one for the other. ⚠ Form-based routes capped at the third dhyāna, asserted

concepts.title: Lu Ch'un-yang and the Sword That Turned Back
concepts.description: ⭐ the best worked example of gong-fu against prajñā. An immortal reads the mountain's energy from the air, lands, and **cannot see anything in the monk he came for**. *A ghost guarding a corpse* · *even if you can survive for eighty thousand eons, in the end you will fall into empty annihilation* · the flying sword turns and threatens its owner. ⚑ **The conversion is done by a question, not a display** — Huang-lung declines the cosmic half of Lu's line and asks how a grain of millet contains the world

concepts.title: Ranking the Attained
concepts.description: ⚑⚑ **the comprehension rule and its violation, three paragraphs apart.** Assessment runs downward only, and the failure from below is *confident false comprehension* — then a ten-point league table across five traditions, using as its worked example the very episode (Confucius on Lao Tzu) that illustrated the limit. **On his own rule the ceiling of a ranking is a statement about the ranker.** ⛔ The rank-assignments are `[DO NOT FILE]` and are not carried as claims about anyone

concepts.title: Anything Phenomenal Cannot Be the Tao
concepts.description: under the book's own heading *Mistaking the Marks of the Path as the End Result*. ⚑ **Identifiability is the disqualifier** — *if you can identify something as a phenomenal appearance, it certainly isn't the state of enlightenment* — which needs no teacher, no ladder and no judgement about depth. ⚑ A Zen test that measures **hesitation** and is therefore defeated by rehearsal. ⚠ Four causes offered for a light include a channel *opening* and a channel *obstructing*

concepts.title: Noticing Purity Is What Spoils It
concepts.description: ⚑⚑ **not the ordinary warning about pride.** The recognition *is* the spoiling, in the same moment; the pollutant is named as *a concept*, and the concept named is the tradition's own accurate one. **A property that cannot be predicated without being falsified** — so no first-person report of a clean mind can be true when made, and the whole testimonial literature describes states that had already ended. ⚠ The mirror is also named as an attainment reached after years of practice; how effort produces it is never addressed

concepts.title: The Oneness Experience Is a Form-Skandha Event
concepts.description: the modern West's commonest origin story for a spiritual life, filed at the **coarsest aggregate** as a report about the arrangement of material rather than about the perceiver. ⚑ **The load-bearing four words are *sometimes those who don't cultivate*** — a state that arrives without the practice cannot certify the practice. ⚠ Hua-yen's interpenetration doctrine is cited three times approvingly while the experience of it is demoted, and the two are never related. ⚑ The Buddha produces the same vision on demand with his toe

concepts.title: Dry Wisdom and Dead Tree Zen
concepts.description: *forced mental clarity (which is actually a type of stupor)*, arising from **mental holding rather than freedom**. ⚑⚑ **The aetiology selects for the diligent**: sensations arise *because the body is transforming*, the practitioner suppresses them as a distraction, and the clarity survives while the transformation stops. ⚑ **The crescendo instruction is the one falsifiable prediction in the build** — let them proliferate en masse, they reach a peak marking a stage, then die away

concepts.title: The Error of Naturalism
concepts.description: Mahāmudrā's three essentials quoted approvingly (*the essence of naturalness is to make no effort*) against the practice that reads them as permission to skip sitting. ⚑ Three subtractions: no concentration so no physical change, no distinction between ordinary mind and *prajñā*, cessation and contemplation bypassed. ⚑ Dahui was making the same complaint against silent-illumination Chan in the twelfth century. 🚩 *Japanese Zen practice today* dismissed in a subordinate clause — reported, not adopted

concepts.title: The Occipital Etiology of Visions and Voices
concepts.description: chi at the ear nāḍī and the occipital region. ⚑ **The mechanism supplies the event and the practitioner supplies the visitor** — *one who has deep religious beliefs may have illusions of hearing the voice of God or Buddha*. ⚑ **Thomas Keating reaches the same epistemic verdict from inside Christian contemplation** — *even saints have misunderstood*, filtered through psyche and cultural conditioning, *no guarantee* — though his ontology is incompatible and Bodri does not mark it

concepts.title: Breath Practice Manufactures the Boast
concepts.description: ⚑⚑ *boasting that he has achieved supreme truth* appears on a **symptom list**, between reciting strange poems and crying for no apparent cause, with random nostril-and-mouth breathing named as the cause and *unfit for spiritual training* as the verdict. ⚑ Two failure modes: the loud one announces itself; the quiet ones — tranquillity read as enlightenment, devotional feeling read as liberation — produce no signs at all. 🚩 Bhakti filed in a footnote beside hypnosis and starvation as a channel-jostling route

concepts.title: The Calm Place Is the Dangerous One
concepts.description: ⭐ the *Śūraṅgama* to Ānanda: the clarity is *like rapidly flowing water that appears to be still on the surface — due to its speed you cannot perceive the flow*. ⚑ **Proof from output**: *if this were not the source of thinking, then how could one be subject to false habits?* ⚑⚑ **Samādhi removes the particle aspect and leaves the wave** — so the deepest stillness deletes the only evidence the flow was running. A third kind of stillness, neither held nor built, that relaxation makes worse

concepts.title: No More Lotuses Came
concepts.description: ⭐⭐ T'ien-wang Wu rises from the river in a lotus, converts a military governor, and is **not yet enlightened**. ⚑ *Later on, after T'ien-wang Wu was enlightened, no more lotuses came* — **the signal was accurate and read exactly backwards**. ⚑ On his deathbed he cries nonstop and a monk asks him to be quieter because the monastery will be embarrassed; *these cries of pain are the one that is not in pain*; the disciple does not understand, *and that did it*. ⚑ Bodri declines the verdict and calls it a meditation case

concepts.title: The Avatar Mistake Runs Both Ways
concepts.description: ⚑ *if they can mistake such low levels for the higher, they can certainly mistake the higher for the lower* — the error is a property of the instrument, so every over-promotion in the record implies an unrecorded under-recognition. ⚑ **Arhat-grade practitioners with no powers at all, and Zen masters who withhold *because they know these things lead people astray*** — so the observable population is filtered against the top. ⚑ The teachable route is the one that stops short. ⚠ *Buddhism is the only one that focuses on prajna wisdom*, unargued

concepts.title: The Two Ways to Stall
concepts.description: you can purify the sixth and seventh consciousnesses and still miss the Host. Three reasons, two kinds: caught by what the practice **produces** (bliss, small powers), or caught by the **teaching itself**. ⚑⚑ *If someone attains enlightenment and then thinks, "I am different than you," this is being attached to the dharma* — **the only failure here that gets more likely the better you do, and has no external tell.** ⚑ Huai-jang polishes a tile: *how can cultivating dhyana make you into a Buddha?* ⚑ Rules exist *because you can't let everything go*

concepts.title: Flow States Are Not Samādhi
concepts.description: ⚑ **four unreconciled positions across three hundred pages**: athletes taste *shadow attainments*; misidentifying flow as samādhi is among the *catastrophes*; *in truth, they're seeking samadhi* without knowing it; and Csikszentmihalyi quoted approvingly at length with his own challenge-and-skill mechanism silently replaced by thought-quieting. 🚩 **Tolle quoted with a page reference and introduced in the body as *"one individual"*** — third instance of anonymous introduction for a contemporary teacher the book elsewhere criticises `[n=3]`

concepts.title: Cessation Tops Out at the First Dhyāna
concepts.description: the first dhyāna is *reachable through any type of cessation-contemplation practice*, and its bliss has two ordinary causes: kundalini warmth plus hormonal secretion. ⚑⚑ **Two operations, not one** — concentration builds each rung, release carries you between them, and *the actual problem is learning to let go of each state you cultivate*. ⚑ The faculty mapping: kōan grips **intent**, śamatha-vipaśyanā grips **discrimination and attention**, esoteric methods grip **contact and sensation** (*the ones most prone to errors*). ⚑ *If you don't cling, lower states will always depart and higher ones will always naturally appear*

concepts.title: The Esoteric Schools Run It Backwards
concepts.description: pacify the mind and the transformations follow naturally, *but in the esoteric schools many practitioners start from the opposite end*, forcing the manifestations in order to cultivate the mind. ⚑ *Taking their medicine incorrectly*: using the sixth consciousness to imagine the channels open guarantees it never settles. ⚑⚑ **A *reflexive process of mutual dependency* he names and then prescribes inside — third such loop in the build.** ⚑ The deity is incidental; one-pointed concentration is the mechanism, *the same effect achieved in bhakti yoga*. ⚑ The ladder as a **readout of what has stopped interfering**

concepts.title: Three Ways We Sabotage Ourselves
concepts.description: three faculties, all one's own, all working as designed. The sixth turns discrimination into habit into karma; the seventh overlays liking and disliking and **substantiates impressions with a further degree of false realism**; the "I"-thought is the root both rest on. ⚑ **Solidity is a residue of having reacted** — the things that feel most undeniably real are the ones you feel most strongly about. ⚑ *Forget likes and dislikes* is a **technical instruction with a target organ**, not moral advice, and survives transmission as the latter. ⚠ The seventh is active in infancy before the sixth comes online — so the self is not learned. 🚩 National-character illustration excluded; recurrence recorded

concepts.title: The Eightfold Path Is Not a Beginners' List
concepts.description: the poster version read as a portrait of stage four rather than instructions for stage one, with a six-layer dependency pyramid running down to *cultivate an interest*. ⚑ Behaviour sits at the base and the summit under one word, never disambiguated; and the Confucian twin is matched by a bracketed gloss he inserted

concepts.title: Sudden and Gradual Both Have Places
concepts.description: **three phases, not two**: you cultivate gradually to awaken suddenly, then cultivate gradually again. ⚑ The **base-rate argument** — if the trigger caused awakening, cheap universal triggers would produce it; they don't, so the trigger is the last thing in the room, not the cause. ⚑ Confucius and Tzu-lu's pheasant; the blind cat, the surfacing turtle, and **the worm's-hole sky** — the chance glimpse is *narrower*, not merely shorter. ⚑ **Hui-neng paid the physical bill after, Milarepa before** — the gradual phases are fungible but not compressible. ⚠ *The secret method is to just drop everything and you're there*, p 577, unreconciled against the preparation argument

concepts.title: The Double Cultivation of Nature and Life
concepts.description: *hsing* and *ming*; **the egg-shell you must preserve and then break**, and *without the body the Tao cannot be attained / but with the body Truth can never be realised*. ⚑ Body-only is *the worst but most common* error, named against Taoists, Esoteric adherents and yoga practitioners — **the practice meant to reduce body-identification increases attention to the body, and works better the more it succeeds**. ⚑ **The sign-reversal**: body work banks a clinging habit, mind work banks a releasing one. ⚠ Taoist couplets price both failures identically; Tsongkhapa's Ratnākaraśānti prices them unequally, and Bodri adopts the unequal ranking silently. 🚩 National-character and *countries they've invaded* illustrations excluded; recurrence recorded

concepts.title: Discard Until What Cannot Be Discarded Remains
concepts.description: ⭐ **the one portable tool in the book.** *All states that can be returned to external causes are obviously not you*, and the teacher's question — *that which cannot be returned anywhere, if it is not You, what is it?* A sorting rule, not a doctrine. ⚑ **The terminus and the commonest failure are phenomenologically identical** — "this cannot be discarded" is what a real residue feels like and what an unexamined attachment feels like. ⚑ The vacation as accidental evidence — and it demonstrates the *operation*, not the ontology. ⚑ Ch'ang Ch'ing wore out seven cushions **after** enlightenment

concepts.title: You Realize the Tao Once
concepts.description: a **threshold, not a magnitude**: no second seeing, and Tao-hsin's criterion — *when beginning learners see emptiness, this is seeing emptiness, not real emptiness*. ⚑ **And it secures nothing**: retrogression stays possible until the **eighth bhūmi**, seven stages past the door. ⚑ **Twelve names for one event** — the synonym lists manufacture the serial-awakening report by licensing one state to be counted repeatedly. ⚑ What happens once is a **cessation, not an acquisition**, which is the only reading on which singular + non-securing + nothing-produced are all true

concepts.title: Seeing the Tao Is the Sixth and Seventh Only
concepts.description: **two of eight faculties**; the first five and the ālaya untouched, so *you're not really, really empty at the Stage of Seeing the Tao*. ⚑ Three rungs inside the sixth alone, and most people are on the first. ⚑ **Wang Yang Ming mistook the host for the guest** — an error only a real attainment makes available. ⚑ The senses come last because they are the **cleanest** conduits, not the dirtiest. 🔴 **Hui-neng: the transmutations are *only changes of appellation and not a change of substance*** — quoted approvingly, three pages after a detailed causal sequencing of them, unremarked. 🚩 Tolle named in the footnote only (anonymous-teacher pattern, a fifth instance); Dalai Lama vacancy claim recurs, excluded

concepts.title: Cause Side and Effect Side
concepts.description: Hui-neng via Nan: sixth and seventh transform **at the level of cause** and are called *easy*; the first five and the eighth only **at the level of effect**. ⚑ Not harder — **unavailable**, which reframes the body schools as attempting an operation the system won't accept yet. ⚑ **Half a project costs a whole lifetime.** ⚑ T'ien-wang Wu enlightened and screaming on the floor, as the book's own worked example. ⚑ **The transformed half is invisible and the untransformed half is the only one anyone can check** — so authentic attainment is unverifiable from outside by construction. 🔴 p 250 — *cause and effect are not different, the beginning and end interpenetrate* — flatly contradicts the distinction and concedes it is conventional, which downgrades the verdict it certifies

concepts.title: The Legacy of the Waves
concepts.description: the wind stops and the water keeps moving; **you can be detached from a thought and still be carrying the seed that produces it**. ⚑ 🔴 **The conditional clause — *only if you refrain from providing them with any further energy* — is present at p 248 and absent from the p 574 restatement**, which is the version doing cross-tradition work. The image that travels has lost its instruction. ⚑ The metaphor breaks twice, both times toward reassurance: waves have no seeds, and waves decay unassisted. ⚑ *You can refrain from sexual activities, but that doesn't cut off sexual desires* — and desire is ranked **easier** than ego habit. ⚑ *Before enlightenment — chop wood and carry water*: the flattening is the whole observable content of the attainment

concepts.title: All That Matters Is That Your Eye Is Correct
concepts.description: Yang-shan, past the threshold and not at peace, asks for a method and **is refused**. ⚑ *If your realization of the Tao is wrong or incomplete, then no matter what you do in your practice it's all wrong* — practice quality is **gated** on the eye, not added to it. ⚑ **Cooking rice over a hot fire**: few principles, non-decomposable situations, therefore no manual — argued at page 573 of a manual. ⚑ 🔴 ***If you know the correct principles of practice, you can even invent new cultivation techniques yourself*** — the book's most permissive sentence, one page after condemning improvised chi work. ⚠ The same exchange is quoted **three times in three materially different wordings**, none with a locator

concepts.title: The Two Selflessnesses
concepts.description: you are not a thing, and **neither is anything else**; emptiness identified with dependent origination, so the two are one fact under two descriptions. ⚑ *Emptying the view of the body is a different feat than emptying the self* — **you cultivate the body to make the body droppable**, which is a far smaller claim than the form schools are read as making. ⚑ 🔴 **The Abrahamic summits — union with God, seeing God's face, the Hasidic dissolution — relocated to the first of two, and the Arhats who stop there called *one-sided and half-baked***. Applied consistently: no tradition's own summit is accepted as one. ⚑ 🔴 **The scheme is called two and the book prints three, twice, along two different cuts** — including inside the Forman passage cited to establish the two. 🚩 Three consecutive Forman citations on one spread; heavy instance of the standing dependency. ⚠ p 576 is in the flagged interleaving zone — Socrates split across the page break

concepts.title: Jing, Chi and Shen — The Three Essences
concepts.description: one substance at three grades; *Buddhism describes the path in terms of the mind, Confucianism in terms of behavior, Taoism in terms of phenomena*. ⚑ **Jing is defined broadly (the vital force in every living cell) and discussed narrowly (reproductive fluid) — and Bodri says why: the narrow sense is the *observable* one.** Everything downstream inherits the proxy. ⚑ Lao Tzu's infant erection — *to not know the intercourse of male and female and yet have an erection, this is the arising of jing* — establishes jing as prior to desire. ⚑ **Thirty names for chi across six continents**, offered as convergence; breadth is evidence only for a sharp referent, and *life energy* is not one. ⚑ 🔴 **The five-row correspondence table**: āyurveda is a real structural match, Christianity is lexical, the guṇas map a *mixture* model onto a *sequence* model, Vedānta is hedged mid-sentence — and the persuasive force is the row count. The identical-metaphor error, committed by the author who named it. ⚑ **Shen is nearest the goal and least discussed, because it is the rung with no technique attached.** 🚩 *mungo (African)* — one word for a continent inside a named-language list; referred to the `african-spirituality-sources` gate, not treated

concepts.title: The Three Fullness Signs
concepts.description: jing full → no sex; chi full → no eating; shen full → no sleep. ⚑ **Every sign is an absence, which is the scheme's real strength** — you cannot manufacture not-wanting without the manufacture showing as effort. ⚑ The **second triad runs the diagnostic backwards**: no physical bliss without full jing, no internal light without accumulated chi, no no-thought without condensed shen — which gates the three states practitioners most want to report. ⚑ 🔴 **The confound, named in one sentence and never solved**: *cultivators who do not feel like eating much… are actually sick or just weak rather than advanced.* Fullness and depletion present identically, and the error runs both ways — attainment is also mistaken for illness. ⚑ Buddha and Milarepa both ran the false positive to its end and had to eat their way back. ⚠ **Bodri's bracketed gloss sits *inside* the Tao-school symptom quotation**, downgrading the language and relocating the stage in the source's voice

concepts.title: How Each Essence Is Lost
concepts.description: three exits: jing through sex, chi through **hard breathing and exercise** (fn 70: the back of the neck and the limb joints — hence the towel over the knees), shen through **the rectum, excessive thinking, or eye-strain**. ⚑ **The escalation**: sensitivity to loss *and* the cost of loss both rise with attainment, so the discipline gets stricter the further you go. ⚑ 🔴 **The rules are codified from a perception their recipients are said to lack** — *ordinary individuals cannot recognize any of this at all because their bodies are so insensitive* — which makes them useful exactly in the window where they cannot be justified, and is also the structure that protects a wrong rule forever. ⚑ The **seven-emotion chi table** (anger rises, fear descends, grief dissipates, surprise scatters) — phenomenologically apt in a way that is hard to arrange by accident. 🚩 **The meditation-outcomes list (57% PMS, 75% of insomniacs *cured*, 36% less pain treatment) is sourced to one page of a 2001 popular trade paperback. REPLICATION RISK · SECONDARY WITHOUT PRIMARY.** 🚩 The ancient-kings-and-concubines mortality claim: no source, no figures, no confounds

concepts.title: The No-Leakage Principle Across Traditions
concepts.description: ⭐ *discipline* (Buddhism), *no-leakage* (Taoism), *celibacy* (Christianity), *brahmacharya* (Hinduism). ⚑ 🔴 **The rule has two halves — retention *and* mental emptiness — and all four names designate only the first. The half that survived transmission is the half an institution can audit.** ⚑ *Forced celibacy without emptiness is useless*, and shows in the *dried up, joyless, wrinkled* faces of monks and nuns. ⚑ **The barrier scales with success**: cultivation raises chi, which raises desire — so a rule whose difficulty rises with compliance cannot be met by resolve. ⚑ Hīnayāna's first rule is lust, Mahāyāna's is killing — **the ordering is a doctrinal fingerprint**, and it shows the rule is about the substance, not the act. ⚑ Monasticism read as a **supply solution** rather than as piety — against p 43's *you don't have to enter into a monastery*. ⚠ Evidence stack (Muktananda's bank, Napoleon Hill's 25,000 men, the *Pradīpikā*) argues for the half he calls worthless alone. ⚠ *Hatharatnavali* attributed in body, *Haṭha Yoga Pradīpikā* in footnote

concepts.title: Vajrolī and the Energy-Stealing Schools
concepts.description: the graded protocol ending in **a bladder of mercury held three hours**; Bodri prints it and warns of the toxicity in the next sentence. Reported as what the source records, hazard stated, **never as practice**. ⚑ **Four independent objections** — technical (you couldn't transform it into chi anyway), economic (*better to just go for a hormone shot*), merit (theft destroys the precondition), empirical (*the history of the Tao school is littered with the bodies*). ⚑ ⭐ **The turbid-jing argument is the best of them and it is structural: the extractable form of the resource is the degraded form.** Pure jing is in every cell and cannot be moved; only the spent form can. ⚑ *Would not be the Tao if it involved a secret technique* — a general disqualifier that fires before ethics. ⚑ *No Buddha, Bodhisattva or real master would ever try to suck energy from another person, **even if it was offered*** — consent does not touch the objection, and he never argues for that. ⚠ **Body attributes the protocol to Svoboda's *Aghora*, footnote to White's *The Alchemical Body* — second body/footnote mismatch in the chapter.** ⚠ Śiva Saṃhitā and the *Pradīpikā* indicted on p 129 and the *actual teachings of yoga* exculpated on p 130

concepts.title: Hsi and the Cessation of Breath
concepts.description: the junction between two breaths. ⚑ **Three traditions point at a boundary rather than a state** — Patañjali's gap, the Buddha's *life is just between the inhalation and exhalation*, the *Tantrāloka*'s *worshipped at the point of the meeting of day and night*. A junction is unimpressive and therefore unlikely to be invented for effect. ⚑ ⭐ **kumbhaka against *kevala kumbhaka***, and the reclassification it licenses: *you're only really practicing prāṇāyāma when you reach this stage of natural respiratory cessation* — **the discipline is named after its destination and universally practised as its road.** ⚑ 🔴 **The kundalini demotion: *what people usually identify as "kundalini" is just the frictional phenomenon* of chi scouring an unclean channel.** Which inverts the sign — the dramatic event measures *obstruction*, and the real initiation presents as nothing happening. ⚑ *You don't need to practice these exercises* — mental resting opens the channels too — against *the only reason you practice forceful retention*, on facing pages. ⚠ **Third and fourth body/footnote attribution mismatches: Patañjali's prāṇāyāma definition and the *Gheraṇḍa Saṃhitā* line both footnoted to the Bihar School *Haṭha Yoga Pradīpikā*.** The pattern is now `[n=4]`: body names the famous text, footnote names the compendium actually open

concepts.title: Women's Cultivation Gong-Fu
concepts.description: **"killing the dragon," "regaining one's virginity," "returning to the stage of a maiden"** — three names for the cessation of menstruation, which gates the hundred days for women. ⚑ **A three-way branch by sex and age** (pre-pubertal: seven days; menstruating: kill the dragon first; post-menopausal: restore the cycle, *then* stop it — because depletion and fullness present identically). ⚑ 🔴 **Two pages earlier: *they happen to everybody… no matter whether they are male or female*.** Neither claim qualified against the other. ⚑ ⭐ **The best clinical hedge in the book** — nutritional deficiency, excessive stress, serious illness and xenoestrogen exposure named and explicitly excluded as look-alikes for *stemming the red tide*. ⚑ fn 86 admits *very few cultivation books discuss the details of women's gong-fu* and offloads to one 1992 translation volume. 🚩 **`[DO NOT FILE]` the menarche-and-psi claim (fn 85, *China's Super Psychics*) — excluded purity-confers-psi category; reported, not used**

concepts.title: Physical Immortality as Taoism's Distinctive Claim
concepts.description: the **one aspect unique amongst these schools**: physical lives can last forever, generated internally from one body's own yin and yang. ⚑ **Two immortalities, and only the first is Taoism's own** — bodily renewal is distinctive; the projection body is *a nondenominational result*. ⚑ 🔴 *Cannot help you avoid cyclical existence* — real, unique, and **the lowest-ranked thing on the grid**, which is a strange result for an instrument claiming neutrality. ⚑ ⭐ **Ceiling-becomes-doctrine, with no dishonest step**: a teacher transmits the furthest point reached, the point delivers real results, results confirm the teaching, the cap propagates *hundreds of years*. ⚑ *Swapping one hat for another is still wearing a hat.* ⚑ **The same capability ranks with the devas or with the Buddhas depending only on what else is present.** 🚩 McDougall's soul-weighing recurs as support; excluded, nothing built on it

concepts.title: The Channels Are Nervous Systems
concepts.description: ⭐⭐ **the single most deflationary passage in the book**, quoted approvingly from Nan: *the governor channel is the function of the spinal nervous system, the conception channel is the function of the autonomic nervous system, jing is the endocrine functions of the kidney glands and reproductive organ, and the spiritual saliva is the endocrine functions of the pituitary and lymph glands.* **Is the function of** — not *corresponds to*. ⚑ *Not any mysterious secret of orthodox alchemy and immortality*; *they have nothing to do with the Tao*. ⚑ 🔴 **Flatly contradicts p 97**, where the channels run *just as there are countless nerves* — a separate system with independent scientific verification claimed. ⚑ **Deployed against rival schools in the errors chapter and withheld from the two chapters that teach the same anatomy** — a claim used rather than held. ⚑ Decoded, the microcosmic orbit reads as an autonomic-endocrine cascade tracked by attention alone. ⚑ Every sign is a report on **remaining blockage**, so intensity runs inverse to progress. ⚠ Source is a **Top Shape Publishing** volume — Bodri's own publisher

concepts.title: Bliss Is Endocrine
concepts.description: *the body's hormonal system is responsible for producing the physical bliss*; *jing and chi and shen transformations are the actual biophysical causes*. ⚑ ⭐ **Milarepa's three diagnoses in a row** — five-element winds, side-channels entering the centre, *the increase of bindu in the Great Bliss chakra* — each mechanically specific, each closed with **it is neither good nor bad**. A fine-grained causal vocabulary and a completely flat evaluative one. ⚑ 🔴 **The four empties and four joys are *nothing else than a separate delineation of the characteristics of the four dhyāna***, and the uniqueness claim is *a bit of propaganda put forward by the school to help keep the transmissions alive* — an absence argument (*where did Buddha ever say*) delivered in a confident register. ⚑ And two paragraphs later he defends the same school on compassion grounds: **skilful means and a marketing claim look identical from outside.** ⚑ Emptiness causes bliss, not the reverse

concepts.title: Three Flowers and the Literalism Hazard
concepts.description: *return the jing to renew the brain* read as a **procedure** by insiders in three traditions, who *actually try to suck things into their heads*. ⚑ ⭐ **The poison argument**: were the jing actually to reach the brain in physical form *it would be poisonous* — a one-line refutation that works by taking success seriously. ⚑ **The vocabulary fails in both directions**: descriptions read as instructions and executed; technical reports read as literature and admired. **An encoding fails not by being unbreakable but by being accidentally readable.** ⚑ *The cultivation path is one of emptiness and non-effort all the way, but people want to do something.* ⚑ **The colour test** — seeing white or red bodhicitta means the jing is *not yet transformed*, because transformed bodhicitta is clear. ⚠ *Cūḍāmaṇi Upaniṣad* footnoted to the Bihar School *Pradīpikā*; Chuang Tzu displaced from its introducing sentence and sourced to a Sufi anthology

concepts.title: The Rider and the Horse
concepts.description: **minds are cripples with sight, winds are blind men with legs, and the lame climb on the backs of the blind.** ⚑ ⭐ ***The scattering of ordinary mind is caused by chi*** — distraction as a physical variable in the wrong state, not a failure of resolve; which is the book's only real *mechanism* for why breath practice aids concentration. ⚑ **The loop runs both ways** (*winds lack specific direction without minds*), so the mind-first and body-first schools are two entry points into one circuit and the dispute is only about where to start. ⚑ *The mind — the king — mounted on the horse of vitality: when the horse is held, the king is held.* ⚑ 🔴 He presents the model and then warns that Esoteric explanations *can mislead you quite a bit* — *originally my mind was clear but I was blinded by the teacher*. ⚑ Four words carry the whole hedge: *at least for the conventional level*. ⚠ Five secondary sources, one unattributed; nothing primary

concepts.title: Bindus Are the Indian Jing
concepts.description: *bindus*, *bodhicitta* and *bodhimind substances* all refer to jing; the Indian additions are **location** (brow, heart, navel) and the **white/red partition**. ⚑ 🚩 **The transmission claim — the Indian schools *included the Taoist findings* — is unsourced, undated, contrary to the ordinary chronology, and contradicts Bodri's own explanation that such agreements come from independent observation of one body.** Recorded, not used. ⚑ *Bodhicitta* names a **vow** in one literature and a **fluid** in another, unmarked — the form/formless problem at its worst. ⚑ ⭐ **Why the scheme could not be dropped: a medical structure was built on it, and the users are people who never cultivated.** A framework held by conviction dies with its believers; a framework held by its dependencies has no cohort whose death would release it. *It had lost its early usefulness* and stayed

concepts.title: The Yin Shih Tsu Record
concepts.description: ⭐ **the build's third annotated first-person case study, previously unlogged.** A layman who took up chih-kuan for his health; ten years on the lower belly, then a shift to the *central spot* and six months of counted involuntary circuits. ⚑ **The form is the evidence**: thirty-six times left then thirty-six right, *the same number of turns each way*, sites visited in order — a man taking inventory, not describing ecstasy. ⚑ ⭐ ***Thus for the first time I understood the inter-relation of the eight psychic channels and the nervous systems, and realized there was nothing fictitious and unaccountable in it all*** — **the deflationary identification reached from inside the experience, and received as a relief.** ⚑ It **terminated** after six months, *probably because all the psychic channels had by then opened*. ⚠ Via Lu K'uan Yu's *Secrets of Chinese Meditation*; the bracketed glosses inside the quotation are the translator's

concepts.title: Experiences Vary by Sex, Age and Health
concepts.description: content varies, **class does not**. ⚑ **Stated twice with different variable lists** — p 184 names practice, age, sex, health, merit, past lives and *degree of effort*; p 589 drops effort and adds *education* and *wisdom*, making variation more a matter of what you arrived with. Unmarked revision. ⚑ 🔴 **No negative case is ever given** — nothing is named that would fall outside the class, so the invariance half cannot fail and therefore cannot support the cross-tradition filing it licenses. ⚑ It quietly resolves the p 121/p 123 sex contradiction (transformations invariant, experiences and routes variable) — a resolution Bodri never states — **and the resolution runs out where a gating prerequisite is involved.** ⚠ Two near-exhaustive symptom catalogues agreeing is guaranteed by breadth, not earned

concepts.title: Latent Illness and the Paradox of Easy Colds
concepts.description: ⭐ *when you actually examine people who claim they're very healthy because they never get colds… **these are really the individuals to worry about***; a body *so dirty that any external wind invasion could never penetrate*. ⚑ Meditators catch **more** colds — the protective layer of filth is gone — and the Zen countermeasure against the Indian one is **a jumper**, on the grounds that diverting chi spends the thing the attainment is for. ⚑ **The early phase is an expenditure, not a plateau**: all initial spiritual energy goes into cleaning the body. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **The double hedge at p 192 is the most careful passage in the book** — susceptibility neither confirms nor negates, and neither medicine nor cultivation may override the other — spoiled three sentences later by *I guarantee that modern physicians do not understand cultivation physiology*. 🚩 The cancer claim carries no evidence

concepts.title: Cultivators Become Hypersensitive
concepts.description: **every item on the inventory is a cost**: more colds, drafts, other people's illness, other people's smell, earthquakes at three hundred miles. ⚑ **One mechanism, four surfaces** — the screen comes off; nothing is added. ⚑ ⭐ 🔴 **The adept's solitude given a *sensory* explanation in one subordinate clause** — *although of course there are other reasons for preferring solitude as well* — which competes with the tradition's renunciatory account and predicts the opposite timing. ⚑ Teaching reframed as *a sacrifice to bear such suffering*. ⚑ **Perceiving more and liking people less**: the compassion the path claims as its fruit is nowhere in this passage. 🚩 Two excluded categories here — national trademark odours, and an unsourced sexualised claim about young women; `[DO NOT FILE]`, recurrence recorded

concepts.title: The Tibetan Five-Factor Disease Etiology
concepts.description: a full causal anatomy of illness: latent basis, karma as cause, disturbing emotions as circumstance, **conceptual thinking as the connecting link**, prāṇa-wind as assembler, gods and demons as support. ⚠ **Announced as five factors and enumerating six.** ⚑ The five-poison grid (desire→coldness, anger→heat, stupidity→phlegm, envy→aching, pride→swelling) with matching winds and spirit classes — ⭐ **a taxonomy generated by crossing lists the doctrine already had, with the 404 figure giving it away.** ⚑ The connecting link is quoted as an internal monologue — *I am sick! I am disabled! What shall I do if it gets worse?* — the one element that reads as observed. ⚑ *Abandon the notion of a demon* treats the fifth factor by disbelieving it. ⚠ **The top-tier instruction *don't even take one single dose of medicine* is reported, never as practice — and Bodri calls the whole passage *however imperfect* and says masters use herbs and medicines.** 🚩 *Meditation… can never hurt you* is an absolute inconsistent with his own material

concepts.title: Gampopa's Episodes
concepts.description: ⭐⭐ **the only place in six hundred pages where a transmission is shown operating rather than described.** Fifteen printed consultations; each returns a *cause* and one small adjustment, never a meaning. ⚑ Two of the fifteen are diagnosed as **equipment and effort** rather than anatomy. ⚑ **The corrections shrink as the experiences grow** — from five-element winds to *loosen your belt* to *practise more gently* — which is the single-piece feedback rule working, not an unimpressive teacher. ⚑ *You need not tell me of your visions. I already know them* — the reporting was the student learning to report. ⚑ Bodri ranks Gampopa above Yin Shih Tsu and U.G., **both below the first dhyāna**, on central-channel involvement. ⚑ 🔴 *That's why spiritual schools commonly require a master to certify your attainments, **but if the master himself is mistaken, what's the use of his testifying?*** — demonstration and demolition in one paragraph. ⚠ Quotation elided; fifteen printed, inventory names eighteen

concepts.title: It Is Neither Good Nor Bad
concepts.description: the refrain, verifiable **at least nine times**, attached to nine different mechanisms. ⚑ ⭐ **It has a boundary**: it runs through the chi-mai episodes and **stops** when the phenomena become kāya-class, at which point Milarepa delivers a positional judgement instead. A phrase with a domain of application is a policy, not a habit. ⚑ *Keep on meditating, **without hope or fear*** — both directions refused, because a phenomenon graded *bad* steers the practice as surely as one graded *good*. ⚑ **What is given instead**: praise for effort, a new technique after nearly every consultation, and precise corrections. *The austerity is only tolerable because everything else is generous.* ⚑ **A teacher who grades experiences manufactures a student who needs grading.** ⚠ The refrain's wording is Stewart's English; its consistency may be a translator's regularisation

concepts.title: The Meditation Belt
concepts.description: ⭐⭐ **the Vajra Black Line Hell, heart congestion and *intense depression*, diagnosed as a strap tied too short.** *Loosen your belt and keep meditating.* ⚑ **Maximum content, minimum cause** — and the prescription is sized to the cause, not to how frightening the thing was. ⚑ The depression is the item nobody quotes and the only one carrying a real duty of care; **the account never reports whether it lifted.** ⚑ 🔴 **Second belt episode: Gampopa loosens the strap himself, the roaring stops — and Milarepa's diagnosis does not mention the belt.** A clean student intervention overridden by the framework. ⚑ **The deflationary diagnosis is downstream of the esoteric anatomy, not opposed to it** — a purely mentalist model has no route from *hell vision* to *check the strap*. ⚑ The counterfactual that matters: graded as a good sign, he tightens the belt

concepts.title: Who Should Not Practice Dream Yoga
