concepts.description: ⭐ **contraindications the school itself omits**: chi mai in good condition *particularly the stomach and intestines*, and *practitioners should not be "dreamy," absentminded or "spacey" individuals to begin with*. ⚑ **The du-yin is the faculty of dreams, inspiration and instinct — and of insanity and incoherence.** The practice cultivates the substrate insanity runs on. ⚑ **The population most drawn to it is the population excluded** — *artists, religious people and writers* have a more active du-yin. ⚑ The screening variable is self-assessed by the faculty being assessed. ⚑ 🔴 **He faults the school for omitting the qualifications and two paragraphs later discards its elaborate protocol as unnecessary** — offering a breath technique that works the same night, with no instructor and therefore no gate. ⚑ He publishes because lucid-dreaming courses already teach it without the warnings. 🚩 **Three excluded categories on these two pages**: Art Bell as a source, psychics' IQ and eye-sheen, purity-confers-psi

concepts.title: Dream Control as a Diagnostic
concepts.description: ⭐ **dream control is the test, not the goal**: *if he can master the Four Voids of Sleep, he can be assured of recognizing the Four Voids at the time of death.* **Sleep is the only rehearsal available for the one event that cannot be rehearsed** — nightly, free, low-stakes, repeatable, and permanently uncalibrated. ⚑ *Death is just your sixth consciousness moving to a new place, and there is a moment when it collapses so that you can see the Tao* — **the threshold happens to everybody; the qualification for noticing does not.** ⚑ **The one externally testable claim in the whole zone**: an experienced practitioner reading a dying person's chi mai and estimating time to death. Nobody appears to have kept the record. ⚑ *No dreaming* as the marker of breaking through the conception skandha — and ⭐ 🔴 **Chuang Tzu's confound, quoted by Bodri as corroboration: *there are two types of people who don't dream: the enlightened and the very stupid.*** He has filed his own counter-evidence as support

concepts.title: The Cultivation Timetable
concepts.description: ⭐ **the Tao school *determined the time requirements***: a hundred days for jing→chi, **seven days for a child**, six hundred days in six milestoned increments for the full rejuvenation sequence. ⚑ **The justification is entirely physical** — *just as the time it takes to bring water to a boil follows certain laws of physics* — which is why every number attaches to a bodily transformation and none to insight: **you can schedule the vehicle and you cannot schedule the mind.** ⚑ ⭐ **A schedule is a countermeasure, not a description.** The numbers are round, memorable and milestoned because a commitment device has to be recallable under strain; Thailand's compulsory three months is the same device at civilisational scale. ⚑ 🔴 The six-hundred-day sequence predicts **white hair reverting and teeth regrowing** and Bodri endorses only *much healthier* — a hedge that leaves the strongest claim unowned. ⚠ Via **Lu K'uan Yu, *Taoist Yoga* p 19** and **Rieker's *Yoga of Light***, not primary Tao-school texts

concepts.title: The Sweet Nectar Research Programme
concepts.description: ⭐⭐ **the only falsifiable claim in the book that costs nothing to test**: a sweet pituitary secretion at *ching-an* that *can be objectively tasted by any third party who kisses you.* ⚑ **Third-party test, reversible dose-response** (*it will appear when you cultivate intensely, but if you stop… it will also disappear*), **a named negative control** (*don't jump to the conclusion that this substance is an endorphin*), and a taste-variation model keyed to the five *tattwas*. ⚑ ⭐ **The best-constructed claim in the book is the one nobody ran** — same author who sources telepathy to a radio host; the difference is not competence but whether he is describing or reaching for support. ⚑ **Ubiquity is evidence of lowness**: soma, ambrosia, amrita, grail wine and seven others named as one substance — a phenomenon everybody reports is thereby *early*, not central. 🔴 No source given for any of the eight identifications, and the Samson-in-Judges reading is Bodri's own. ⚑ Carries the *wai-dan*/*nei-dan* two-medicines frame, where **your own jing, chi and shen** outrank every external remedy

concepts.title: Reading Attainment Off the Body
concepts.description: ⭐⭐ ***Read that again*** — the author's own emphasis on the claim that physical transformation is necessary and sufficient evidence of spiritual rank, with ***there is no other explanation, and there is no denying this fact.*** ⚑ 🔴 **Reversed eleven lines later on the same page**: the form-based schools that emphasise physical yardsticks — *yoga, Esoteric Buddhism, Taoism* **and modern science**, filed together — have *a tougher time achieving great spiritual illumination.* ⚑ **A diagnostic returning one verdict for every failure is relabelling the failure, not diagnosing it** — and the variation rule that would have rescued it was available and unused. ⚑ ⭐ **The real yardsticks are behavioural**: *emptiness attainments, prajna, and virtuous behavior* — the only test here with a public referent, given four sentences. ⚑ The five-element ladder **announced as five and catalogued as four** (fire removed by the author's own note), with a first-transformation clock of *one year* against p 121's hundred days, unreconciled. ⚑ ⭐ **U.G. Krishnamurti, quoted at length, telling him not to print it**: *there is no point in leaving any record — people will only simulate these things* — and the *legitimize the path* wager that publishes anyway, cost named. ⚠ The iconographic swellings are the **editor's bracketed parenthesis** reporting what *his friends observed*, not the practitioner's testimony

concepts.title: Ching-An, the Precursor State
concepts.description: ⭐ **the one state singled out from every gong-fu phenomenon in the book**: *lightness and peace*, a cool draught *similar to a cool breeze or draft*, and the feeling that *the bones have dissolved away.* ⚑ **Two doors and the lower one is better** — foot-born beats head-born for stability; the Confucian *feeling of Spring*, the Christian *washing of the feet* and Mercury's wings all annexed to it, **none of the four sourced.** ⚑ ⭐⭐ **The habituation account, via Nan Huai-Chin**: the lightness weakens but *this does not mean that it actually fades away* — *very much like eating new food for the first time.* **The state holds; the instrument drifts.** ⚑ 🔴 **Two fadings, one sensation, opposite remedies, no discriminating test** — and the prescription offered (*live alone in a quiet place*) treats the less likely one. ⚑ ⭐ **The capability gate**: *a person can detach himself from worldly desires only by progressing to this point* — every renunciation instruction below this asks for an output before the machine that makes it exists. ⚑ 🔴 ***You can easily cultivate it to prove its existence for yourself*** followed immediately by ***so few cultivate that they rarely achieve these states*** — falsifiable in principle, permanently unfalsified in practice, both supplied on one page. ⚠ Tsong Khapa named and unfootnoted, then set aside for the volume actually quoted; the Wright/Edison appeal rests entirely on one popular book

concepts.title: Never Guide the Chi
concepts.description: ⭐⭐ ***You really should never try to mentally lead the flow of chi*** — and the pre-emptive refusal of the only defence: *it doesn't matter that many people and even cultivation schools make this mistake, for it's a mistake nonetheless.* ⚑ **fan-chi**: what you feel when you push is internal wind, *just a form of playing with your body consciousness*; **the stated criterion is breath cessation**, and everything below it is disqualified. ⚑ ⭐ **The best argument in the chapter is an analogy** — *you cannot properly guide your blood flow or lymph circulations either*: whatever you feel yourself directing is by that fact not the thing you meant to direct. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **A dated history of the error**: Song-dynasty masters' journals of what happened to them read by later students as specifications — *they tried to take some specific form results of the path into the causative process of the path itself.* **The records of outcomes became the method**, and the loop has confirming feedback. ⚑ ⭐ ***Lao Tzu's original method of cultivation is quite unlike the later Tao school practices*** of tan-tien concentration and chi mai work — the founder's principle filtered out by the school's own transmission machinery. ⚑ **The accessibility test**: *if Tao is supposed to be within everyone's grasp, who's supposed to transmit this sort of knowledge to everyone?* ⚑ 🔴 The chapter ranks chi/chakra/channel/kundalini cultivators at the **first two of five Mahayana stages** — a demotion of most of the book's own subject matter. ⚠ *Trust me! Count on it!* does the work a citation does elsewhere; the Mencius parable carries **Bodri's own gloss inside the quotation marks**; national-character and living-tradition dismissals recur here (recorded, not carried)

concepts.title: The Four Signs and the Four Emptinesses
concepts.description: ⭐ **mirage, smoke, fireflies, butter lamp** — four visions in fixed order as the chi enters the central channel, each fainter and less structured than the last. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **The same four arrive when you die** — identical sequence, identical elemental logic, printed fourteen pages apart — **which is the entire warrant for treating sleep and dream practice as rehearsal for death.** ⚑ Then the four emptinesses via Tsong Khapa: moonlight, sunrise, **utter darkness in which *the person has a sensation of swooning and loses consciousness***, and the clear light. 🔴 **A rung of the ladder is a blackout**, and nothing distinguishes it from a faint from the inside. ⚑ **The sky images borrow a day's vocabulary without its order** — moonlight, sunrise, deep night, dawn — smoothing over the one place the sequence actually breaks. ⚑ **Seven stages say *contemplate that this is empty*; the eighth says *remain*** — the apparatus is a sequence of things you decline, ending in the one you don't. ⚑ 🔴 **Two anatomies printed as one**: the firefly sign at the *throat* knot in the death list and at the *navel* in the meditation exposition, from two different intermediaries, unreconciled. ⚑ ⭐ **Rated low by its own author** — *one more, albeit purely technical means for rating your progress at a certain lower level* — which is fn 518's position stated in the body text, and which quietly undercuts the death claim it is attached to. ⚠ Tsong Khapa via **Mullin's *Readings on the Six Yogas of Naropa*** and the death sequence via **Kunsang's *Advice from the Lotus Born***; Chuang Tzu uncited

concepts.title: The Five-Element Purification Sequence
concepts.description: earth as bone and hair, water as blood and hormones, fire as heat, wind as breath and growth, space as the gaps. ⚑ ⭐ **Not a ranking but a dependency graph**: *fire cannot exist without air*, and *how do you clear the mai… by cultivating the chi* — **one intervention moves three elements**, which is why every tradition on earth starts beginners on the breath. ⚑ **Wind goes first *because it's the easiest of the five elements to transform*** — the one item that is both automatic and voluntary. ⚑ 🔴 **Announce five, print six**: the underwriting *Śālistamba Sūtra* passage lists earth, water, heat, wind, space **and consciousness**, quoted whole and unremarked — third instance of the count mismatch `[n=3]`. ⚑ 🔴 **Staircase against spiral**: year-counts at p 165 against *it's not like you purify them once and you're done* at p 179, unreconciled. ⚑ **Wind-as-wood and space-as-metal** join a constituent list to a relational cycle, with the space/metal identification argued from resemblance (*both metal and space are very strong*). ⚠ Egyptian four-element material via **Plutarch's *Moralia*** — a Greek reading of Egypt used to grade Egypt as having *failed to emphasize* space; credit: Bodri prints the Kemetic forms alongside the Greek

concepts.title: True Kundalini Is Warm, Not Fierce
concepts.description: ⭐⭐ ***a soft comfortable feeling like Springtime. It isn't hot and fierce, but warm and soft because the body is healthy.*** ⚑ ⭐ **Two kundalinis under one name**: the famous burning is *the friction felt when the yang chi is still cleaning the chi mai* — **yin kundalini**, and *properly speaking, this isn't kundalini at all*, but *a manifestation of friction akin to the arising of an internal infection*. The real thing is the *yang aspect, which is rarely discussed*. ⚑ Motoyama's levitation, terror and day-long headache filed **as an example of the friction, not of the attainment.** ⚑ 🔴 **Demoted to the warming phase** — *doesn't even reach to the Stage of Seeing the Path* — with behaviour reinstalled as the real rank, for the third time in one book. ⚑ ⭐ **The correction cannot win**: the quiet version leaves no testimony, so the literature is entirely friction, and a base-rate claim has no instances to fight with. ⚠ Osiris read as a spine-and-channel account through Bodri's own brackets, no source for the myth; Kalahari Kung healing dance called *a very crude form of forced chi circulation* with *num* glossed as *[the raw kundalini energy]* — Katz's Harvard ethnography deserves better than the adjective

concepts.title: The Extreme of Yin Gives Birth to Yang
concepts.description: ⭐⭐⭐ **the causal spine of the entire book**: *any state of yin at its extreme always gives birth to a state of yang.* Pull it out and the corpus doesn't lose a chapter, it loses its mechanism — no-effort becomes quietism, the ban on guiding the chi becomes an assertion, and the phenomenology chapters lose their ordering. ⚑ 🔴 **Stated symmetrically at p 354** — *just as the extreme of yang will give rise to yin* — **and used in one direction only.** The unused half is exactly where a theory of decline, burnout or state-loss would live, and there isn't one. ⚑ ⭐ 🔴 **No threshold, no timetable, and *extreme* defined by whether yang followed** — so every barren stretch is evidence of insufficient stillness, permanently. This is where the *no other explanation* machinery is manufactured. ⚑ Demonstrated by a lake, a cosmogony, Hubble photographs of spiral galaxies and *hun tun* — four scales, nothing excluded. ⚠ Schauberger's lake via **Callum Coats's translation**, one afternoon, one man, small alternative press, **with Bodri's gloss inserted inside the quotation** — fifth clear instance of bracketed interpolation `[n≥5]`. ⚠ ***Top Shape Publishing self-citation, second recorded instance*** — the *hun tun* passage from Nan Huai-Chin's *Story of Chinese Taoism*, Bodri's own publisher

concepts.title: Chi Flames on the Shoulders of the Virtuous
concepts.description: invisible flames at the shoulders and crown of the *extremely virtuous*, *which ordinary people cannot see*. ⚑ ⭐ **The chain rescues the folk saying by dissolving it**: emptiness produces chi progress *and* fewer evil thoughts, so **virtue and the flames are two effects of one cause**, not cause and effect — a better explanation than the saying, offered as a defence of it. ⚑ 🔴 **Two definitions of virtue in one book**: external and public where physical signs are being demoted, internal and mental where one is being explained. ⚑ *Wisdom horns* as **outlets for pushing dirty chi out of the body**, evidenced by statues of Moses, Yamantaka and Chinese *dragon bones*. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **The evidence is entirely artwork** — Pentecost, Balinese costume, sculpture, iconographic type; not one is a report of an experience, and **Bodri calls the Balinese ornaments *decorative* in the sentence that recruits them as witnesses.** ⚑ 🔴 ***It's a waste of time for scholars to try and catalogue all this material. Only people with cultivation accomplishments can… sort through and organize*** it — the clearest single instance of verification-gated-on-prior-acceptance, stated inside a catalogue. ⚠ Footnote 148 reads in full *See the various translations available of the Yellow Emperor's Classic of Internal Medicine*; and an unsourced claim that meditation expels cancer-causing jing-chi *through the feet, fingers or eyelids* — recorded, not carried

concepts.title: The Central Channel Across Traditions
concepts.description: ⭐ **eleven names for one tube** before you leave two languages: *avadhūti*, *suṣumṇā*, *brahma nāḍī*, *saṃvitta nāḍī*, *madhya nāḍī*, *śūnya padavī*, *brahmarandhra*, *mahā patha*, *śmaśāna* (cremation ground), *śāmbhavī*, *madhya mārga*, *zhong mai* — **four of them are claims rather than descriptions.** ⚑ Generation Stage = everything leading to the chi entering the channel; Completion Stage = everything after. **One anatomical event is the hinge of the whole curriculum.** ⚑ ⭐⭐ ***The Tantric path specifically excerpts this one special fact out of the path entire, and highlights it to the extreme*** — producing practitioners who emphasise *discrete and minute aspects of cultivation biophysics that naturally occur whether or not you pay them any attention.* **Granularity named as a hazard, inside a catalogue.** ⚑ The Zen shortcut (*if your sixth mind settles then the central channel will open naturally*) and the honest reason it loses: *so simple that people don't want to believe in it.* ⚑ 🔴 ***Nagarjuna had to create a pathway for these unfortunates***… *you can easily trick these people*… *the wool is being pulled over their head* — recurrence of the wholesale-dismissal shape; the negative-curriculum claim underneath is kept, the sneer is not

concepts.title: Samādhi Only When the Chi Is in the Central Channel
concepts.description: ⭐⭐⭐ **the sentence the entire comparative project rests on**: *samadhi can only occur when the chi enters the central channel… whenever you're experiencing samadhi, your chi is in the central channel.* ⚑ 🔴 **A biconditional with no independent access to either term** — samādhi is assessed by report, channel occupancy by the signs, which are also reported. **One evidence stream read twice.** It is a definition presented as a law, and its real function is translation between three technical vocabularies. ⚑ ⭐ **But it makes a prediction nobody has checked**: if samādhi entails channel entry and channel entry produces the four dissolution signs, then samādhi reports from channel-less traditions should carry mirage, smoke, fireflies and lamp. The literature is in print. ⚑ **Containment, not sensation, is the marker** — *ecstasy may be experienced… by those who have not meditated in this way… but this does not necessarily mean that the flow will be contained.* ⚑ ***Opening the central channel is not a unique cultivation attainment*** — the ruler is proprietary, the event is everyone's. ⚑ 🔴 ***The true Tantric path… is Zen*** — a tradition's name transferred to its rival, stated once and never defended. ⚑ Padmasambhava enlisted against the practice from inside the school

concepts.title: The Three Channels and Four Chakras, Specified
concepts.description: avadhūti *four fingerwidths below the navel*, rasanā right, lalanā left, *like pillars supporting the four chakras*; navel 64 petals, heart 8, throat 16, crown 32, with shapes, syllables, colours and directions. ⚑ ⭐⭐⭐ **The parenthesis that reclassifies the whole thing**: ***(One visualizes the channels in this way for the purpose of meditation. But in fact) the channels continue on down*** — the curve is drawn *in order to draw the vital energies into the central channel*. **It is an instrument, and the manual says so.** ⚑ Consistent with that: *no certain, fixed size*; the central channel bluish before inner heat and sesame-flame during it; petals *only roughly described… but this is enough*. ⚑ ⭐ **A stopping rule with a named risk** — *if still no progress is forthcoming, prolonged application can incur dangerous obstacles* — which is rare in this literature and to the tradition's credit. ⚑ 🔴 **The design note is the first thing lost**: rival teachers had already misread the diagram as a map *within the lineage*, which is Tsong Khapa's whole correction. ⚠ Via **Mullin's *Tsongkhapa's Six Yogas of Naropa* pp 139–164**, a 26-page block quote with Bodri's brackets throughout; and the page carries a **seventh body/footnote mismatch** — body cites the *Netra Tantra*, footnote 560 gives Kṣemarāja's *Pratyabhijñāhṛdayam*

concepts.title: The Four Descending and Ascending Blisses
concepts.description: melt the bodhicitta, move it, hold it at four stations: crown *bliss*, throat *supreme*, heart *special*, navel *innate*. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **The names belong to the order, not the places** — Bodri's own ascending gloss reverses every assignment (navel *bliss* … head *innate*). **The four blisses are a count, not a map.** ⚑ **Containment is the achievement and bliss is what it feels like**; *karmamudrā* is only *a conducive condition*. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **Tsong Khapa complaining that his own tradition's manuals omit the safety information** — dosage, timing and *how to avoid incurring physical illness* are *not discussed with sufficient clarity* — the negative-curriculum pattern testified from inside. ⚑ **The ecstasy does not carry over by itself**: *stamp all objects and events… with the seal of this ecstasy and emptiness*, likewise missing from some oral traditions. ⚑ ⭐ **The four blisses are the four dhyāna renamed**, and Bodri's objection is that the method attends to sensation while the goal is detachment from it — **an objection his own imaginary-cognition argument (*just as yin can turn into yang*) would have answered, thirty pages earlier, unused.** ⚑ *Ambrosia if they work, and poison if they are taken incorrectly*

concepts.title: The Sixteen Steps of Full Awareness of Breathing
concepts.description: the ānāpāna list quoted in full: four body, four feeling, four mind, four dharmas. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **The last four have no verbs of doing.** The first twelve say calm, gladden, concentrate, liberate; steps 13–16 say only *observe*, ending at *observe letting go*. **The sequence ends by removing the doer** — the same terminal move as the four emptinesses' *contemplate ×7, remain ×1* `[n=2]`. ⚑ ⭐ **Non-forcing staged as a graduate skill, not offered as an insight** — you cannot put down what you were never holding, which dissolves the corpus's loudest apparent contradiction: **the no-effort claim is true of the destination and false of the route.** ⚑ ***The secret cultivation technique commonly found within the Esoteric schools is to cultivate your breath*** — the target is cessation, which is why the list needs no anatomy. ⚑ 🔴 *Shakyamuni Buddha… incorporated… the tantric techniques* — **an anachronism as stated**; the structural version was available and free. ⚠ The sūtra reaches the reader via **Thich Nhat Hanh's *Plum Village Chanting and Recitation Book*** — the most-quoted breathing instruction in Buddhism, arriving through a chanting pamphlet; and the observing-self material via **Deikman's *The Observing Self***

concepts.title: Three Elixir Fields Beat Seven Chakras
concepts.description: ⭐⭐ ***The three elixir fields are a superior means of instruction… because their usage tends to limit the possibilities of mental clinging and attachment.*** **Not more accurate — better teaching, because there is less to grab.** ⚑ ⭐ **The mechanism is the rider and the horse**: *wherever the mind is focused, the chi will gather at that point* — so every named location is a place attention can go and be rewarded, and **resolution sets the rate at which a map manufactures attachments.** ⚑ **Difficulty inverted**: *it's easy to experience the chakras, but to experience the elixir fields requires a little more advanced stage* — a point can be manufactured by attending, a boundary cannot. ⚑ *Even this is too many*; *countless masters became enlightened… without any teachings on chakras and chi mai at all*. ⚑ 🔴 *Believe it or not, these elixir fields correspond to the Realms of Desire, Form and Formlessness* — the page's only content-claim about the fields, delivered with no argument, in a book that twice warns against mechanical correspondence. ⚠ **Hopi four-chakra claim given with no citation**, recruited as corroboration — recurrence of the annex-as-evidence handling, not carried as fact

concepts.title: The Fifth Element Is Emptiness
concepts.description: ⭐ ***The most important of the four elements is actually the fifth element, which is emptiness*** — the others *all depend upon the emptiness element for their existence*. **A taxonomy that lists its own container among its contents.** ⚑ 🔴 ⭐⭐ **Two emptinesses, distinguished at p 176 and merged at p 564.** *Empty space doesn't have the same meaning as mental emptiness. Both have to be cultivated* — and then one sentence begins with the element and ends with the meditative state. **The book's central mind-to-body bridge is a word doing two jobs**, and the author had already marked the difference. ⚑ **The Śūraṅgama says *your four elements are out of harmony* where Tantra would say blocked channel** — the anatomy is optional, not fundamental. ⚑ ***All the various changes to the body described in Esoteric Buddhism are brought about through emptiness cultivation*** — the catalogues are inventories of what emptiness produces, mistaken for the method. ⚑ **This life is already a bardo** — *our current but transient human state of existence… the first type of "intermediate body"*, and *we're already fundamentally free from birth and death but we just cannot realize it.* ⚑ He closes the escape route himself: *since they're already saved, then just let everything be natural* is the failure mode, and *faith without wisdom just enhances ignorance.* ⚠ Medieval alchemy named and explicitly excluded from the comparative sweep

concepts.title: Yin Shen and Yang Shen
concepts.description: the invisible body *ordinary people cannot see* against *a projected physical body that people can see and touch*. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **The lower grade comes free with illness** — via Nan, yin shen projection *can happen to quite ordinary people who are not meditating… when one is ill, nearing death, or bordering on schizophrenia*. ⚑ ⭐ **So the criterion is provenance, not product**: identical reports, opposite verdicts, decided by causal history — which is coherent and **unobservable from outside**, leaving only the practitioner's own account, the very evidence the criterion was meant to escape. ⚑ **A hard gate with a stated mechanism**: *if you're not mentally healthy, there is no way your yin shen can ever transform into a yang shen*, because *an unhealthy mentality is a yin mentality*. ⚑ 🔴 ***The only thing that these projection experiences prove is that we all possess an inner body of chi*** — the careful claim — followed immediately by *cultivation science goes one step further*, which is the whole distance to a body others can touch. ⚑ ⚠ Foxes needing a human skull, dragons detectable by untransformed head channels, given unsourced and unhedged; *Tao and Longevity* cited here as 1991 and elsewhere as 1984

concepts.title: Three Distinct Transport Gong-Fu
concepts.description: ⭐ **three mechanisms produce one story**: dematerialisation and reassembly, yang shen emanation, and *space warping* that transports the real body *without moving it*. Bodri separates them so readers don't assume *the transporter principles featured in Star Trek movies*. ⚑ **The counterexample argument**: a body that can be disassembled has every channel open, and the person still lacks the Tao — *it only goes to prove that Tao has nothing to do with form phenomena!* ⚑ *Lots of dragons and asuras… also have this ability, so it isn't anything spiritually unique.* ⚑ ⭐⭐⭐ 🔴 **The twelve words that undo the book's method**: *much has to do with the location of the practice rather than the spiritual lineage or tradition* — dry, high-altitude conditions make this gong-fu easier, so **the tradition with the densest dematerialisation literature is the one practising where it is most available**, and the confound acts on the archive as well as the practitioners. He uses it for siting advice and never turns it on his own rankings. ⚑ Candraprabha's water-filled room, the boy's broken tile, and *is it not a sign of my backsliding?* — an ordinary cause read as a verdict. ⚠ *I have actually seen an example of this warping myself*, one clause, no circumstances

concepts.title: Thought-Born Body versus Yin Shen versus Illusory Body
concepts.description: ⭐ **the one-way entailment that sorts them**: *you can learn to emanate your yin shen without cultivating through the sensation skandha, but you cannot achieve the true thought-born body… unless you purify the sensation skandha.* **Yin shen is cheap; the illusory body is manufactured and disqualified for it; the thought-born body cannot be manufactured at all.** ⚑ The discriminating evidence is therefore never in the report of the journey — **it is whether clinging to sensation has actually gone**, which shows up in a cold room, not in a vision. ⚑ ⭐ **A taxonomy built to be refused**: three terms carefully distinguished and all three forbidden as goals, because its purpose is defensive — *you are being trained to recognise, not to seek*. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **The habit argument, which survives every metaphysical commitment**: *constant familiarity brings affection, and affection eventually brings love and attachment* — so **a body-centred method runs its dosage against its own goal**. ⚑ *You don't have to know the results of practice and bring them into the causal features of the path* — **third instance of that formulation `[n=3]`**, after p 204 and p 547, across three unrelated schools. ⚠ Ginseng and peyote achieving the yang body, unsourced

concepts.title: The Twelve Analogies of the Illusory Body
concepts.description: magician's phantom, moon in countless pools, shadow, mirage, dream body, echo, city of smell-eaters, hallucination, rainbow, lightning, **bubbles**, mirror image. ⚑ ⭐ **Not twelve ways of saying *unreal* — twelve partial models, one property each**, none covering another's. **A twelve-image list is a confession that nothing available is close enough.** ⚑ ⭐⭐ 🔴 **As printed, the commentary glosses eleven, silently drops the bubbles, and adds an unlisted image (*a fish leaping out of clear water*).** The dropped one is **the list's only image of ending**; the substitute is about **arising**. Provenance of the gap undeterminable from this text — stated at exactly that strength. ⚑ **The echo gets amended** for the *pure* illusory body, which is metaphor used as apparatus. ⚑ ⭐ *The only reason the Tibetan Esoteric school stresses the creation of an illusory body… is because the specific form of cultivation technology it employs makes particular use of this solidified thought creation* — **it is an artefact of one technique, not a universal stage**. ⚠ Via Sonam Rinchen's *Atisha's Lamp*; the alchemical *mystical union* reinterpreted by Bodri

concepts.title: The Substitute Empty Body
concepts.description: ⭐⭐ **the name is the argument**: *substitute* (it stands in), *empty* (it is no more real), *body* (and it is still one). Somebody built the caveat into the label so nobody could forget it — ***and people forget all the while.*** ⚑ ⭐ **A warning encoded in a name never gets read**, because a compound term is parsed once and used thereafter; **compression is an asset for what you want felt and a liability for what you want checked.** The only working remedy is a person reissuing it in prose every generation, which is what this page is. ⚑ *Sorry, but I have no better way to describe them* — **second of three admissions of descriptive failure in this cluster**. ⚑ **Ungraspable, not empty** — a term chosen because *empty* invites an attempt at annihilation that produces only fatigue and anxiety. ⚑ The fish-leaping image recurs here in Bodri's own voice, confirming it is live in the tradition. ⚠ *A particular school of Buddhism arose* — unnamed-targets pattern on a substantial historical claim; Forman dependency recurs

concepts.title: Moggallāna's Death
concepts.description: ⭐ **the Buddha refuses four monks and allows one, and the reason is latency**: the others *could not have attained with so rapid a response*. **The skill on display is switching speed, not power.** ⚑ ⭐⭐⭐ **Then brigands beat him and he uses none of it**: *he got dizzy and then lost consciousness… he lost the correct view in that he lost his samadhi, and therefore lost his superpowers.* **The powers are not possessions but rentals against a maintained state — so they are unavailable in exactly the conditions that destroy the state.** ⚑ ⭐ **He heals himself for seven days — to protect a city's faith, at the students' suggestion.** The last deployment of the canon's greatest power is the management of a congregation. ⚑ ***Superpowers could never go against the dharma of impermanence***, marked twice (a nun likewise could not save herself). ⚑ ⭐ **The pastoral gap**: he names masters offering *sweet words to ease your fears* and being cursed when the feared thing comes — **and supplies no conduct at the boundary he has just explained perfectly.** ⚑ 🔴 The four dhyāna are stage two of five: **the greatest wonder-worker in the canon, placed by his own tradition's arithmetic.** ⚠ Buddhaghosa via Ñāṇamoli, well located; the death narrative uncited, and **Subhūti named as the best friend where the Pāli sources give Sāriputta** `[CONTESTED]`

concepts.title: Asaṅga Carried Maitreya Through the City
concepts.description: twelve years on one object and *he never once received a vision*, then a complaint made to a buddha. ⚑ ⭐ ***He had been there all the time, but because of mental obstructions Asanga was never able to see him*** — twelve years of nothing reclassified from failure to occlusion, which is the reading most likely to keep somebody practising **and unfalsifiable**. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **The city test proves nothing and confirms everything**: nobody sees Maitreya, Asaṅga does, and **the only competent witness is the person whose competence was the question.** ⚑ ⭐ **The old woman sees a puppy and becomes extremely wealthy** — a partial percept, and **the benefit arrived with the interpretation entirely wrong**, which is a large doctrinal claim dropped in a subordinate clause. ⚑ **The test that matters**: does a tradition's restriction gate *acquisition* or *verification*? Gating acquisition is ordinary; gating verification leaves it functional inside, unfalsifiable outside, and **receiving no correcting signal at all**. ⚑ Pai Chang names the dharmakāya eleven ways — the second object in this corpus to attract eleven names. ⚠ The episode is given with no source whatever

concepts.title: Why Bodhisattvas Are Painted Beautiful
concepts.description: ⭐ ***The Absolute nature is impersonal, so a Bodhisattva still needs an appropriate medium to reveal himself*** — the Reward Body exists to solve an interface problem, and awakening is *just achieving one of these principles*, not the whole path. ⚑ ⭐⭐ 🔴 **The ornaments are disowned in the sentence that endorses the paintings**: *the true body of the Tao isn't ornamented with any ornamentation.* ⚑ ⭐ **So the beauty is a specification, not a depiction** — the images are one-pointed concentration objects (*since you concentrate on only one thought — the vision of a beautified body*), and **ornament is what makes a static object survive an hour of looking.** ⚑ ⭐ **Transfer objects owe fidelity; state objects owe only holding power** — and nothing in an object announces which it is, so **anything beautiful enough to hold attention is beautiful enough to reward interpretation**, which is how a lens specification accrues an exegetical literature. ⚑ *The Esoteric school says that it's composed of highly purified chi but this isn't correct* — followed by Bodri's own analogy withdrawn as *improper*: **third admission of descriptive failure in this cluster `[n=3]`.** ⚠ *This I have personally witnessed on many occasions*, one clause, no instance

concepts.title: The Five Skandhas as Experiential Barriers
concepts.description: ⭐ **five screens, not five components**: *five different types of experiential events that screen our true nature*, with the path as *detachment from, purification of, exhausting or breaking through* them — four verbs, all subtractive. ⚑ ⭐⭐⭐ **The corpus's most consequential filing decision**: *chi, chakras, mai and kundalini… all belong to the skandha of form!* and *all the transformations involving chi, chakras, kundalini and so forth only belong to the lowest skandha transformation on the spiritual path!* **Every demotion elsewhere in the book is downstream of this one placement.** ⚑ ⭐ **And the demotion follows from a definition, not an argument** — form is *appearance, resistance, extension*, chi has all three, and the scheme's **completeness claim** (*everything we can possibly experience in all of conventional reality*) leaves nowhere else it could go. **A taxonomy with a completeness claim is a verdict machine, not a description.** ⚑ The redundant listing of sense organs argued into *sentient matter*, *the interface between chi and consciousness* — 🔴 verification-gated (*any samadhi practitioner quickly discovers*). ⚑ Science-catching-up shape reaches `[n=4]`

concepts.title: The Sensation and Conception Skandhas
concepts.description: ⭐⭐ **the usable line**: *the object perceptions provided to us by our senses are components of the form skandha, but **the commentary we make upon them is part of the conception skandha***. Red is form; *too bright* is conception. **Recognition itself is already conception.** ⚑ ⭐ **Three screens, three border-pairs**: form bounded by *form and emptiness*, sensation by *contact and separation*, conception by *forgetting and remembering* — non-interchangeable, each naming its own screen's constitutive operation. ⚑ 🔴 **The strange gloss**: *it's impossible to truly forget something because forgetting isn't permanent or impermanent; **it's only a current moment of drowsiness*** — which makes the conception store permanent and leaves *purifying* it undefined. ⚑ **The chatter runs on attention**: *your fixated involvement upon this chatter which actually reinforces it with energy* — hence *without using force*. ⚑ **Volition defined by exclusion** (everything the other three miss, including *time and motion*) and consciousness demoted: *the highest secret of the Zen school is that our consciousness or awareness isn't the ultimate, fundamental "host." **It's still a "guest."*** ⚠ **Self-citation** — a Pingala Upaniṣad quotation sourced to Bodri's own *Twenty-Five Doors to Meditation*

concepts.title: The Volition Skandha and the Shimmering Mirage
concepts.description: a *wavering, pure but glittering haze that's endlessly whirling about*, and Chuang Tzu's ***wild horse*** for the same heat haze. ⚑ ⭐ ***Action that passes on its effects*** — the cleanest gloss on *saṃskāra* in the corpus. ⚑ **Habit energies as *a ceaseless subterranean stream that forever runs on and on***, with *limitless millions of divisions* — unenumerable by construction, which is why the remedy is settling rather than itemising. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **The one image in the book that forbids something**: a suspension clarifies only by being left alone, so going after defilements individually adds more motion than it removes. **That is what makes it an argument rather than a mnemonic** — and it gives a sorting rule for the whole metaphor-rich literature: ask what the image rules out. ⚑ The merit-only route priced at *three eons*, against *one life* combined with meditation — 🔴 the shorter figure given as *an actual truth, not a lie* with no derivation. ⚑ ⭐ *Even a child can say these things… **who can actually do them?*** — the apparatus is not for knowing what to do

concepts.title: U.G.'s Seven Days of Sense Transformation
concepts.description: ⭐⭐ **the most structured first-person account in the corpus**: one change a day for a week. Skin *soft like silk*, the slipping razor · the **declutched state** and the tomato-soup loop · smell and taste **decompounding** (*whether… the most expensive scent or… cow dung, it was the same irritation*) · *vistavision* and **blinking permanently over** · all sounds *originated inside me* · the body gone, leaving only *the points of contact* · and ⭐⭐⭐ day seven: ***I had discovered that all my senses were without any coordinating thing inside: the co-ordinator was missing.*** ⚑ **The order is the finding** — modalities first, body-image sixth, the integrator last, **discovered by its absence**. ⚑ ⭐ **Invisible-in-operation and knowable-only-through-failure are one property**, so every experiential literature is rich on contents and silent on the machinery assembling them. ⚠ **Two of Bodri's glosses printed inside the quotation** supplying chi mai and sixth consciousness, neither in U.G.'s account; and the account crosses three skandhas while being filed under one. 🔴 Reads as depersonalisation as readily as attainment

concepts.title: The Four Bhāgas — How Knowing Authenticates Itself
concepts.description: image (*nimittabhāga*), perception (*darśanabhāga*), **the knowing that perception occurred** (*svasaṃvittibhāga*), and the corroborator of that. ⚑ ⭐ **Every argument is by elimination, none by introspection** — without the image you would perceive *indiscriminately all objects*; without the perceiving part you would be *like space*. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **The third is posited to explain memory, not awareness**: *there would be no memory or recollection… just as there is no memory of images that have never been perceived.* A functional argument for a component of mind. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **The regress raised against itself and stopped by mutual objecthood** — three takes four as object, four takes three, both restricted to direct inference, so no fifth is needed. **Not a foundation; a closed loop.** ⚑ 🔴 **And that is corroboration without independence** — *their substance is not different*. Which is not an error: **self-knowledge has no possible outside**, so every corroborator is inside, and **the elaborateness of an introspective apparatus measures the difficulty, never the reliability.** ⚠ Well cited — Wei Tat's *Ch'eng Wei-Shih Lun*, printed twice in two translations

concepts.title: Zen Sickness
concepts.description: ⭐⭐ **the illness you catch by succeeding**, arriving *when one first arrives at this stage of realizing true emptiness*. Shao Shan to a named student: *if you can put a quick end to it, you will be able to become a Buddha. **If you cannot control it, you may lose your mind.*** ⚑ ⭐⭐⭐ **Han Shan's case at thirty-one**: asked for one poem, he writes twenty to thirty and cannot stop; everything he had ever read *appeared in front of me and crowded and filled space*; he names it ***the demon of literary habits***. **The content of the sickness is the practitioner's own training.** ⚑ ⭐⭐ **The cure is sleep** — five days, an external witness breaking the window, and a *ch'ing* struck by his ear *a few tens of times*: *'I do not know, and this is my first breath.'* ⚑ ⭐ **A spiritual emergency with a somatic remedy was never a spiritual emergency** — and the coercive traditions found the same lever pulled the other way. **Independent discovery under opposite intentions.** ⚑ 🔴 The marker of the attainment and the marker of the disorder are the same event. ⚠ *Or by drinking some wine* — no dose, no contraindication; recorded, not repeated as advice

concepts.title: Same Methods, Different Coatings
concepts.description: *one river with many feeder streams* · *many paths up the mountain, but we can see only one moon* · *the cows have many different colors, but the milk is the same*. ⭐⭐ **Three images, one structure — invariant core, variable surface, and the implicit claim that removing the surface loses nothing.** The load-bearing word is **coating**: something applied to a thing that already existed, which protects, obscures, and comes off. ⚑ ⭐ **The narrow thesis is much better than the imagery**: *different religions simply advocate different sets of spiritual exercises or routines for arriving at the same states*, with equivalence located in **practitioners at equal attainment**, not in traditions — *Christian priest, Jewish rabbi, Buddhist monk, Hindu yogi, Tibetan master, Sufi adept… when that happens these individuals are equivalent*. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **The benchmarking passage switches register into management consultancy** — *in terms of benchmarking, what is best from another school that we can borrow* · *how can we update our transmission* — and its last question is the generous one: **reveal whichever of these principles are already in our framework but have lost the light of day.** ⚑ 🔴 **The metaphor forecloses the only interesting question.** A coating cannot be constitutive, so the imagery cannot represent a difference that is load-bearing — e.g. the dhikr instruction's boundary where *to bring the mercy of God does not stand in his will or choice*, which has no obvious Eastern counterpart. ⚑ 🔴 **The Zen passage on the same spread refutes it**: not recording gong-fu phenomena is a design decision that produces both a higher realisation rate *and* a named characteristic failure (*purposeful ignorance is actually a fault*). **A decision with consequences on both sides of the ledger is not a coating.** ⚑ 🔴 **The sentence justifying the whole programme is unsupported**: *spiritual gong-fu is also the easiest thing to materialistically see and measure, and the easiest thing to reproduce* — in a book that denies reproducibility by sex, age, health, inheritance and **practice location**, and measures nothing. ⚑ 🔴 ⭐⭐ **FOURTH POSITION ON CATALOGUING, and all four are within fifteen pages**: p 186 the catalogue is the evidence · p 188 cataloguing is a waste of scholars' time · p 194 it must be done or the path goes extinct · **p 199 comparison frameworks are *a necessary job* against p 200 *to dwell on the task of understanding gong-fu is an intellectual's or scholar's trap that leads nowhere***. None retracted. ⚠ Ibn al-Arabi via **Karen Armstrong's *A History of God***, third citation to it. ⚠ Recorded, not carried: *when a country or race loses its greatness, it still clings to the past claims of its greatness*

concepts.title: The Witness Practices of Every Tradition
concepts.description: ⭐⭐⭐ **the strongest comparative argument in the book, and it gets a paragraph.** Nine named procedures: Kabbalah's *witness* of the Yesod · Tien-tai chih-kuan · early Greek introspection · yogic *antar mouna* · Gurdjieff's self-remembering · Augustine's recollection and introversion · Hīnayāna śamatha-vipaśyanā · **Freud's evenly-hovering attention** · **Deikman's Observing Self**. ⚑ **It compares *procedures*, not reports** — and a procedure can be handed to someone and watched, which no testimony can. Two of the nine come from outside any tradition with a stake. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **The two principles**: *chih* is stopping (cessation, samādhi); *kuan* is *looking into, watching, witnessing, or observing* (the embryonic basis of prajñā). **Mutually dependent** — *you can't look into the Real if it's being screened by all sorts of busyness* — with the Dalai Lama's warning that calm abiding alone *will only suppress the disturbing emotions… temporarily*. **Concentration suppresses; observation dismantles.** ⚑ 🔴 🚩 **CONSENSUS MISREPRESENTATION** — *even modern transpersonal psychology has discovered…* is evidenced by **Ken Wilber, *A Brief History of Everything*** (fn 400), one author's popular synthesis making the same comparative argument from the same materials. Same appeal again at p 425 with an eight-term list and no citation. ⚑ ⭐ **The research proposal is half right**: the sampling argument is legitimate — *if you only study ordinary practitioners rather than accomplished adepts, you'll never get to the true heart of the matter* — and the design **founders on *accomplished adept*, which has no framework-external criterion.** ⚑ 🔴 ***A little higher*** (attainment, unargued) and ***cleanest and clearest in terms of cultivation theory*** (the map, plausible) run together in one sentence. ⚠ Ninth bracketed interpolation: Hasidism's *wisdom comes into being out of nothingness [emptiness]*. ⚠ p 425 sits inside the **pp 424–427 three-author splice zone**

concepts.title: One Hundred Twenty-Five Thousand Practices, One Aim
concepts.description: Pārvatī asks Śiva how to transcend the ego: *There are 125,000 practices and all these practices ultimately withdraw the mind from the sense objects.* ⭐⭐ **The number is not the content.** It means *past counting*; the claim is the clause after it, and the claim is **restrictive** — not *same state* (unfalsifiable) but *same operation*, which can be checked against any given procedure. ⚑ ⭐ **It explains the thing the vaguer version can't**: surface variation is variation in *what you occupy the interpreter with*. ⚑ 🔴 **And it has counterexamples in this book's own curriculum** — bhakti saturates with one object rather than withdrawing; deity visualisation constructs an extremely detailed image; and **chi-mai work attends to the very body consciousness Bodri names as *one of the biggest problems*.** Either false for a large class of practice, or true only by a redescription that drains it. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **Three verbs, not one instruction**: *detach from, ignore or turn away from*. **Turning away** relocates the object and collapses when you tire; **ignoring** requires confirming the thing is still ignored, which is attending; **detaching** changes the relationship rather than the target, costs nothing to maintain, and **cannot be done on purpose**. The first two are *chih*; the third is what *kuan* produces. ⚑ 🔴 ⭐⭐ **FOUR CONSECUTIVE CITATIONS, FOUR TRADITIONS, NO PRIMARY TEXTS** — Matt (Kabbalah), Julia Ching (Wang Yang-ming), **Forman (Eckhart)**, Muktibodhananda (the Śiva dialogue). **Second instance of a comparative argument built end-to-end from intermediaries** after pp 309–310. `[n=2]` ⚠ Body says *one of the Tantric texts of Hinduism*; footnote gives the **Bihar School *Haṭha Yoga Pradīpikā*** — the same volume four separately named Sanskrit texts elsewhere resolve to. ⚑ Internal: the book explains at p 267 that **84,000 is symbolic** and prints 125,000 without the note

concepts.title: If They Were Absolute, There Would Be One Religion
concepts.description: *if they were absolute standards, then there would be only one religion in the world, and since there isn't, then of course you know that these things are all helpful expedient constructions.* ⭐ **Valid, and premise 1 is asserted without support** — it requires that an available absolute would have been found by everyone, which is false in every domain we can check. **Plurality tracks difficulty, not non-existence**, and the argument would prove too much (medicine before germ theory, physics before Newton). ⚑ ⭐⭐⭐ **THE ILLUSTRATION ARGUES THE OPPOSITE.** Yājñavalkya, pressed seven times: three and three hundred, three and three thousand → 33 → 6 → 3 → 2 → 1½ → **One** — and Bodri's own gloss is *he would have been correct with each response.* **There is an absolute; the plurality is the delivery mechanism.** The skillful-means frame does all the work the syllogism was meant to do, without the bad premise, on the facing page. ⚑ ⭐ **Two targets, one polemical**: the syllogism attacks exclusivity by levelling; skillful means attacks literalism and **leaves a hierarchy** — *some are teachings on the ultimate, some are simple guidance mechanisms… you can't mix fish eyes and pearls together.* **A ranking, one paragraph after an argument that would make ranking impossible.** ⚑ 🔴 **The bill**: the syllogism covers Buddhism, which is the measuring instrument. The nearest thing to an answer is the *false stages* footnote, which concedes rather than replies. ⚑ **Sunday, Saturday, Friday and the fifteenth of the lunar month**, none holier than another; *all possible dharmas should be seen as just medicines to treat illnesses*; and the respect clause — *we must still be respectful of what they are trying to accomplish*

concepts.title: If They Could Save You, They Already Would
concepts.description: ⭐⭐⭐ **the theodicy run in an unusual direction**: *if any being had the power to save you, then because of their great compassion they already would have. But since they cannot, we still have wars and plagues and depressions.* **Keeps the being, keeps the compassion, gives up the capacity** — a move the theistic traditions can't make and the Buddhist ones can. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **And a dilemma whose horns both land in the same place**: unconditional salvation would already have happened; conditional salvation *would still require the personal work and effort on your part.* **The real target is the transaction**, not the belief. ⚑ 🔴 **What it doesn't reach**: the argument assumes salvation means unilateral relief of suffering, and doesn't engage a covenantal or relational account at all. ⚑ ⭐ **The best move is a refusal**: the *Māṇḍūkya* — *all creatures are forever free from bondage… ever illumined and always liberated* — printed and then declined, *this inherent intrinsic freedom won't save you.* **He grants the most abusable doctrine in the literature and cuts its practical inference off cleanly.** ⚑ 🔴 **p 631 concedes the opposite of what p 241 implies**: religion's *framework and social structuring are **absolutely essential***. Compatible — institutions are load-bearing for the approach and irrelevant to the arrival — and the joint is never stated. ⚑ **Then the return**: *when you save yourself you end up saving the world*, via mutual interpenetration — which converts a metaphysical identity into a causal benefit and gives no reason the traffic runs one way. ⚠ 🔴 **Ananda's confession printed TWICE in different wordings, a page apart, and the second carries no footnote.** `[n=2]` for one-quotation-two-ways after the U.G. case. ⚠ Śūraṅgama via Yin-Shun's *The Way to Buddhahood*; Bodri's bracket *[cultivate]* inside it

concepts.title: He Did Not Found a Religion
concepts.description: *enlightened teachers like Shakyamuni Buddha or Socrates or Confucius… never held the idea of establishing a religion in their mind. All they did was decide to talk about the path, and **all the damage came from later aspirants.*** ⭐⭐ **The word *damage* decides what kind of claim this is** — an original teaching, complete and correct, followed by decline. **It is the premise every institutional complaint in the book runs on**, and it exonerates every founder completely. ⚑ 🔴 ⭐⭐⭐ **THREE INCOMPATIBLE POSITIONS ON FOUNDERS.** (1) They never intended it, p 197. (2) **They *are* the shepherds** — the Godman passage Bodri prints whole and endorses: *these shepherds are the founders of the world's main religions*, branding sheep with ideas while priests run around barking. (3) **Founding is a normal, traceable act performed by six named and often admired people** — Nāgārjuna, Tsong Khapa, Guru Nanak, Baal Shem Tov, Abu Yazid, Padmasambhava. None retracted. ⚑ ⭐ **The distinction that would rescue it** — teachers founded *methods*, successors built *religions* — **is defeated by the book's own material**, since Tsong Khapa deliberately founded and codified and is ranked 8. The honest version is a correlation, not an intention: *the highest-ranked figures mostly taught rather than organised.* ⚑ ⭐⭐ **What the thesis buys**: it lets him savage institutions while keeping every tradition's founder intact — **which is what makes the p 187 ecumenical programme possible at all.** If the root were compromised there would be nothing to recover. ⚠ Anonymous-teacher `[n=5]`, the Godman/Papaji instance; **the bracket naming *[Christianity, Judaism, Islam, etc.]* as the flocks is Bodri's**, and it is what turns a parable into a named list

concepts.title: Moses Hid His Face
concepts.description: ⭐⭐⭐ **the one comparative reading in six hundred pages that needed no assistance.** Exodus 3:6 plainly says a frightened man covered up; an 1817 Hasidic homily says *through his experience of awe, Moses **attained** the hiding of his face, that is, **he perceived no independent self.*** **The face is the self, and hiding it is its dissolution.** ⚑ ⭐⭐ **A five-step mechanism, not an assertion**: practice → *awe of God's vastness* → *there is no place empty of Him* → the state of *ayin* → *one has no independent self.* **The operative feature is unboundedness, not scale** — a self requires an edge and the account removes the possibility of one. ⚑ ⭐⭐⭐ **This is a tradition doing the comparative work before the comparison existed.** Issachar Ber was not reading Nāgārjuna; he was working out what the commandments are for, from inside a covenantal tradition with a personal God, and landed on the dissolution of the independent self. **Independent arrival, not corroboration** — and Bodri's twice-used *even* quietly reverses which is worth more. ⚑ ⭐ **Cited to a named primary text** — *Mevasser Zedek*, Berditchev 1817, p 9a–b — **rare in this book, and attached to its strongest claim**, while Śaṅkara on the same page comes via a popular survey. ⚑ 🔴 **What the reading costs**: Moses spends the next chapter and a half arguing, bargaining and asking for signs. The passage is evidence about 18th-c. Hasidic doctrine, not about Exodus. ⚑ 🔴 **And on the Buddhist scheme it is the *first* selflessness only** — the self dissolves into something that emphatically remains — which the book's own vocabulary calls *one-sided and half-baked*, and which it does not apply here. ⚠ **The bracket *[emptiness]* on *ayin* cannot be attributed from this text** — may be the translator's; recorded, **not counted**. ⚠ *As Shankara said,* is separated from its quotation, which appears at the foot of the page — **conversion artifact**, fourth of its kind after pp 576 and 585

concepts.title: Traditions Improve by Collision
concepts.description: *you should be like a taxi driver who knows all the possible routes… and who chooses the quickest one*, against *the "not invented here" syndrome*, with the **Bodhisattva vow to study infinite doctrines recruited as the licence**. ⚑ ⭐ **The diagnosis is aimed at ecumenists, not exclusivists**: masters who say all trails end on one peak *usually tightly cling to their own cultural traditions without borrowing the best from elsewhere.* **Saying so and never borrowing is the tell.** ⚑ ⭐⭐⭐ 🔴 **THE SENTENCE THAT UNDOES THE CHAPTER, and it is two clauses long**: *the true spiritual path is **scientific**…* followed by *the path is also **self-validating**. In other words, it produces the signs of its own proof — which have all been identified and cataloged by various previous enlightened ones.* **Self-validation is offered as evidence of being scientific, and it is the property that excludes it.** The sentence even names the loop's parts: the standard was written by people whose authority is that they passed the same check, and confirmation arrives *as you follow it through to completion*, so those who stopped early produce no data. ⚑ 🔴 **Unnamed-targets `[n=2]`, announced as policy**: *truly I tell you without naming names*, then six verdicts including ***some actually lack any means of enlightenment whatsoever*** — unanswerable by anyone, and handed to a reader the framework says cannot evaluate a path they haven't walked. ⚑ ⭐ **The medicine rule has a buried condition**: aspirin-for-a-headache requires that you know what's wrong, that the action is known, and that feedback is fast. None of the three holds here. The surviving form is narrower — *don't refuse a method because of where it came from* — which is a prohibition on one bad reason, not a procedure. ⚑ 🔴 **No account of cost anywhere in the chapter**, in a book that elsewhere records gates (Kabbalah by age and marital status), Tsong Khapa's complaint about missing dosage and injury avoidance, and a stopping rule with a named retreat. ⚑ **The historical claim underneath is probably just true** — Ch'an is neither Indian nor Taoist and required both — and **it took centuries and produced its own accident report**

concepts.title: The Angelic Hierarchies Converge
concepts.description: nine Christian orders (Angels → Seraphim), nine Jewish levels (Holy Chayot → Ishim), six Buddhist Desire Realm heavens, six Puranic lokas, seven heavens in Islam. ⭐⭐⭐ **The inference, with the exclamation mark**: *sociologists, psychologists and anthropologists have proposed all sorts of reasons behind this worldwide idea… but the real reason for its commonality through world religions is because **it's true!*** — **the rival explanations are named as a class and not one of them is stated.** ⚑ 🔴 **The convergence is strongest exactly where independence is weakest.** Nine-and-nine, with *Seraphim* and *Cherubim* on both lists, belongs to the two traditions with a shared scripture and centuries of mutual influence in this precise area. **Every genuinely distant tradition gives a different number.** The honest finding is narrower and still real: **traditions everywhere grade the invisible world, and the gradings track linguistic and political proximity.** ⚑ ⭐ **The heavens are a trap for the diligent** — practitioners who reach them *mistakenly believe that their cultivation work is all completed*, and the realms correspond to attainments *just below the first dhyana*, which is why such people get called psychic *even though their cultivation abilities aren't very high at all*. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **The virtue argument is the best reasoning in the section**: precepts → no regret → joy → happiness → bodily tranquillity → bliss → concentration, landing on *almost the exact same characteristics that arise from developing the first dhyana* — **so virtue is a method rather than a moral prerequisite**, with its ceiling stated (lower heavens only). ⚠ 🔴 **Two standards for what convergence proves, a page apart**: agreement is evidence *because it's true*, disagreement is *crazy ideas* professors of religion *made up* — and the arbiter is attainment, unverifiable from outside. ⚠ **Unsourced annexation**: *many of the visitations of the Virgin Mary are manifestations performed by various Bodhisattvas*, with those who had the experience said to lack the capacity to know it — no source; not carried as fact. ⚠ Gurdjieff via **Robert L. Spencer's *The Craft of the Warrior***, a small-press martial-arts book; and fn 218 recommends Bodri's own *Twenty-Five Doors* as *what I believe is the most advanced information available*

concepts.title: The Spiritual Contest as a Recurring Form
concepts.description: the Taoist masters propose burning both scriptures and letting the fire decide; the sutras emit five-coloured light, the Taoist texts burn, and the masters who could *mount the fog and ride the clouds* find nothing works. ⭐⭐ **Bodri's reading is that the tournament is a teaching device** — *common ways accomplished sages often use to help guide people from bad roads of spiritual practice to superior roads* — and the instances really do recur in one situation: an arriving tradition against an entrenched one, needing to move a population fast. Elijah and the priests of Baal · Buddhism entering China · Milarepa against the Bon · the prophet at Bethel and Jeroboam's hand. ⚑ ⭐⭐⭐ **EVERY SURVIVING ACCOUNT IS THE WINNER'S.** Five instances, four traditions, and in two the narrator is the victor personally (Yeshe Tsogyel's *Sky Dancer*, Milarepa's *my contest with the Bon*). **Not an accusation of fabrication — a fact about what gets copied for four centuries.** So the frequency of the form is poor evidence for its efficacy and excellent evidence that contests are narratively useful to whoever won. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **The framing sentence is annex-then-grade at its most compressed**: ***Please note the similarities, but also understand that Yeshe Tsogyel's performance demonstrated the need for a much higher stage of attainment*** — convergence asserted and verdict installed **before the reader sees either text**, with no criterion given. ⚑ ⭐ **The thing nobody remarks on**: Yeshe Tsogyel **negotiates the fee before the resurrection** — *if you will give me a large sum of gold… I will restore your son to life*, and the terms are agreed first. It is in her own account, without embarrassment, and Bodri's comparison never mentions it. ⚑ 🔴 **The book's own framework makes every contest inadmissible**: if powers track body structure rather than realisation, a contest of powers adjudicates nothing about the paths. ⚑ 🔴 **And the contests argue against the thesis they are recruited for** — each one is a claim of denominational superiority made by that denomination. ⚠ p 363's block is interleaved with body text — **conversion artifact**, not a source defect

concepts.title: The Five Kinds of Prajna
concepts.description: true form, visaya, literary, expedient, and the relatives. ⭐⭐ **The first item in a list of abilities is not an ability** — true form *is* the dharmakāya, so the list was never a list of capacities but a diagram of one thing under four demands, which is why no English noun can translate the word. ⚑ ⭐ **Visaya is the framework's only self-report instrument** and it is calibrated in something incommunicable: the bricklayer standing back from an unusually even course is reading the same dial as a contemplative of thirty years, and *life's visaya opens up to a certain degree* is the entire readout. ⚑ **The relatives are the first five pāramitās reclassified as family rather than preconditions** — and they only qualify once the effort has dropped out, which quietly says that effortful generosity is a different activity wearing the name. ⚑ **A theory of talent**: Zhao Yi's *three parts human striving, seven parts heaven* — with the seventy percent earned in previous lives, so the untrainable share is accumulated rather than endowed. ⚠ 🔴 **NEW COUNTABLE — unobtainable-source citation `[n≥4]`.** The entire six-page framework is quoted from **Nan Huai-chin's *Commentary on the Diamond Sutra*, trans. Pia Giammasi, a PRIVATE MANUSCRIPT** (fn 45). Distinct from the untranslated-book pattern: an untranslated book exists and someone with the language can check it; a private manuscript has no door. Joins p 244 (privately translated Nan), p 528 and p 616 (Bill Porter, private manuscript translation), p 613 (a book *yet unnamed and unpublished*) — **all four on Diamond Sutra material.** ⚠ *Not* an anonymous-teacher instance: Nan is named in body text at pp 26, 144, 185, 209

concepts.title: The New Catholic Encyclopedia Gong-Fu List
concepts.description: eleven phenomena from *New Catholic Encyclopedia* Vol. 10 (1967): visions, thought-reading, *incendium amoris*, stigmata, bilocation, levitation, compenetration of bodies, incombustibility, inedia, incorruptibility, locutions. ⭐⭐⭐ **Four of the eleven are handed Chinese equivalents inside the quotation** — [kundalini heat], [yang shen emanations], [the body becomes full of chi], [the mai have been transformed] — **and the seven left untranslated are exactly the ones with no chi-mai equivalent.** The convergence is produced by the annotation, on the page where it is claimed. **New sub-species of the bracketed-interpolation pattern: brackets applied inside a *borrowed list*.** ⚑ 🔴 **NEW NAMED SELF-CONTRADICTION, LOAD-BEARING — p 186 vs p 188 vs p 194.** The nondenominational argument rests on a scholarly catalogue at p 186; at p 188 *it's a waste of time for scholars to try and catalogue all this material*; at p 194 cataloguing is *a proper road of investigation* that *must be done if spiritual cultivation is to… avoid becoming extinct*, **and is his stated reason for writing the book.** Three positions in nine pages; the middle one is the outlier and the only one stated as a principle. **The book's whole comparative method depends on the instrument it disqualifies.** ⚑ 🔴 **Unfalsifiable by absence** — *if the phenomena don't appear… your cultivation is wrong or just isn't good enough* — printed one paragraph after the testable version. ⚑ **The representativeness move fails**: genealogy (*most Christian sects trace their roots to Roman Catholicism*) used as warrant for representation, when the Reformation was largely an argument about this exact category. ⚑ ⭐ **The strongest item is not an argument** — Cardinal Crescenzi touching Philip Neri's hand and reporting it burned like a fever. ⚠ Neri via **Redfield/Murphy/Timbers, *God and the Evolving Universe*** `[POPULAR SOURCE]`; kundalini signs via Grof's edited volume, not a yoga primary text. ⚑ **Credit: p 187 is the least polemical page in the book** — conversion given up entirely, each tradition asked to recover the material inside its own borders, and invention authorised where a tradition genuinely lacks it

concepts.title: The Imitation Hazard
concepts.description: ⭐⭐⭐ **the danger is not that imitation fails; it is that it works well enough to generate first-person evidence.** U.G.: *People simulate these things and believe that something is happening — that's what they do.* **The output of the imitation is a conviction, not a sensation**, and the checking apparatus and the target are the same object, so every check is an act of rehearsal. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **Precision is the harmful variable.** *The yoga schools and various esoteric (form-based) schools, because of their emphasis on body-change descriptions, actually end up encouraging people to excessively desire these phenomena* — **so the traditions that documented their phenomenology best handed their own practitioners the highest-resolution imitation targets available.** ⚑ **Three imitations sit inside the *Source Mirror* hundred-and-twenty list** — *imitate insentience, like wood or stone* · *imitate uninhibited freedom and give up cultivation* · *cling to the nonclinging mind, learning imitation insight* — **all in a catalogue of good-faith failures by serious practitioners.** ⚑ ⭐ **U.G.'s criterion is negative and unusable prospectively**: no behavioural change, no framework at the time — both of which an imitator structurally cannot have, and neither of which can be aimed at. Hence his conclusion is not *read carefully* but ***there is no point in leaving any record.*** ⚑ 🔴 **The p 201 therapies passage concedes more than it means to**: if the form obstacles are now manageable with ordinary bodywork and *the problem today is… the mental ties that bind us*, then the book's own physiological apparatus is, by its author's account, the less important half

concepts.title: U.G. Krishnamurti's Transformation and His Warning
concepts.description: ⭐⭐ **the exemplar who objected.** Cited in **seven places** (pp 141, 194, 201, 204, 212–214, 439–441, 589, 593) — the corpus's most-used modern first-person case — and **graded down in all of them.** ⚑ ⭐⭐⭐ **The demotion, item by item**: U.G. says permanent (*it's the same situation even now*), Bodri says *temporary interruption of the sixth consciousness*; U.G. declines the vocabulary (*I don't want to use that word, so I say it is a state of not knowing*), Bodri supplies a ranked apparatus and files him at the **form** skandha, not conception; and ***had U.G. actually engaged in meditation at this time… the entire process would have been over rather quickly***, with the yield of not meditating given as *become healthier* rather than any attainment. ⚑ **Diagnosis: chi rushing to the head**, modelled on a pot starting to boil with the perineum as the pot's bottom. ⚑ ⭐ **The properties that made him valuable are the ones the use spends** — no framework, no method, no vocabulary, no stake in any ranking, which is why *psychologists… none can adequately explain U.G.'s circumstances*. ⚑ 🔴 **Gated on prior acceptance**: correct interpretation requires *the appropriate cultivation teachings… or* prior attainment, after which no report can push back on the framework. ⚑ ⚠ **The mirror nobody names**: this is structurally what the clinical frame does to mystical experience, and only one of the two gets criticised. ⚑ **Credit**: the disclaimer at p 214 is real — *what happened to U.G. won't necessarily happen to you*

concepts.title: Socrates' Phaedo as Cultivation Instruction
concepts.description: the *Phaedo*'s *get rid of the body and contemplate things by themselves with the soul by itself* read as a practice manual. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **Three assertions of very different weight**: that the passage contains an instruction (defensible), that *Socrates also realized the Tao* (asserted flat), and that this is *yet another independently derived system* — **which is the load-bearing one and is never argued.** ⚑ 🔴 **The confound is in the book**: p 136's admission that much of the cross-tradition variation *has to do with the location of the practice rather than the spiritual lineage or tradition* is never turned on this claim. ⚑ ⭐ **The most falsifiable sentence on the page**: follow the Socratic instruction and *first your chi will be cultivated to the point where you see an internal light, and next you'll attain samadhi and then break through the skandha of form* — a three-stage prediction attached to a text that mentions none of it. ⚑ 🔴 **Annex, then grade**: Socrates ranks *about a 3*, his path stops at the Path of Preparation — **and he is simultaneously used against the book's own austerity-heavy traditions**, matching or eclipsing Yeshe Tsogyel and Milarepa *who followed much simpler cultivation approaches*. ⚑ ⭐ **The best thing he says about him is a transmission claim**: *since Socrates had no students who could match his state, the track record of spiritual greats who've come after him has remained relatively sparse in the West* — **which means the 3 is measuring lineage, not realisation.** ⚠ **Bracketed interpolation, new instance**: *[the path of cultivation]* inserted onto the *Phaedo*'s word **purification** — the word the annexation turns on. ⚠ **p 576 is an attribution trap**: the Socrates sentence is torn in half by a conversion artifact and **fn 579 belongs to the Padmasambhava quotation, not to Socrates, who is uncited there.** ⚠ Self-citation: *Socrates and the Enlightenment Path*, William Bodri, Red Wheel/Weiser 2002

concepts.title: Not Fixed Anywhere, the Mind Is Everywhere
concepts.description: Takuan to swordsmen: ***If the mind is fixed at any particular external point, the other points are left unguarded.*** ⭐⭐ **Not focused on — *seized by*.** The relationship runs the opposite way from how it feels: you think you are gripping the object with your attention, and the object has taken your attention prisoner. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **The argument for non-attachment here is a resource argument and it is falsifiable**: *your capabilities don't decrease when you master emptiness, for they actually increase exponentially* — fixation spends the whole attentional budget in one place, so release is recovery rather than sacrifice. **It arrives from a domain where being wrong gets you killed**, which is better error-correction than most contemplative advice ever sees. ⚑ 🔴 **The extension is unlicensed**: Takuan's case is simultaneous, spatial and fast; Bodri extends it to *a million different activities* and to capability in general, and there are obvious task types where fixation *is* the competence. ⚑ **Internal form is the neglected half** — *mental views, ideas, emotions and conceptions* — and a view doesn't feel like a held object, it feels like the shape of the room. ⚑ **Letting go is not annihilation**, argued by counterexample: *when was Shakyamuni Buddha or any Zen master ever annihilated? It was simply the concept of a self.* ⚑ 🔴 ***This is essentially the same method of cultivation practice*** collapses Christian monastic surrender into non-fixation **by dropping the addressee** — the weaker claim one paragraph later (*the same spiritual principles and techniques*) is the defensible one. ⚠ Takuan via **de Bary's anthology**, not a Takuan translation; a **Pingala Upaniṣad** line via Bodri's own *Twenty-Five Doors to Meditation*; and an **unsourced hadith** (*a single hour of meditation is better than performing acts of worship for sixty years*) with no collection or grade — `[LOW CONFIDENCE]`, in a book that dismisses Islam wholesale at p 189

concepts.title: Three Accounts of One Form-Skandha Experience
concepts.description: Yin Shih Tsu, U.G. and the Christian material stacked to show *varying forms, constant principles*. ⭐ **What actually recurs**: heat · involuntariness (*the energy… does not feel the limitations of the body; it is not interested; it has its own momentum*) · duration in months and years · and, in two of three, **third-party observability.** ⚑ ⭐⭐⭐ **What does not recur is pain.** U.G.: *It is not that ecstatic blissful beatitude and all that rubbish — stuff and nonsense! — it is really a painful thing*, with six months on one wrist joint, bone-marrow pain, and *as if a wet towel were being wrung*. **The Christian list is a list of marvels and carries no equivalent.** Both cannot be neutral descriptions of one process, and the book never names the divergence. ⚑ **His own explanation is a publication claim, not a physiological one** — *everybody has. Even Ramana Maharshi suffered after that* — which would make the absence of pain in hagiography a fact about which accounts survive. ⚑ 🔴 **NEW `[CONTESTED]` — one U.G. sentence printed two ways in this book.** p 194: ***Behave normally.*** p 201: ***I behaved normally.*** Same Arms edition. **Imperative against testimony** — and the testimony version is the whole basis of U.G.'s only criterion. Neither enters as the settled text; verification owed. ⚑ ⚠ **The p 194 observer paragraph is NOT a Bodri interpolation** — the swellings mapped to Śiva's cobra, Buddha-statue lumps and *the horns of Moses* are inside the Arms edition. Its evidential value collapses anyway: **the observers were pre-loaded with the iconography they then reported.** Contrast Crescenzi on Neri's hand, who had no framework predicting it — **the cleanest third-party observation in the book, and it is from the tradition treated as peripheral**

concepts.title: Samadhi in the Abrahamic Traditions
concepts.description: dhikr (*let him not cease saying continuously with his tongue, "Allah, Allah"*… until *the form of the word, its letters and shape, is removed from his heart*), the *Cloud of Unknowing*'s single syllable as shield and spear, the *Philokalia*'s Prayer of the Heart with the breath, and Augustine's recollection-and-introversion. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **Two claims of very different weight**: that these traditions contain structurally similar *techniques* (barely contentious) and that **prophethood and sainthood were *produced by* attainment** — which swallows the traditions' own accounts of election, grace and call. ⚑ ⭐⭐⭐ 🔴 **THE SOURCING IS THE FINDING. Four consecutive citations reach no primary text, and three of them are the same book**: the *Cloud* (fn 251), al-Ghazālī's dhikr (fn 252) and the *Philokalia* (fn 253) all from **Herbert Benson, *The Relaxation Response*, Avon 1976** — a popular paperback on stress reduction **whose author assembled those passages precisely because they resemble each other.** Augustine (fn 250) from Goleman's *The Meditative Mind*. **The chapter's entire cross-Abrahamic evidence base is a set selected for similarity by someone arguing for similarity.** ⚑ ⚠ **And the same move is disclosed one page earlier**: fn 249 states his criterion for the Kabbalah source — Scholem emphasises history, **Matt emphasises *ayin***.
