More transparent than most authors manage, and still selection on the dependent variable. ⚑ ⭐ **The Jewish material is the strongest and needs the least help** — *afisat ha-mahashavah*, the annihilation of thought, as the highest sefirah; *yesh* against *ayin*; the sefirot as *stages of contemplative ascent*. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **The chapter has the better argument and gives it less room**: shared *techniques* are far stronger evidence than shared *phenomena*, because a procedure can be run and compared step by step. ⚑ **No case in the chapter resists the framework** — a comparative argument with no negative cases is reporting a search, not a finding. ⚠ fn 248's missing Arabic term is a conversion artifact; the footnote's total absence of a source is not

concepts.title: Suffering Is the Human Realm's Advantage
concepts.description: ⭐⭐⭐ **the reward for virtue is a place where progress stops.** The heavens are lovelier in every measurable way and *provide very little incentive for spiritual cultivation*, so their inhabitants spend their time enjoying themselves *and accordingly **using up their accumulated merits.*** **Not a plateau — a drawdown.** ⚑ **The human realm's advantage is the *mixture***: too much suffering removes the capacity, too little removes the reason, and *a relatively even mixture of both good and evil* is what prompts practice. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **The Dhū'l-Nūn filters (fn 230)**: creation splits into ten, nine take the material world; the remaining tenth splits, nine take Paradise; that tenth splits, nine flee Hell. **One in a thousand remains** — *not lured by the material world, nor inclined after Paradise, neither afraid of Hell.* **The three filters are exactly the three things a religion has to offer.** Asked what they seek, they will not say: *Thou knowest best what we desire* — **the remainder is unnameable by construction, since anything nameable could be offered.** ⚑ 🔴 **And it contradicts the surrounding argument**: p 288 explains the poor are religious because they hope for *a better life in heaven*, **which is filter two.** Suffering supplies a motive and the motive it supplies is the one the story removes. Neither passage notices. ⚑ **Three-tradition convergence needing no gloss** — *rare to find a wealthy man who wants to cultivate* · *for the rich and noble, it's hard to develop the aspiration* · the Gospel on the rich man. ⚑ ⭐ **The argument is completed honestly**: the poor *lack sufficient teachings*, and the prescription is ethics, discipline, awareness and merit-making — **capacities, not transfers.** ⚠ Unfalsifiable in the direction that matters: any hardship reads as productive or excessive only in retrospect

concepts.title: Brahmā's Error
concepts.description: ⭐⭐⭐ **the being who was genuinely first.** *Some will claim that they are the ultimate. Nevertheless, Buddha clearly tells us that this is a mistake **because of their own lesser stage of cultivation**.* **Not fraud, not malice — a locally valid inference.** A being at the top of a realm has complete evidence for its domain and nothing inside the realm can correct it. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **The same shape one rung down**: the Śūraṅgama's meditator who dissolves volition and concludes either that everything flows *from* them (Maheśvara) or that they flow *from* it (Īśvara). **The doctrine is not about gods — it is that priority within a bounded domain reliably reads as absolute priority, and the boundedness is what cannot be seen from inside.** ⚑ **The fall by ingestion**: beings from the **Light-Sound heavens** descend, eat earth substances (*namely salt*), become *too heavy (less etherized) and lose their ability to leave.* **A physics of embodiment, not a morality of transgression.** ⚑ 🔴 **The convergence's weakest leg**: Genesis and the Taoist descent are real parallels; **Edgar Cayce is not an independent witness** but a modern reader downstream of material that already contained the claim. `[LOW CONFIDENCE]`, not carried. ⚑ 🔴 **The warrant undercuts itself** — a god's report is unreliable because of its stage; a Buddha's is reliable because of rank; both report from a position. ⚠ **Sourcing on one spread**: Tsung-mi via **Peter Gregory / University of Hawaii Press** (excellent) against **Top Shape Publishing — third instance `[n=3]`**, Bodri's own publisher

concepts.title: The Heaven of No-Thought Is a Trap
concepts.description: ⭐⭐⭐ **the tradition's own list puts the attainment beside coma.** Five (or six) *stations* where the sixth consciousness stops: mindless sleep · unconsciousness · the samādhi of no-thought · the Heaven of no-thought · the Arhat's samādhi of extinction — and Paramārtha's version adds **drunken stupor**. **Not an insult; a taxonomy classifying by one criterion, which by that criterion cannot tell them apart.** ⚑ ⭐⭐ **The heaven is near the top of the Form Realm and is terminal**: *you can neither listen to the dharma for achieving self-realization, nor can you practice it* — and at the end *it's as if you had never been there at all… **nothing has been attained, not even further merit!*** ⚑ ⭐⭐ **The method that produces it is the ordinary mistake**: suppressing discriminatory thoughts *and even the knowing aspect of the mind* is *actually the same thing as trying to produce the samadhi of no-thought.* **Whole schools taught it as a high method.** ⚑ **Doctrinal corrective**: *Buddha never actually said that there is anything wrong with thoughts*; and *to stir thoughts is error, to stop thoughts is also error.* ⚑ ⭐⭐ **Huineng's definition is the opposite arrangement** — *even though you see all things, you do not attach to them* · *in the midst of the six dusts, you do not stand apart from them, yet are not stained by them.* **Full contact. What is absent is the staining, not the traffic.** ⚑ ***No-thought and thought are actually both experiential realms of false thought.*** ⚑ ⭐ **Disqualified in two lines needing no doctrine**: *only a temporary stage of attainment and there are yet higher realms still.* ⚑ 🔴 **The criterion is an absence, and absences have no properties** — so the tradition sorts by the **aftermath** instead, which it never says it is doing. ⚠ `[LOW CONFIDENCE]` on the cognitive cost (*you'll easily forget about things and become a bit stupid*) — no case, no source, though the prediction follows from the mechanism

concepts.title: Hearing Is the Best Gate
concepts.description: the *Śūraṅgama* runs a survey: **twenty-five Bodhisattvas and Arhats report how they got there**, and Mañjuśrī is asked to name the best **for humans.** He picks hearing. ⚑ ⭐ **The coverage argument**: *the eyes cannot pierce a screen* · *body only feels when it is touched* · *mind's thoughts are confused and unconnected* · *voice whether near or far at all times can be heard*. **Ten drums, ten directions, simultaneously — and no aiming required.** ⚑ ⭐⭐⭐ **The deeper argument — the faculty survives its object**: *absence of sound is not the end of hearing, and sound when present is not its beginning*; and **hearing continues in sleep when thinking stops.** **The one faculty a human already has that demonstrably operates without the sixth consciousness** — hence *inward turn your faculty of hearing to hear your own nature.* ⚑ ⭐ **Avalokiteśvara's six-step ladder**, each move dissolving the pair the last one made, with the hinge at step four: hearing and its object cease — ***but I did not stop where they ended.*** ⚑ **One gate suffices**: six organs from one ālaya, *if one of these returns to source, all six functions are ended.* ⚑ 🔴 **The other twenty-four are dismissed**: *expedients used by Buddha in particular cases… **not good for indiscriminate practice by men of different types*** — which sits badly against a mechanism that makes *types* a real consequence of differing development. ⚑ **Bodri's own honestly-flagged addition**: *what they didn't say* is that **smell is second**, breath reclassified as a smell-gate practice on the shared wind element. ⚠ Forman dependency for the *Laṅkāvatāra*; and *my teacher once showed me a realm of blue skinned human inhabitants* — one clause, no circumstances, framed as confirmation

concepts.title: Prayer Requires Karmic Connection
concepts.description: ⭐⭐⭐ **a god of wealth turns up in person to explain that he cannot help.** *Only if you practice generosity and giving can you become wealthy… **how can you obtain them without this karmic past?*** closing with ***What can imploring the gods do about it?*** — **a deity asking what the point of praying to deities is.** ⚑ **Two conditions, both required**: prayers are answered *if at all* by Desire Realm devas **because these are the beings closest to us** — proximity, not altitude — and *if you don't have any karmic connection… your calls for help will be worthless.* ⚑ ***A Buddha cannot teach individuals with whom they have no karmic affinity.*** **Cannot, not will not** — the limitation is on the helper's side. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **Which is why the Buddha-name lists exist**: he recited countless Buddhas' names so hearers could *form a karmic connection… just from hearing or reciting their names even once.* **Those long liturgical lists are infrastructure installation, not ornament.** ⚑ ⭐⭐⭐ **The tiger story**: the Arhats vetted a would-be monk, *couldn't find any good roots*, and refused him — and the Buddha overruled them because *infinite kalpas ago this man was chased by a tiger, and while being chased he shouted 'Namo Amitofo.'* **The connection was formed in terror, once, and the audit missed it.** ⚑ **Merit is the second gate**: *you cannot receive the grace of spiritual assistance no matter how much you cry out* — and **being human *is* the shortfall**, since *if we had a greater degree of merit, we would have been born in the heavens.* ⚑ ⭐ **The forbidden thing is the exchange model**, not prayer: intervention is real but asymmetric, *just as we might work to save a beached whale.* ⚑ 🔴 Unfalsifiable in operation, and it converts unanswered prayer into a verdict — with the tiger story as its own partial answer

concepts.title: Which Clinging Traps You in Which Realm
concepts.description: ⭐⭐ **nobody sentences you; you match.** Evil thoughts and deeds surround a person with *a specific yin-type chi*, and at death *this evil-type chi will naturally cause them to be reborn in a realm with a similar yin-type nature.* The administering beings are mentioned and set aside in the same sentence. **The sorting is physics.** ⚑ ⭐ **Greed and anger are named** — and the realms are not punishments corresponding to vices but **the vices extended**, given an environment that expresses them continuously with none of the ordinary human interruptions. **Which is why thoughts count as much as deeds: the thought *is* the chi.** ⚑ ⭐⭐⭐ **And it is framed as therapeutic** — the matching incarnation is *the only thing that will help you burn up your karma.* ⚑ **The ladder has no shortcuts**: hells → hungry ghosts → animals → human, because each realm exhausts one kind of chi. ⚑ **Structural pairing, not severity**: illness with no appetite and no drink is a small hungry-ghost episode. ⚑ 🔴 **Two incompatible models run side by side** — matching (*you leave when the material is exhausted*) against **remission** (*this merit can act to quicken your journey through this realm and lighten your **punishments***). **Three uses of *punishments* in a system with no punisher**, and the two models recommend different actions. ⚑ 🔴 **The time argument slides** from lunar day-length to subjective duration; the experiential claim was plausible without the astronomy. ⚑ ⭐ **The uncomfortable corollary, stated plainly**: good conduct is not a defence, because what is matched is what you *are*. ⚠ *The stories aren't always fictitious* about disappearing-in-the-woods folklore — no case, no criterion; not carried

concepts.title: There Is No God Above the Gods
concepts.description: ⭐⭐⭐ **theism given a mechanism rather than a dismissal.** The *Śūraṅgama*'s **second and third false conditions of the consciousness skandha**: a practitioner who has *thoroughly comprehended the voidness of the skandha of volition* and *wiped out the concept of birth and death* but *not yet realized the wonder of nirvana* either surveys the universe *and regards it as their own bodies* (→ adherent of **Maheśvara**, sowing *arrogance for asserting the omnipresence of the self*) or concludes the ground is *the true permanent indestructible body* (→ adherent of **Īśvara**, sowing *false perfection*). **Same depth, same real attainment; the fork is whether you locate yourself inside the ground or outside it.** ⚑ **Fifty warnings, ten per skandha**, with the honest caveat that there are more. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **The concession that changes the argument's character**: ***for worldly religion the sages wisely pose the idea of a creator God since this is what people can handle.*** Not fraud — a competent teaching for the audience available. ⚑ ⭐ **And the objection narrows to one thing**: *if you want to call the Tao "God," then that's okay as long as you don't form any image… **don't think of It as a being or person.*** Not *your God doesn't exist* but *the moment you give it a face you have stopped pointing at it.* ⚑ 🔴 **The warrant is testimony plus rank** — the mechanism shows a practitioner *could* be wrong, not that they are, and the framework has pre-classified the contrary report as a known error. ⚑ 🔴 **Two rival catalogues of how to be wrong** — fifty by skandha, **forty-six by bhūmi** in the *Abhisamayālaṃkāra* — printed unreconciled, which discounts any single item on either. ⚑ ⭐ **Read structurally, the doctrine is a guarantee that no experience can be terminal**, and the fifty warnings are its enforcement mechanism

concepts.title: Psychic Ability Is Inherited Chi Mai
concepts.description: ⭐⭐ **a two-step, and the two steps are the point**: *it's not that psychic abilities are inherited themselves. Rather, **a better set of chi mai is inherited***. Genes → channel quality → ability. **Nobody inherits the capacity; they inherit the plumbing.** Not grace — *it has nothing to do with "grace" or "God" or whatever* — and not a gene for the faculty. ⚑ **Which relocates rarity**: everyone has the faculty and differs in **obstruction**, so the natural psychic has good plumbing and no attainment. ⚑ **No collective progress either**: *human beings will always have obstructed chi channels.* ⚑ 🔴 **The regress terminates in karma** — favourable chi mai requires *previous virtuous lives of cultivation* — which absorbs any distribution, including siblings differing, and makes the model unfalsifiable at exactly the layer doing the work. ⚑ ⭐⭐⭐ **THE FOOTNOTE DEMOLISHES THE BODY TEXT.** fn 587 lists six routes that open the channels: **accident · chi-gong breath retention · constant hunger asceticism · devotional bhakti · hypnotic induction · recovery from sickness.** **Two injuries, one deprivation, one induced state, one technique, and love — with equal effect.** A capability opened equally by concussion and by devotion **certifies nothing about how it was reached**, which is the book's own deflation stated more forcefully below the line than anywhere above it. `[LOW CONFIDENCE]` on the routes as aetiology; the structural point holds regardless. ⚑ ⭐ **And the operative variable turns out not to be channels but BONES** — earth is the hardest element to transform, *"Extraordinary are the bones of an Immortal"* — with masters choosing rebirth **on skeletal quality.** A materialist criterion inside a framework that files the body at the bottom of the skandhas

concepts.title: The Body Mapped to the Three Realms
concepts.description: feet to pelvis **Desire** (genitals, jing) · abdomen to brow **Form** (chi, internal light) · brow upward **Formless** (shen, emptiness) — framed as *yet another way to understand one's progress.* ⚑ ⭐⭐⭐ **Which means the three-realm cosmology and the jing-chi-shen physiology are ONE SCHEME IN TWO VOCABULARIES** — and therefore **their agreement is not cross-confirmation**, it is a fact about the framework. Nothing in the chapter distinguishes the two possibilities. ⚑ ⭐ **The one part that could have come out otherwise**: *legs and feet correspond to the hell realms and the realm of hungry ghosts*, and the soles open **at the first dhyāna** — specific, distal, bilaterally checkable, and not derivable from up-is-refined. **The only testable claim on the page.** ⚑ 🔴 **The evidence offered for it is iconographic** — the devil's cloven feet, the footless ghost — **conventions with their own documented histories, recruited as preserved observation.** Same move as the chi-flames argument; the physiological claim stands or falls without them. ⚑ ⭐ **The instruction nobody repeats, in brackets**: *the chi must rise to the head **(but remember that it must also descend!)*** — the corrective for the failure modes that get whole pages elsewhere, buried in a subordinate clause. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **The sharpest joke in the book**: *it's not that things are secret, it's just that people don't understand them* — and his teacher's line that *many people won't be able to make a living anymore after everything is now revealed* — set against Padmasambhava on not giving the nectar to charlatans. **Most secrecy is a racket and some is quality control; both, unreconciled.** ⚑ 🔴 **And then he discards it**: esoteric chakra and chi-mai teachings are *actually useless for making genuine progress*, the chapter being *yet another form of spiritual education and cross-referral*

concepts.title: The Four Arhat Stages and the Two Immortal Typologies
concepts.description: ⭐⭐ **the oldest Buddhist scale measures a debt, not a state**: Srotāpanna seven lives · Sakṛdāgāmin one · Anāgāmin none in the Desire Realm · Arhat done. ⚑ ⭐ **Views first, then thoughts** — the Stream Winner cuts the *deluded views of the Three Realms* but *not the deluded thoughts*; the Once-Returner cuts six of nine levels of deluded thought, *not the last three which are more subtle*, and these *don't originate from one lifetime but from many.* **The most auditable scheme in the book: a specified quantity of a specified thing per rung.** ⚑ **And the rung is losable** — *he can still regress from this stage of progress* — which agrees with the bhūmi ladder that most of the path is reversible. ⚑ ⭐ ***In this entering of "entering the stream," there is no entering.*** ⚑ 🔴 ⭐⭐ **THE TAOIST LADDER MEASURES SOMETHING ELSE ENTIRELY** — ghost, human, earth, spirit, celestial immortals graded by **completeness of a bodily transmutation** (lead replenishing mercury, jade nectar into elixir, three yang essences at the crown) with a **bureaucratic promotion** at the top. The human immortal's defect is *knowing only one method*; the earth immortal's is complacency. **Neither is a count of anything.** ⚑ **The join is asserted once**: Great Arhat ≡ Great Golden Immortal, both being where *chi has transmuted into shen and shen has transmuted into emptiness* — **a bridge made of jing-chi-shen, which is native to one side of the comparison.** Every cross-tradition ranking in the book depends on it holding. ⚑ 🔴 **Annex-then-grade on the Vedic seers**, and *ancient Egypt had a similar ranking scheme* with no source, scheme name or content — not carried. ⚑ ⭐ **Supply-side explanation for a doctrinal gap**: schools omit the formless absorptions *because so very few people can access these states* — a map stops where its practitioners stopped

concepts.title: The Bhūmis on Three Axes
concepts.description: ten stages with beautiful names, **five accounts from four sources, running on at least four incommensurable criteria.** ⚑ ⭐⭐ **What you attain** (the Buddha's naming-etymology to Avalokiteśvara) · **what you overcome** (the barrier list) · **what you can now do** (the capability list) · **which pāramitā you consummate** (the *Flower Ornament* synopsis). **Ask a practitioner *which rung* and only one axis returns a number.** ⚑ ⭐⭐⭐ **The fourth bhūmi overcomes *the barrier of attachment to concentration states, and the barrier of attachment to RELIGION*** — both acquired by practising well, both required to go before the halfway mark, in a numbered list, in a religious text. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **The one boundary that does real work is 7/8**, and it is mechanical rather than descriptive: the first seven are *impure* because *subtle ego-clinging still exists*, the seventh consciousness is unpurified and the volition skandha untransformed. The **eighth is where backsliding stops** — *you are sure to gain enlightenment in every subsequent incarnation* — and where **the real class of superpowers** begins. ⚑ ⭐⭐⭐ **The seventh-stage bodhisattva *always appear[s] in the abode of devils*** and acts *similar to those of heretics* — four uses of *appear* in one passage. **Which makes behaviour useless as a ranking criterion at exactly the point the book most needs one**, and hands an unfalsifiable defence to anyone whose conduct is questioned. ⚑ ⭐ **Sourcing is unusually good here** — Keenan/Numata, Chang/Motilal — and that is itself a finding: **when Bodri works inside the Buddhist technical literature the citations improve; it is the comparative chapters that run on intermediaries**

concepts.title: The Arhat's Remainder
concepts.description: ⭐⭐⭐ **everything is gone except the wanting it gone.** True egolessness achieved, *and yet Arhats still possess a subtle sort of clinging to spiritual visaya. **They still grasp to an internal desire for purity***, and that infatuation turns them away from the world of form. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **Why that residue is the last one standing**: every other attachment has an object the practice is aimed at; **a desire for purity is aimed at what the practice produces, so the practice cannot remove it and every session strengthens it.** It presents as diligence and survives any ordinary audit. ⚑ **It bookends the path** — the same appetite is the exit condition for the *lowest* realm (*desire really includes… the desire for purity, calmness and the cultivation of Tao*). ⚑ ⭐ **Zen's verdict**: attaining bodhi is *seeing only **the beautiful side of the Tao***, and *there is also the realm of existence to be mastered.* ⚑ ⭐⭐ **Stilled, not extinguished** — the karmic roots are *temporarily stilled… **still ready to burst forth, waiting for the right circumstances to arise***, so an Arhat can hold emptiness *for thousands and thousands of eons* and still suffer *a rebirth that is out of the Arhat's control.* **A force quiet for aeons is observationally identical to a force removed; only the eventual event separates them.** ⚑ **Hence the vocabulary**: *nirvāṇa with remainder* against *without*, the *Vimalakīrti*'s *remaining subtle habits not yet broken*, and **fractional**. The operative difference is **mobility** — a Buddha comes and goes through all Three Realms at will. ⚑ ***Although illusions may be subtle, as long as they remain one is not yet fully liberated.*** ⚠ 🔴 **The charge of *breaking the vows of spiritual discipline* is one school's rulebook applied to another school's graduates** — Bodhisattva vows the Arhat never took — printed in disciplinary language with the marker (*from the Mahayana perspective*) that most readers will skim

concepts.title: The Three Realms
concepts.description: Desire, Form, Formlessness. ⭐⭐⭐ **The concession and the claim are two lines apart.** *You can always cut a single cake into many different patterns, and Shakyamuni offered several alternative partitionings… this particular three part divisional scheme is the most useful one he employed **because it is the one most closely and directly tied to the path of cultivation attainments*** — **a selection on usefulness, stated candidly** — followed immediately by ***there is no Fourth Realm… no other alternative universe or parallel existence or hidden realm either. Everything in existence is included in these Three Realms.*** **A partition drawn to track cultivation stages cannot then test them**, and a scheme that exhausts existence can never be shown to have left anything out. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **The realms are defined by what a being can no longer be moved by** — Desire by the wanting of food and sex *and* by reproduction requiring two bodies; Form by the real dhyāna attainments, outside Desire entirely. **The cosmology is a phenomenology in disguise.** ⚑ ⭐ **The celibacy argument carries its own hedge** — the rule is *supposed to* help — and the correction is immediate: *doesn't mean that you can't have sex… it's just that you can't drop into lust.* **The requirement is on the pull, and a rule can only check the act.** ⚑ 🚩 ⭐ **PROPHECY AND CONFIRMATION ARE DIFFERENT CLAIMS**: Shakyamuni is said to have foreseen women giving birth *as young as five years old*, confirmed by an unsourced statistic about first menstruation *between ages nine and ten*. **The evidence contradicts the prediction it is offered to confirm, and the figure does not match the published record.** `[DO NOT FILE]` ⚑ 🔴 **Science-catching-up is now well past `[n=4]`** — astronomy *has since proved him right*, unsourced galaxy shapes as flowers/globes/saucers, *quantum physics has gone on to prove this principle*, and an oscillating universe scientists *will no doubt come to*. **The confirmation is always announced and never cited.** ⚑ ⭐ **CREDIT — the one claim on these pages that generated a procedure rather than an announcement**: 84,000 organisms in a bowl of water (correctly named as symbolic), producing the rule that monks strain drinking water through gauze **and return the cloth to the water**, with an independent Jain parallel. Premise, procedure, rationale, cross-check. ⚑ 🔴 **The abandoned distinction**: p 265's *even the images of heaven espoused by different religions are a projection of the cultural psyche rather than an ascertainment of absolute fact* is exactly what would have rescued the p 274 *because it's true!* argument — structure real, imagery local — and it is never connected. ⚠ John C. Lilly cited in the body only as *a famous scientist*

concepts.title: The Graded Sexuality of the Desire Realm Heavens
concepts.description: Yāma embrace · Tuṣita clasp hands · Nirmāṇarati smile · Paranirmita-vaśavartin **glance into one another's eyes.** ⭐⭐ **As you ascend, the contact thins** — and the axis is named: human sex runs on **jing**, eye contact on **shen**, so the ladder of heavens is a ladder of *which essence the exchange runs on*. The higher beings are not being ascetic; a finer substance needs less apparatus to move it. ⚑ ⭐⭐⭐ **THE MAPPING INVERTS ITS OWN HIERARCHY.** Bodri matches the four modes to the four tantra classes — Action = looking, Performance = smiling, Yoga = holding hands, Highest Yoga = sexual embrace — **so the mode belonging to the highest heaven belongs to the *lowest* tantra class, and the class named *Highest* matches the lowest heaven.** He writes *the Paranirmita-vaśavartin heaven, which would correspond to Action Tantra activities* and does not notice. Three readings available (efficacy-not-refinement · spurious four-to-four match · a real finding against the esoteric schools); **the book takes none.** ⚑ ⭐⭐ ***"Desire" really includes… the desire for purity, calmness and the cultivation of Tao as well*** — **so the exit condition from the lowest realm includes not wanting to exit it.** ⚑ ⭐ **The usable criterion survives all the cosmology**: *whenever you can freely abandon clinging to even some small measure of your desires so that they don't rule you, you are making definite progress.* Incremental, and it requires no belief in the Yāma heaven. ⚑ **The beings in the highest Desire heaven are still below the first dhyāna** — refinement *within* a realm doesn't get you out of it — and there are four samādhi below the first dhyāna, which is why its inhabitants can do supernatural things. ⚠ **Wholly unsourced** — four modes, longevity, wives, male birth from the knees — the reader referred to *Buddha's various descriptions* with no work named. ⚠ p 279's gender doctrine (male rebirth requires transforming yin chi to yang; *naturally this isn't a sexist statement, for it's just the way things are*) **recorded as the source's position, not carried**; likewise the jihad passage. ⚑ ⭐ **His own question undoes his own paragraph**: on the wives ratio — ***what makes an individual think they'll be reborn in that heaven as a male rather than as a female?***

concepts.title: Teaching Schemes Are Audience-Relative
concepts.description: ⭐⭐ **the Buddha preached the existence of self**, *only to attract the simple-minded*, while teaching no-self to those *with greater wisdom store*. **Two contradictory doctrines on the tradition's central question, held simultaneously and issued by audience.** ⚑ ⭐⭐⭐ **Pai Chang's symmetry is the mechanism**: the first tier — *it is possible to attain buddhahood by cultivation… mind itself is buddha* — is *Buddha's teaching* and *incomplete*, concerned with **weeding out impure things**, *words for ordinary people*. The second — *one cannot attain buddhahood by cultivation… neither mind nor buddha* — is *also Buddha's teaching*, **complete**, concerned with **weeding out PURE things**, *words for someone of rank on the Way*. **So the second is not a correction of the first; it is the removal of the first, prescribed when the first has finished its work.** ⚑ ⭐⭐ **THE HIGHER TIER CANNOT BE SAFELY PUBLISHED** — reading a removal early performs the subtraction without the prerequisite. **A structural argument for esoteric transmission requiring nobody to want to gatekeep**, and the reason *you are not ready* is both the field's most abused sentence and sometimes literally true. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **The best evidence is behavioural**: lecturing on the Lotus Sutra, Shakyamuni *had **hundreds of Arhats leave** because they didn't want to hear about a stage of Tao higher than what they had already accomplished.* **Not a limit on comprehension — a limit on what a listener can afford**, operating at the very top of the scale. ⚑ Lung-ya: *to speak of practicing the path is an expression of encouragement, **a term of inducement**… ultimately there is no doctrine to get, no path to practice.* ⚑ ⭐ **Applied to this book, unprompted**: *taking this very book as another example — **where actually only the most rudimentary issues of the path are being discussed***. Honest self-assessment and unfalsifiable positioning have the same shape. ⚑ 🔴 **The two reading rules it licenses (tiering, duress) make every contradiction pedagogy and every silence politics** — no text can be found simply confused. ⚠ **The closing paragraph turns civic**: *the masses absolutely require religious methods of ordering society… without religious instruction, societies would have no way to become pacified*, evidenced by an unspecified impression of ex-Communist countries. **Recorded, not carried.** ⚠ Harshest line aimed at the reader in the book: *then close up this book because you're not worth my time*

concepts.title: The False Tantras and Nāgārjuna's Intention
concepts.description: ⭐⭐⭐ **the founding of the Esoteric school described as market-facing syncretism.** Nāgārjuna *took the schools of orthodox Buddhism, Vedic Brahmanism, yoga, mantra practices, and all sorts of other schools… and combined them all together into one. In a way we can say that he **produced a sausage which was stuffed with a little bit of everything***, because *many people are attracted to these various means of cultivation.* **Said of a figure this book ranks 10.** ⚑ ⭐⭐⭐ **THE BINDER IS THE ACHIEVEMENT, NOT THE ASSEMBLY**: *this was possible **only because** he linked all the popular practices of his time together **using the correct view of prajna***. The contents pre-existed him; the organising view did not. **Hence the warning — *so if people want to do the same thing, they have to be careful as to whether they are really qualified*** — which is what *false tantra* means here: **not a forgery, but the same operation performed without the binder.** ⚑ ⭐⭐ **And it cannot be detected by inventory**, because a genuine and a false assembly have identical contents. The difference is a *view*, and a view is invisible in a practice manual. **This is exactly what "a basket collection of yoga techniques" describes.** ⚑ ⭐⭐ **The quantitative evidence**: the tantras partition the bhūmis into *eleven, twelve, thirteen, fourteen, fifteen and even sixteen or more* divisions against an orthodox ten — **a monotonic upward drift, which is the signature of subdivision rather than of discovery**, and which Bodri explains as re-cutting *according to the merit scenario* rather than by realisation. ⚑ 🔴 **But the ten-fold scheme is conceded first**: the partitions are *just a matter of skillful means with **no actual reality in fact***. **If none is real, the objection to sixteen cannot be accuracy** — only incomparability. ⚑ 🔴 **No criterion is offered for the binder**, so the test is unavailable to precisely the person who needs it; and the historical claim about Nāgārjuna carries no citation. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **He recommends the operation at p 518 and documents its failure here, two hundred pages apart.** ⚠ Bon as *shamanistic*, the mix as including *heavenly asura* practices — recorded, not repeated; **credit: *may be beneficial in terms of religious belief*** is conceded in the same passage

concepts.title: Bodri Ranks the Schools
concepts.description: Zen · true Taoism and Esoteric Buddhism · śamatha-vipaśyanā · yoga · Pure Land, with ***I don't like ranking various spiritual schools*** on the record. ⭐⭐ **The criterion is PORTABILITY and it is stated**: form-based schools depend on the human body's particular architecture, while Zen's methods *work regardless as to the realm you're born into or the physical structure you possess.* **An engineering property, not a value judgement** — Zen ranks first because it has the fewest dependencies. Plus a side-effect demerit: form-based practice *tends to increase our subtle clinging habits regarding the human-realm.* ⚑ 🔴 **The top two entries are extinct.** The second-place schools rank there *as ideal types*; as practised, *since the real schools within these traditions can hardly be found at all today, these schools… become only fourth ranked yoga school techniques.* **A hierarchy whose upper reaches are unavailable cannot guide a choice.** ⚑ **Why the deviant branches win**: they are *quite colorful and exotic* — market competition operating inside a single tradition. ⚑ 🔴 **And it contradicts the individual ranking**: Zen first / yoga fourth predicts a separation the sage list doesn't show (Milarepa and Tsong Khapa at 8, Zen masters at 7–9, Nāgārjuna at 10). The defensible reading is **population rates, not ceilings** — which is not how it is phrased. ⚑ ⭐ **Zen's own named fault, printed nearby**: *this purposeful ignorance is actually a fault with many Zen practitioners*, who *think they understand all the important cultivation matters… without having attained any real comprehension at all.*

concepts.title: The Ranking of the Sages
concepts.description: Yeshe Tsogyel 2 · Socrates 3 · Wang Yang-ming 3–4 · Mencius 5–6 · Chuang Tzu 6–7 · Confucius 7–8 · Huang-Po 7–8 · Milarepa and Tsong Khapa 8 · Ma Tsu 8–9 · Lao Tzu 8–9 · **Nāgārjuna 10**; Hui-neng, Vimalakīrti and Shakyamuni above the scale. ⚑ 🔴 ⭐⭐⭐ **THE PRINCIPLE DISQUALIFIES THE TABLE, THREE SENTENCES EARLIER**: *first level Bodhisattvas cannot comprehend the cultivation of those at the second… like parents understanding their young children while the children don't comprehend their parents **yet thinking they do**.* **Ranking Nāgārjuna at 10 requires being at 10.** Both hedges (*unfair*, *superficial*) concern which dimension is measured, never who can read the scale. ⚑ ⭐ **The one evidenced ordering** is Confucius on Lao Tzu — *my mouth gaped open and I could not close it* — recognition without comprehension, which is exactly what the principle predicts. **A method that produces orderings from documented reactions, and no numbers at all.** ⚑ ⭐⭐ **The payload**: Yeshe Tsogyel and Milarepa, on *very painful paths of form-school esoteric cultivation*, ***matched and even eclipsed*** by Socrates, Lao Tzu and Confucius on *much simpler cultivation approaches* — *cultivate prajna and you attain everything; cultivate the body and you may attain nothing at all!* **The league table is an argument against the book's own physiological apparatus.** ⚑ 🔴 **The confidence gradient runs backwards** — hedged ranges low down (*3 or 4*, *5 or 6*), a flat 10 at the top. ⚠ **Jesus and Mohammed placed at or below the first bhūmi** in a subordinate clause with no evidence, and none of the book's own Abrahamic material brought to bear. Recorded, **not carried**. ⚠ Confucius as a śamatha-vipaśyanā practitioner — no source

concepts.title: Every Religion Will Disappear
concepts.description: ⭐⭐ ***every religion will disappear, every nation will fall, and every people will scatter***, with **Buddhism named on the Buddha's own prediction** and Christianity, Islam and Judaism *despite their current prominence*. **One of the few places the framework is turned on its own tradition with no rescue clause.** The target is *chosenness*, which works because chosenness is a claim about permanence. ⚑ ⭐⭐⭐ **The real mechanism is IRREVERSIBILITY, and it is separate from impermanence**: *sages arriving later… would be hampered by what had been previously established (and by then inculcated into rigid dogma) by **much lower adepts**… A greater sage arriving later might not be able to do anything to correct the mistaken, incomplete or wayward notions.* **Traditions should therefore show sedimentary strata arranged by date rather than by merit** — Hinduism offered as the instance, *perfectly true*. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **THE PHOTOCOPIER**: religious professionals *pick up the stack of papers and bang them on a table trying to make all the edges line up.* **Banging a stack aligns the edges and changes no page** — a precise description of systematic theology resolving contradictions *through intellectual arguments and logic rather than through spiritual achievement*, by **academics selected for argumentative skill, which is uncorrelated with knowing which pieces are right.** ⚑ ⚠ **Tsong Khapa is said to have privately concluded reform was unavailable and played for damage limitation** — a claim about a documented figure's strategy with **no source**; and it names Bon, Taoism and yoga as the *damage* and *tumors*. Recorded, **neither carried**

concepts.title: Bodri's Reversal on Tibetan Buddhism
concepts.description: four verdicts in one book: **second of five** (p 291, as an ideal type) · **fourth as actually practised** · ***perhaps the school of Tibetan Buddhism has the clearest account of practice stations*** (p 414) · ***not Tibetan Buddhism of any form, despite its popularity*** (p 463) · *despite the **checkered history***… (p 469). ⚑ ⭐⭐ **Not a contradiction — four assessments of four objects sharing one name**: the formless core (near-extinct), the map (best in class), the living institution (degraded), and the brand. **The book never separates them.** ⚑ ⭐⭐⭐ **CATEGORY CAPTURE**: *people usually think that the Esoteric school stands for Tantric practices, but they… **identify "esotericism" with Tibet and Tibetan Buddhism***. The name now points at its most-encountered instance, which makes every other member of the category unnameable — and **a captured name can only be corrected using the captured word**, so every correction reinforces it. ⚑ **The positive claim**: *the school of Consciousness-Only or Mind-Only is the actual basis behind the Esoteric school* — Yogācāra as theory layer, tantra as technique layer. ⚑ 🔴 **The prophecy is declared unfulfilled**: Tibetan temples in America don't satisfy it because *the real Esoteric school has yet to come into America en masse* — **unfalsifiable, no criterion given, and the unfulfilled remainder is the material the author is publishing.** ⚑ ⭐⭐ **The compliment and the complaint have one cause**: detailed delineation earns the praise and generates the imitation hazard. **The best-documented tradition is necessarily the most imitable one**, and the book makes both observations without connecting them. ⚑ **The unstated working position: read the tradition, don't join it** — which inherits the borrowing programme's problem, since a map taken alone arrives without its gates. ⛔ **The prophecy's stated wording uses a racial descriptor for the Americas; recorded on the ledger as the source's own, never reproduced in vault voice**

title: Phase 10 — Natarajan + the site's non-*tattva* sections. Batch 1, 2026-08-18. **9 pages + 1 fold.**

concepts.title: The Two Ratios
concepts.description: ⭐⭐⭐ ***Personality = Deeds ÷ Words*; *Character = (Words + Deeds) ÷ Thoughts*.** Under one for most people; **one is the perfect human being**; above one *"may be hyperactive or even mad"* — a failure mode on the good side. ⚑ **Absence-capable, first-person, and it moves AGAINST inflation**, since a consolidating practitioner talks more and the denominator grows. **With its own disclaimer printed beside it, not shelved.** ⚠ Its blind spot is the man who promises nothing

concepts.title: Rajas Is the Road Out of Tamas
concepts.description: ⭐⭐⭐ *"Would to God it were otherwise in my land, for **this is verily the virtuousness of death**."* **Morality produced by inertia "very much looks the same" as morality produced by sattva** — so the ladder runs only in order, *"without an abundance of Rajas you have hopes neither in this world nor the next."* ⚑ **The diagnostic is necessarily indirect: go and do something strenuous.** And the ideal must be **one notch up, not three** — which is why the gopī path is affirmed and suspended rather than ranked. ⚠ Gendered reformist rhetoric reported, never restated

concepts.title: The Vīra-Sādhana and Its Seven Nights
concepts.description: ⭐⭐⭐ **the *Tantrasāra*'s hero's practice, and the build's first three-part apparatus of test, pass-condition and adverse outcome**: *"for seven days, showing great and terrifying visions in the last third of the night, he surely comes. **If the sādhaka passes through this illusion undeterred**, he attains the boon."* ⚑ **The first rite tests endurance; this one tests what you do when the practice generates the thing that stops you.** With the alphabet-prāṇāyāma, and the fiercer rite carrying the **gentler** mantra

concepts.title: The Thirteen-Knotted Cord
concepts.description: ⭐⭐ the Hanumān Vrat, **whose unit is the year rather than the count.** Thirteen syllables of *oṃ namo bhagavate vāyunandanāya*, one per lotus-petal; **thirteen knots on a cord that lies across them and is then bound on the wrist for a year**; a *granthi-pūjā* addressing each knot by epithet, **closing on *"the future teller of the Rāmāyaṇa"***; and an *aṅga-pūjā* that reads the body **as a biography** where the river's reads hers as geography. ⚑ Ends in *vāyana*, a gift **he both gives and takes**

concepts.title: Turning a Chaupāī Into a Mantra
concepts.description: ⭐⭐ **any *Mānas* verse converted into an accomplished mantra by one night's eight-substance havan**, on the warrant that **Śiva gave the chaupāīs their power at Vārāṇasī** — so the practitioner faces the city and *"no oath is required."* Four worked verse-to-purpose pairings; **a Laṅkā-kāṇḍa Saturday rule with no reason given**; separate establishment per purpose; women eligible. ⚑ **The only mantra procedure in the volume a person with a job could complete** — because it borrows authority from a poem the reader already owns

concepts.title: Worship as Treatment
concepts.description: ⭐⭐ an **Āyurvedaratna** arguing that Hanumān's immortality and his mastery of medicine are one fact seen twice: the eleven Rudras as the ten vital airs plus the soul, *vāta* foremost among the doṣas, **therefore *"a destroyer of disease as such"*** — a quantifier slide the essay does not notice. ⚑ **The same mantra at three intensities, the lowest requiring *"no formal preparatory discipline"* and suiting *"people of any background"*** — because the essay's stated reader is **the incurably ill**. ⭐ And it keeps the conjunction: **medicine *alongside* worship**

concepts.title: Why a Śābara Mantra Needs No Grammar
concepts.description: ⭐⭐ a class of formula **defined by working while broken** — *"deliberately odd or ungrammatical… need carry no coherent meaning at all"* — defended through ***sphoṭa***, which explains them by explaining away the semantics of every mantra. ⚑ **The volume's one stated adverse outcome — *"if the presiding deity is fierce, produce the opposite of the intended effect"* — is printed here, as the foil, in the essay about the class it does not govern.** With the 81-day bean-triangle and the unlocatable French sand-plate report `[LOW CONFIDENCE]`

concepts.title: Sampuṭīkaraṇa: Enclosing the Core
concepts.description: ⭐⭐ **the garland-mantra of epithets recited three times before AND after the core count** — a named technique for giving an unbounded practice edges, where **the deeds bracket the identity.** ⚑ **And it is the innermost of three concentric brackets**: placement, image and gesture are all performed twice, before and after. Used again in the volume for whole-*kāṇḍa* recitation and **never once defined** — an assumed skill surfacing as a verb

concepts.title: One Template, Two Counts
concepts.description: ⭐⭐ two *Mantra-Mahodadhi* vidhis sharing one ***sarvatobhadra* maṇḍala verbatim** — tortoise to wish-tree, nine seat-powers, four widening circles, eight epithets, eight generals, ten guardians — **and differing in seer (Rāma vs Śiva) and count by eightfold (12,000 vs a lakh), with no reason for either figure.** ⚑ **The accomplishment-before-application rule is printed on one facing page and not the other.** ⚠ **Four companion rosters across four texts in one volume: the frame is copied exactly, the personnel drift** — because a wrong name still yields a working diagram

title: Phase 10 — Natarajan + the site's non-*tattva* sections. Batch 2, 2026-08-18. **10 pages (3 here) + 4 source-updates.**

concepts.title: The Curse That Came With a Reversal Clause
concepts.description: ⭐⭐⭐ the sages *"had no recourse; they stayed silent and suffered it"*, so they took the strength away — **with the reversal printed inside the curse: *"whenever someone reminds you of your own glory, your strength will return and grow."*** The diagnosis is explicit (*"pride in strength is unfit for a devoted servant"*), which makes the curse a kindness issued for a servanthood not yet begun — and makes Jāmbavān's speech at the shore its documented operation rather than encouragement

concepts.title: The Parade Was the Survey
concepts.description: ⭐⭐⭐ the humiliation **used rather than endured**: the Brahmāstra submitted to *"rather than let the weapon's authority fail"*, released by the demons' own redundant bark ropes at a cost only Meghanāda understands; the march to court studied for *"roads and militarily useful positions"*; and the tail-parade delivering what the night search could not — *"thanks to Rāvaṇa's own punishment, he inspected it thoroughly"*, with blocks, lanes, gates and every notable demon's residence itemised. ⚑ **The release is timed to the completion of the survey, not to the fire**

concepts.title: The Speech Rāma Read
concepts.description: ⭐⭐ a full character assessment taken from one introduction: three Vedas inferred, *"not a sound that is out of place"*, **no unnecessary movement of face, eyes, forehead or brows**, pace neither dragged nor hurried, sound *"originating from the region of his heart"* using **lungs, throat and head together**. ⭐ **Closing on a hiring decision** — *"he will be able to accomplish all his works merely by delegating"* — and on the rule that **grammar is for the listener**: *"if people do not understand what we speak, it is a problem. If people misunderstand us, it is a catastrophe."*

title: Phase 10 — Natarajan + the site's non-*tattva* sections. Batch 3, 2026-08-18. **9 pages (6 here) + 1 folded + 4 source-updates.**

concepts.title: Why He Stayed
concepts.description: ⭐⭐⭐ the volume finally puts the obvious objection to its own hero — *"why would a devotee like that want to remain on this earth until the end of the kalpa?"* — and answers with **a job description**: *"helping travellers on the Lord's path day and night, **removing the obstacles in their practice.**"* Narrow scope (practice, not welfare), continuous schedule, **and strangers as the object**. With the a-fortiori from Bhīma — *"and Bhīma was his brother"* — and, from Śyāmlāl Hakīm's Nārada essay, **liberation refused unless bundled with continued servitude.** ⚑ **A terminal stage that is a *role* rather than a *state*, and therefore the only kind that can be failed**

concepts.title: The Warnings at the End of the Book
concepts.description: ⭐⭐⭐ **the *adhikāra*, contraindication and stopping criterion this build recorded as missing for ten phases — all three, in one paragraph, at the end of the narrative section.** An eligibility gate with a **non-institutional gatekeeper** (*"permission from a genuine devotee of Rāma or of Hanumān"*), a contraindication with a named adverse outcome (celibacy for the duration; cases *"visible even now"* of illness or divine displeasure), and a stopping rule arriving sideways — **the practitioners who are actually going somewhere *send the siddhis back*.** ⚠ **The finding is not that the corpus lacks safety doctrine; it is that the doctrine is filed two hundred pages from everything it governs**

concepts.title: Five Systems, Five Carve-Outs
concepts.description: ⭐⭐ **five traditions with an exclusivity rule, five structurally distinct solutions to one problem**, printed in one volume with no cross-reference: **evasion** (Vallabha's coded daily cry naming the Hūp image), **an enumerated exception** (*Śikṣāpatrī* 85, scoped to a circumstance, alternatives enumerated), **recategorisation** (Gauḍīya *dāsya* as a mode rather than a seat), **absorption** (Mādhva's three incarnations of Vāyu, so honouring him is honouring the founder), and **constitutive requirement** (Rāmānandī, where his omission makes Rāma-worship *"incomplete, even disruptive"*, with a *prasād* rule that excludes cannabis by supply constraint rather than by prohibition)

concepts.title: The Names Come First
concepts.description: ⭐⭐⭐ **a thousand names spoken *before* the mission is given**, to a servant who has done nothing yet — the corpus's only prospective valuation, against a debt, an embrace and public tributes all delivered after performance. **The naming produces the recognition and it runs the wrong way**: *"I, a mere vanara, have come to know you."* ⚑ **Names 729–740 give the ten avatāras as his own forms, Rāma at 736** — the volume's strongest evidence for its own identification argument, cited by nobody. Plus the operational block (pregnancy, debate, anger, sorcery, children) and ⭐ **a rendering that published an eleven-name hole rather than invent epithets nobody would have checked**

concepts.title: The Mountain and the Word
concepts.description: ⭐⭐ the one obstacle his strength cannot move, **because it is not terrain but category** (*"every rock of it is equivalent to a śālagrāma"*) — so he salutes it and asks. Then the completion order countermands the promise he has already made, and Rāma's ruling is the doctrine: ⭐ ***"your assurance and your word are my own assurance and my own word"*** — an unlimited, retroactive delegation on a commitment made in defiance of a standing order. 🔴 **With the Braj temples essay's incompatible version preserved on the page: different cause (set down by order, not immovable), different mover (Girirāj's complaint, not Hanumān's promise), different obligation (Rāma's debt to the mountain, not to his servant)**

concepts.title: Refuge, and What It Costs the Protector
concepts.description: ⭐⭐ sanctuary stated as **a transfer of assets away from whoever fails to give it** — *"he carries away all that protector's merit with him"* — with the limit case at maximum (*"even a man stained with the killing of tens of millions of brahmins"*) and the policy argument **conceded before being overruled** (*"you have said something very fine about policy"*). ⚑ **And the refugee's own prior attempts inside Rāvaṇa's court — naming the flattery as flattery, backed by Mālyavān, ending in a kick — reach the council not at all.** Two crowns set side by side: one bought with ten severed heads, one obtained by being kind to a stranger

title: Hanumanic Strategy build — Phase 10b, the full re-sweep of all 105 extension documents, 2026-08-19. **3 pages here of 9 built.**

concepts.title: The Navadhā on a Clock
concepts.description: **the nine limbs of devotion given per-limb allocations that sum to exactly ten minutes** — 2 / 2 / 2 / 1 / 1 / 1 / ½ / ½ — **with the ninth, *ātma-nivedana*, deliberately left off the budget and marked *ongoing*.** ⭐⭐ **The clock sorts the list into three classes the tradition never names: loading operations where time buys quantity, single acts where a minute is what one instance costs, and adopted stances that cannot be clocked at all.** ⚑ **A time budget is a taxonomy in disguise, and the limbs that refuse an allocation are the ones the tradition ranks highest.**

concepts.title: The Existing Practice as Infrastructure
concepts.description: ⭐⭐ **the corpus's governing design rule, stated in near-identical language across eight documents: attach to the practice the reader already runs, never add a competing one.** **Two mechanisms — *infusion* (same container, new payload) and *siting* (build only where the base is silent).** ⚑⚑ **The corpus builds payloads, not practices, and every protocol presupposes a delivery system it did not write.** ⛔ **That base is received material excluded from this vault entirely; the dependency's shape is recorded and none of its content.** ⚠ **The split it produces: architecture is transferable, procedure is not — and the corpus has never audited which of its material falls on which side.**

concepts.title: The Question That Replaces "What Would Hanumān Do?"
concepts.description: ⭐⭐⭐ **one document corrects the corpus's most-used device in a single sentence** — *"moving beyond 'What would Hanuman do?' to 'How can I express Hanuman-consciousness through this situation?'"* — **and four other documents go on using the uncorrected form.** ⚑ **The first question consults and cannot fail; the second presupposes an available state and returns a blank when there is none, which makes it the only self-administered instrument in the corpus that can come back negative.** **With the four pillars, the three-phase *divine assumption* practice and its feel-before-image instruction.** ⛔ **Attribution warning: eight quoted phrases are credited to the *Aṅka* and are recorded as the document's own language only.**

title: Bodri, *The Various Stages of the Spiritual Experience* — Phase 2, cluster N (the dhyāna ladder and the formless absorptions), 2026-08-19. **16 pages here of 17 built** (the seventeenth, *Ascent Is Disidentification*, files to psychology).

concepts.title: The Four-School Concordance of the Dhyānas
concepts.description: four vocabularies reading one ladder and sharing no term: **Buddhism counts what departs, Patañjali names what remains, Taoism watches which organ system quits, Tantra reports the bliss quality.** ⚑ ⭐⭐ **The agreement is strongest exactly where Bodri spends least effort.** Rungs 1–2 are Patañjali's own and match Buddhism factor for factor; rungs 3–4 in the yoga column come from Vyāsa and Vācaspati Miśra, whom Bodri says "tended to follow Buddhism's overall outline" — **so the four-witness claim holds only at the bottom of the table, and he stakes the book on the top.** ⚑ The *nir-vitarka*/*nir-vicāra* dispute "scholars have been arguing over for centuries" dissolves on one cross-reading: they are not states but the transition, Buddhism's "suburbs of a city." ⚑ 🔴 **Unreconciled**: Tantra says the fourth rung's bliss is present but imperceptibly subtle; Buddhism says bliss is gone. Both printed two paragraphs apart. ⚑ **The Taoist column is the only externally readable one and therefore the most forgeable** — the compliment and the complaint have one cause.

concepts.title: The Eight Ranks of Samādhi
concepts.description: **uncountable states compressed to nine categories, then the ninth removed because it "is only attainable by those following a pure prajñā, mind-only path."** ⚑ ⭐⭐⭐ **The standard scheme is an intersection**: it contains exactly what all schools share, because the one non-shared rung was dropped from the count — and it is then offered as proof that the schools describe one path. **The information that would distinguish traditions has not been lost; it has been concentrated entirely into the rung the map declines to show.** ⚑ *Bīja* / *sālambana* / *samprajñāta* — three names for one fact, and the clause that matters is that supported absorptions "produce tendencies or seeds for future functions of consciousness": **the Form Realm rungs are still sowing.** ⚑ James Austin's independent eight-phase reproduction, with his aside that "Zen itself will tend to pay rather little formal notice to such divisions." ⚑ 🔴 **No mechanism given for the rung-four/rung-five crossing** — every other transition has one; this one has a change of school.

concepts.title: The First Dhyāna
concepts.description: *ching-an* first: a coolness "like the vapor from dry ice" starting at crown or heels, **feet-first the stabler kind** (Chuang Tzu: "the real man breathes with his feet"), and a sweet salivary secretion Bodri insists "can be objectively tasted by any third party who kisses you." ⚑ ⭐ **The distribution argument inverted**: soma, ambrosia, *madya*, *amṛta*, grail wine appear everywhere "not because it's been a popular symbol to pass along from school to school, but because it's such a low stage of achievement." ⚑ ⭐⭐ **The rung's real criterion is an absence of appetite, not a report of a state** — the one marker in the neighbourhood a claimant cannot self-certify and cannot fake short-term, which is why "most masters will still feel the vestiges of sexual desire." ⚑ Saint Teresa's *orison of union* with its breath-cessation aside — a detail with no devotional payoff. ⚑ 🔴 **Ecstasy-vocabulary is unreliable when he warns and reliable when he argues**, unmarked. ⚑ ⚠ The anti-aging research proposal sits in fn 301, not the body; `[LOW CONFIDENCE]` on the biochemistry.

concepts.title: The Second and Third Dhyāna
concepts.description: **breath stops at the second rung and the pulse at the third**, survivable because "all your chi meridians will have opened up" — the machine powers down in order because it is full, not because it failed. ⚑ ⭐ **The sensory signature changes channel rather than fading**: startled by sound at the first rung, by light at the second, with tongue and nose already offline. Arbitrary, checkable, and reported in one column only. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **Joy is discarded at the third rung as "a coarse factor of mental disturbance"** — and Wang Yang-ming's maxim that joy means the mind is unperturbed is accepted and then *indexed*: true at rungs one and two, false at three. **A correct teaching, cited without its index, prevents the advance it was meant to support.** ⚑ ⭐⭐⭐ **The form-based ceiling**: a path working only chi, *mai*, chakras and kundalini tops out at the third dhyāna, and a method with a ceiling practised by people who do not know it has one produces a tradition that mistakes its ceiling for the sky. ⚑ **Swami Rama's stopped heart is "simply a demonstration of yogic gong-fu"** — and the forced/unforced fix moves the decisive evidence from something observable to something only the practitioner can report.

concepts.title: The Fourth Dhyāna
concepts.description: the rung where **thought itself goes**, "The Pure Ground of Renouncing Thought," and the first one "finally called a stage of liberation" — which reclassifies the three below it, including the disease-ending third, as *not* liberated. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **And then he takes it back in one sentence**: still Form Realm, "an image of emptiness, rather than an experience of true emptiness itself. Nevertheless it's on the very border of making this statement untrue." **The technical reason is Vyāsa's**: all four are "accompanied by supportive factors," and the support left at the top is *asmitā*, bare I-am-ness. ⚑ ⭐ **Yun-men gives the four physical markers in the same order** — a Zen source producing a staged physiological ladder, which Bodri notes "modern scholars all tend to ignore." ⚑ Rāhula's first-person progression through all four in four sentences, followed by everything the four were for; the technique named and unmystified (*ānāpāna*, a question, a forest, time). ⚑ 🔴 **Ramakrishna's five samādhis demoted to chi-channel phenomena — and Buddhism's own five blisses demoted on the same page by the same argument**, which is what keeps the knife from being sectarian; but the inference from his cancer to his attainment is `[LOW CONFIDENCE]`, recorded not carried. ⚑ ⚠ The Han-China reception claim is doing structural work with no historical support attached.

concepts.title: The Yogācārabhūmi's Ten Non-Samādhis
concepts.description: **ten states that are not samādhi, ranked by how close they come**, and Bodri's claim that studying them is "the only way" to discriminate. ⚑ ⭐⭐⭐ **A negative list cannot be gamed the way a positive description can**, because a description is a specification a counterfeit can be built to and an elimination is not. ⚑ **The second five describe accomplished people**: defilements remaining after the fruits are realised; no independent mastery to "enter, abide in, and emerge from" at will; and **rank eight — every runnable test passed, disqualified because the afflictions are not *forever* destroyed, which is unevaluable at the moment of asking.** ⚑ ⭐⭐ **Rank ten disqualifies every state anyone has ever entered, on the grounds that they came out of it** — either the list overshoots or it changes subject from states to the nature, and nothing marks which. ⚑ 🔴 **The entries are defined by being unnoticeable from inside, and the list is handed to the observer inside.** ⚑ ⚠ Chain is *B citing Cleary's translation of Nan's rendering* — three hands. ⚑ **Merit theory four pages earlier gives a completely different account of why people fail; the two never meet.**

concepts.title: The Formless Samādhi Belong to the Seventh Consciousness
concepts.description: ⭐⭐⭐ **the single most clarifying structural fact in the chapter**: "the four dhyāna are in the realm of the sixth consciousness, and the formless samādhi are within the realm of the seventh." **Not eight floors — four states of one faculty and four of another**, so a practitioner can "shuttle back and forth between them without ever catching the Tao," revolving inside discrimination and ego. ⚑ **The dhyānas are a floor, not a lower storey**: reachable from the first rung, unstabilisable without the four beneath. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **This is why the fourth dhyāna's residue is bare I-am-ness** — the whole apparatus was aimed at the sixth consciousness and self-clinging was never in it. ⚑ Infinite space fails "because space is a type of form," and the diagnostic is *knowing*: "to know this realm means you haven't broken away from consciousness yet." ⚑ ⭐ **The criterion stated as law**: "Anything that can exist at one time and not at another cannot be the ultimate natural state" — which guillotines all nine of his own rungs. ⚑ 🔴 **Ling-yuan's peach-blossom awakening reclassified as the first formless absorption, by assertion, with no analysis** — `[LOW CONFIDENCE]` on the verdict, and the method it demonstrates is worth more than the verdict. ⚑ 🔴 **The Buddha's "no gradual steps" instruction and Aśvaghoṣa's warning against popular samādhi are both printed inside the graded chapter and answered on audience grounds.**

concepts.title: The Samādhi of Nothingness and Neither Thought
concepts.description: **the distinction that separates two things every practitioner conflates**: in no-thought states "you are actually applying consciousness in a manner to push away thoughts"; in the samādhi of nothingness "your consciousness naturally achieves this stage of emptiness." **Pushing versus arriving**, with alertness as the only usable tell. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **The thread image for the fourth formless state** — a sewing thread that appears severed until you look closely and find something "so fine that we really cannot call it a thread." Discrimination has not stopped; it has become too fine to name either way. ⚑ ⭐⭐⭐ **Three years to reach the top of everything available, and the Buddha discarded it "because it wasn't dependable"** — thousands of aeons, then the fall, and the criterion is dependence rather than duration. ⚑ **Not annihilation: the ālaya remains**, and the *Saṃdhinirmocana*'s account of who gets this wrong — people who "have the power to think discerningly" but cling to their own views. ⚑ **Stace's thousands of introvertive mystics** and what unanimity is and is not worth. ⚑ 🔴 ⭐ **The Padmasambhava text Bodri endorses orders the last two formless states the other way round and calls the whole formless set "pitfalls of samādhi"** while calling the dhyānas the most eminent mundane samādhi — a harsher verdict than his own "lateral," printed without comment. ⚑ **"Frozen ice" practice, and rebirth as an animal — the observable core being that sustained blankness trains blankness.**

concepts.title: No-Thought Does Not Mean No Thoughts
concepts.description: ⭐⭐⭐ **"'No thought' doesn't have the meaning of 'not a thought arises' since that's like deep sleep, but has the meaning of not dwelling."** The positive definition: **"that empty functioning prajñā wisdom which recognizes thoughts when they arise."** ⚑ ⭐⭐ **Huineng and Tsong Khapa independently published corrections against the same misreading of the same instruction** — Chinese Chan and Gelug, centuries and a mountain range apart. **An instruction whose two greatest exponents both had to correct its obvious reading is badly phrased, and neither of them changed the words.** Huineng's criterion is relational, not quantitative: "when the mind is not influenced by objects." ⚑ **Padmasambhava's three clingings** — bliss → Desire Realm, clarity → Form Realm, nonthought → Formless Realm — with the escape route closed in advance: "even though you think you are neither attached nor clinging to them you retain a subtle internal attachment." ⚑ ⭐⭐⭐ **The portrait of the finished version is not placid**: "If you're in pain you cry out in pain, if you're joyful then you show joy, but these exhibitions all belong to the one who isn't in pain or joy." **Which reverses the folk diagnostic — visible flatness is the signature of the error, and a community selects its advanced practitioners by exactly the wrong signal.** ⚑ Lin-chi: "After the sword of wisdom is used, we must hurry to hone it once again."

concepts.title: The Esoteric Schools' Vocabulary, Decoded
concepts.description: **four terms mapped**: "emptiness" → infinite space; "clarity-lucidity-brightness" with "joy and bliss" → infinite consciousness; "no thought" → sometimes nothingness and sometimes *not dwelling*; "neither perception nor no-perception" → emptiness, lucid clarity and joy together. ⚑ ⭐⭐⭐ **"It's not that this information is a secret because the information is forbidden to others. Rather, it's just a secret because people are ignorant of the facts"** — and "ask any advanced monk about these matters, and they are bound to look at you with no clue at all." **Not gatekeeping: referent loss behind surviving vocabulary.** ⚑ ⭐⭐ **Mandala visualisation's proper target is the infinite consciousness samādhi, and practitioners overshoot to neither-thought-nor-no-thought** — which only reads as a miss because the numbering is not a ranking. ⚑ **Co-emergent bliss is the four dhyānas under another name**, argued structurally: four graded states described in terms of physical comfort are operating in the sensation skandha. ⚑ ⭐ **"The Tantric schools don't want to come right out and discuss entry into the four dhyāna using their techniques"** — a reluctance reported and never explained, and institutional self-interest is indistinguishable from pedagogical care from outside. ⚑ 🔴 **Chakra-to-samādhi correspondences ruled "all wrong"** by an author whose whole apparatus rests on chi and *mai* as substrate — the prerequisite/indicator line asserted, not drawn.

concepts.title: Hemacūḍa and Hemalekhā
concepts.description: ⭐⭐⭐ **the cleanest test in the chapter, and it requires no introspection at all**: "if he had to close his eyes and withdraw his awareness from the body in order to be blissful, he could not possibly have realized the Self." **She accepts every claim about the experience and asks what the experience *requires* — and conditions are public.** ⚑ **"Liberation cannot be produced even by a hundred ecstasies. Either it is the case or it is not"** — and "the effort to gain or regain it wasted," which is not partial progress but the wrong direction, made worse by talent. ⚑ 🔴 ⭐⭐ **Bodri cites this to argue Hinduism falls short of Buddhism — and the text is Hindu**, the critique internal to Vedānta, from a text Ramana Maharshi prized. **The argument he states is circular** (*the Buddha's advent must have been necessary, therefore what preceded was insufficient*). ⚑ 🔴 **He lists *sahaja samādhi* among the demoted states and then tells a story whose entire point is that the natural, unarranged, eyes-open condition is what the graded absorption was falsely substituting for** — the case study argues for half of what it is introduced to demote. ⚑ **Hemalekhā holds no position and her "serene and somewhat indifferent demeanor" is the same description Bodri elsewhere gives to a failure mode.** ⚠ Teaching parable, not report; chain is *B citing Feuerstein's rendering.*

concepts.title: The Mahāyāna Secret: Cultivate Presence, Not Samādhi
concepts.description: ⭐⭐⭐ **"Here's a very fundamental secret — the secret of cultivation"**: Hīnayāna cultivates dhyāna and samādhi, Mahāyāna cultivates presence — **"the method of direct attainment without stages," printed in the middle of a chapter of stages.** ⚑ **Two symmetrical failure modes make the instruction precise**: adding interpretation is *chasing*; imposing the awareness is *forcing*. Third Patriarch: "It is a mistake to apply the mind to the mind." ⚑ ⭐⭐ **"The fact you don't know something is also your fundamental knowing that you don't know something"** — an instruction with no entry condition that cannot be failed for lack of the target, because failing to find it is an instance of it. ⚑ ⭐ **The argument is from having a job**: "Most of us are not monks or nuns… a thousand things are always going on around us" — which describes essentially every reader, and makes the surrounding apparatus optional for its own audience. ⚑ **"Forget about your forgetting"**, and Tilopa's *attain the Non-attainment* — the only formulation that survives his own come-and-go criterion. ⚑ 🔴 **The sectarian framing does not survive his own witnesses** (Zen, three sutras, a Tibetan mahāsiddha, and the Buddha teaching "the enlightenment that has no stages").

concepts.title: Measure Progress by Clarity, Not by the Body
concepts.description: **"Don't even measure things by the state of the body, for it's always changing. Measure progress by clarity of mind."** ⚑ ⭐⭐ **"People forget that their head is actually part of their body consciousness"** — crown pressure, brow sensation and the buzz of a long sit are body data, and they feel mental only because of where they happen. ⚑ ⭐⭐⭐ **Clarity defined so that content is irrelevant**: "Not being confused isn't it; the clarity of knowing confusion or non-confusion is it!" — **a gauge that does not swing with what it measures.** ⚑ **Nan's deflation, quoted approvingly**: *tu mai* = spinal nervous system, *jen mai* = autonomic, *jing* = kidney and reproductive endocrine, the sweet saliva = pituitary and lymph — "a very ordinary method of cultivating one's health… not any mysterious secret." Celestial music explained as chi entering the nadis of the head. ⚑ ⭐⭐ ***Taoist Yoga*'s symptom list includes "boasting that he has achieved supreme truth" as a symptom** — alongside strange poems and involuntary weeping — **so the conviction of attainment is part of the episode, and the presentation is indistinguishable from what a tradition rewards.** ⚑ ⭐ **A prerequisite is not an indicator**: the body is necessary and unreadable, and this reconciles the apparent contradiction the text never addresses. ⚑ **What a tradition does with no gauge**: it must still rank, so it twists its writings "to come up with all sorts of doctrines that aren't inside them."

concepts.title: Nan's Compact Synopsis of the Nine
concepts.description: **five entry doors — faith, breath, mind-cleansing, analysis, mantra — and "they are not beyond four meditations and eight concentrations,"** stated as a classification result rather than as a thesis. ⚑ ⭐⭐⭐ **The discrepancy Bodri endorses as "very complete": Nan splits infinite form from infinite space and the samādhi of nothingness is simply absent.** **The count is preserved and the content is not, which is how schemes actually degrade — by silent omission inside an endorsement.** ⚑ 🔴 **Nan calls the fourth dhyāna "finally the ultimate end" and then describes five further states** — harmless read locally, a licence to stop read by a practitioner at that rung. ⚑ 🔴 **A different mechanism for the third rung**: joy *habituates* ("it becomes a habit that is different from the ordinary") rather than being abandoned as a disturbance. Two processes, one rung, both printed. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **"Biological bliss… a basic instinct of life itself and not the same as an ordinary feeling of pleasure"** — which fits Bodri's own reported facts (appetite vanishing rather than intensifying) better than his own hundred-times-sexual-pleasure comparison does. ⚑ **The arhats' foreknowledge of death and its four-clause formula — the only externally checkable claim about the ninth, and its cadence is liturgical.** ⚑ ⭐ **"They are not the monopoly of Buddhism… but none of them are the ultimate complete teaching"** — everything reproducible conceded, everything unverifiable retained.

concepts.title: The Taoist Seven Stages and Tilopa's Three
concepts.description: **seven rungs of body against three of mind**, with Bodri's own preference stated: "the most important thing is not what happens to the body but to the mind." ⚑ ⭐ **The Taoist seven puts immortality at rung four with three above it** — the tradition's headline claim sits mid-scheme in its own account, and rungs one to three are frankly medical (illnesses kept at bay, energy restored, years recovered). ⚑ ⭐⭐⭐ **Tilopa measures turbulence, not states**: waterfall → Ganges → ocean is one substance at three rates, nothing added and nothing removed. **And the first image says early practice makes the mind *seem* louder** — the noticing increased, not the noise — which is the only rung in either scheme describing a change in observation rather than in the thing observed. ⚑ ⭐⭐ **Three beats seven because a stage-map's rungs are also its plateaus**: every Taoist rung is something you could stop at and rungs two to four are things most people would be delighted to keep. **A slow river is not a destination.** ⚑ **Bodri's own demolition, immediately after**: the absorptions are "only the shadow of the truth… still states of ignorance but the intensity of this ignorance is far, far lighter" — and **"enlightenment is still a zero-one affair,"** which makes every stage-scheme structurally beside the point about the only question.

concepts.title: The Two Liberated Men and the Corpse
concepts.description: **Elisha over the Shunammite's son and Yeshe Tsogyel over a merchant's murdered son**, offered as one capability in two traditions: "it has nothing to do with the religious tradition." ⚑ ⭐⭐ **The distribution of agreement is the argument**: the two accounts converge on mechanics — contact, a transfer from the practitioner's body, a gradual return — and diverge on everything doctrinal (prayer vs procedure, privacy vs audience, gift vs contract). **Which is what a genuine convergence would look like, and also what a standard narrative shape would look like.** `[n=2 SUGGESTIVE]`. ⚑ ⭐⭐⭐ **The detail nobody comments on: she names a price.** The gold is agreed in advance, conditional on the result, from parents who had vowed to burn themselves — and it buys a third party out of servitude. Bodri reproduces the exchange in full inside an argument about the purity of attainment and says nothing. ⚑ **A drop of the adept's saliva is the transfer medium** — the same substance Bodri treats elsewhere as a real cultivated secretion, connection unremarked. ⚑ 🔴 **He ranks the two performances "a much higher stage of attainment" with no criterion**, in a book whose own principle is that ranking requires standing above what you rank. ⚑ ⭐ **The target is the grace explanation as an *excuse*** — "people use as excuses for why they themselves cannot perform such feats" — which is a functional charge, not a theological one. ⚑ ⚠ Both texts are hagiography; the surrounding pages lean on a psychiatric-classification claim this build has excluded.

title: Bodri, *The Various Stages of the Spiritual Experience* — Phase 2, cluster O (the eight consciousnesses), 2026-08-19. **11 pages, all here.**

concepts.title: Why Eight and Not Twelve
concepts.description: ⭐⭐⭐ **the count is not the claim, and he says so first**: "The importance of this structural breakdown is not in the fact that we have eight, rather than twelve or fifteen of twenty-four different types of consciousness." ⚑ **The two-criterion test is tradition-neutral and demanding**: a scheme must explain *both* the process of cultivation *and* the experiential realms encountered. **Either alone is easy; the pairing rules out most frameworks on one side or the other** — a training manual with no account of its results, or a catalogue of states with no route between them. ⚑ **The Vedic four is assessed rather than dismissed**: too coarse for a general map, and genuinely adequate for sleep yoga, dream yoga and bardo practice, because that is where its cuts fall. ⚑ ⭐ **The list is 5-1-1-1** — five items where the divisions are obvious from ordinary experience, three arrived at by analysis — **so all the scheme's contested content sits in the last three items.** ⚑ 🔴 `[CONTESTED]` **"This particular structure is the only one"** — a universal negative after examining one rival, with Sāṃkhya, the earlier Abhidharma lists and the Kashmir Śaiva scheme he quotes elsewhere never tested. **The criterion is earned and the superlative is not**, and they arrive in the same sentence.

concepts.title: The General and His Five Lieutenants
